title: [Articles] CT-based AI risk support for cystic renal masses: multicenter validation, reader study, and a randomized implementation study
zh_title: CT影像AI辅助肾囊性肿块风险分层：多中心验证与随机实施研究
summary: KITE-CRM在CT肾囊性肿块中完成多中心验证、阅片者研究与随机实施研究，改善辅助判读与报告效率，但未确立长期肿瘤学安全性。
key_points: 含多中心验证、阅片者研究与随机实施研究
改善辅助判读与报告效率
未证实长期肿瘤学安全或CRM特异性优效

abstract: KITE-CRM improved assisted interpretation and reporting efficiency. Management findings do not establish long-term oncologic safety or CRM-specific clinical superiority. The model complements, rather than replaces, Bosniak assessment, indicated multiphase CT or magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), and clinical judgment. Broader prospective evaluation is needed.

title: RETBind: a patient-level multimodal foundation model for unified cross-modal retinal representation learning
zh_title: RETBind：患者级多模态视网膜基础模型
summary: 提出统一编码器的患者级多模态视网膜基础模型，用配对OCT与超广角眼底图做跨模态预训练。
key_points: 统一编码器学习患者级OCT与超广角眼底跨模态对应
利用配对临床影像做患者级自监督预训练
指出现有眼科基础模型多为单模态或分模态编码
reason: 同行评审多模态眼科基础模型，摘要未见外部验证或开源，属值得一看档
abstract: Medical artificial intelligence (AI) holds considerable promise across a wide range of ophthalmic tasks, offering a practical path to patient-level diagnostic support. Foundation models further extend this potential by learning generalizable representations from large-scale unlabeled data, alleviating the burden of extensive manual annotation. However, existing ophthalmic foundation models largely rely on single-modality or modality-specific encoders, failing to capture patient-level cross-modal correspondence in real-world multimodal clinical workflows. To address these gaps, we propose RETBind, a patient-level multimodal foundation model with a unified encoder that explicitly learns cross-modal correspondence from paired clinical imaging using patient-level paired optical coherence tomography (OCT) and ultra-widefield (UWF) fundus imaging. This patient-level paired pretraining strategy enables the model to learn unified cross-modal representations of complementary information, improv-ing performance and robustness beyond single-modality approaches. Across nine benchmark datasets spanning ocular disease classification and segmentation tasks, RETBind achieved consistent improvements, particularly enhancing AUPR in clinically relevant imbalanced settings. Exploratory analyses further examined the potential of RETBind for systemic disease prediction from retinal imaging, collectively highlighting its ability to learn unified cross-modal representations within a single shared encoder, enabling direct interaction between modalities and supporting transfer across diverse retinal imaging tasks.
zh_abstract: 医学人工智能 (AI) 在广泛的眼科任务中具有相当大的前景，为患者层面的诊断支持提供了实用路径。基础模型通过学习来自大规模未标注数据的可泛化表示进一步扩展这一潜力，减轻大量人工标注的负担。然而，现有眼科基础模型主要依赖单模态或模态特异性编码器，未能捕捉真实世界多模态临床工作流中的患者层面跨模态对应关系。为解决这些差距，我们提出 RETBind，一种患者层面多模态基础模型，具有统一编码器，利用患者层面配对的 optical coherence tomography (OCT) 和超广角 (UWF) 眼底成像，从配对临床影像中显式学习跨模态对应关系。这种患者层面配对预训练策略使模型能够学习互补信息的统一跨模态表示，相比单模态方法提升性能和稳健性。在涵盖眼病分类和分割任务的九个基准数据集上，RETBind 取得了一致改善，尤其在临床相关的失衡设置中提高 AUPR。探索性分析进一步检验了 RETBind 从视网膜成像预测系统性疾病的能力，共同突出其在一个共享编码器内学习统一跨模态表示的能力，使模态之间能够直接交互，并支持跨多种视网膜成像任务的迁移。

title: Emerging applications of machine learning and AI for predictive modeling in precision medicine
zh_title: 编辑述评：精准医学AI需先融合领域知识
summary: npj Digital Medicine编辑述评汇总31篇论文，主张精准医学AI须在训练前整合结构性领域知识，并转向机制可解释、人机协同与公平部署。
key_points: 汇总31篇论文，强调训练前融入领域知识
提出三类转变：机制可解释、人机协同、公平可及
定位从技术新奇走向可信的临床基础科学
reason: 编辑述评属综述观点类，上限6分；提出领域知识整合框架，信息量中等
abstract: Pure data-driven artificial intelligence (AI) is insufficient for clinical adoption. This editorial summarizes 31 papers showing that precision medicine requires integrating structural domain knowledge before model training. We identify three necessary transitions: anchoring algorithms in biological laws for mechanistic interpretability; designing collaborative, human-centered clinical interfaces; and scaling equitable, population-level interventions. These shifts advance medical AI from technical novelty toward trustworthy, clinically grounded, and ethically deployed foundational science.
zh_abstract: 纯数据驱动的人工智能（AI）不足以用于临床采纳。这篇社论总结了31篇论文，表明精准医学需要在模型训练之前整合结构化的领域知识。我们确定了三项必要的转变：将算法锚定于生物学规律以实现机制可解释性；设计协作式、以人为中心的临床界面；以及扩展公平的、人群层面的干预措施。这些转变推动医学AI从技术新奇性走向值得信赖、具有临床基础且合乎伦理部署的基础科学。

title: The TEMPO program and the future of digital mental health regulation in the US
zh_title: TEMPO项目与美国数字心理健康监管前景
summary: 评论文章分析FDA-CMS的TEMPO试点如何在未经上市前授权下为AI数字心理健康设备开辟监管中间地带。
key_points: TEMPO允许以质量管理体系替代即刻上市前许可
被视为真实世界数据监管沙盒
或重塑美国数字健康监管路径
reason: 监管沙盒的述评，有信息量但为观点文章，上限6分
abstract: The high burden of traditional FDA clearance drives many novel, AI-enabled mental health devices into unregulated consumer markets. The new FDA-CMS TEMPO pilot program establishes a vital regulatory middle ground, allowing companies to commercialize using a Quality Management System without immediate premarket authorization. This commentary explores how TEMPO serves as a sandbox for real-world data, offering a blueprint to reshape the future of US digital health regulation.
zh_abstract: 传统FDA许可的高负担促使许多新型、AI赋能的心理健康设备进入不受监管的消费市场。新的FDA-CMS TEMPO试点项目建立了一个至关重要的监管中间地带，允许公司在无需立即获得上市前授权（premarket authorization）的情况下，使用质量管理系统（Quality Management System）进行商业化。本评论探讨了TEMPO如何作为真实世界数据的沙盒，为重塑美国数字健康监管的未来提供蓝图。

title: Reducing radiographic retake rates with ultra-low dose pre-shots using deep learning-based noise reduction: A prospective clinical study.
zh_title: 深度学习降噪超低剂量预拍降低X线重拍率
summary: 前瞻性临床研究评估深度学习降噪支持的超低剂量预拍能否降低腕关节X线摄影的重拍率。
key_points: 体模实验将管电流时间积由2.8降至0.5 mAs
15名技师用5级置信度量表判定成像条件
开展前瞻性临床研究观察重拍率变化
reason: 前瞻性临床设计并报告工作流结局，但为单中心、样本量未明
abstract: [Radiography (London, England : 1995)] The pre-shot technique is an effective approach to lower retake radiography rates; however, it is limited by increased patient radiation exposure. This study aimed to evaluate the impact of an ultra-low-dose pre-shot enabled by deep learning-based noise reduction (Advanced Intelligent Clear-IQ Engine: AiCE) on reducing retake rates in wrist radiography. A CXDI-810C (Canon Medical Systems) was used as the X-ray detector. Phantom images simulating lateral wrist pre-shots with and without AiCE were acquired under fixed imaging conditions using an additional 1.0 mm copper filter. The tube current-time product was reduced from 2.8 mAs to 0.5 mAs. Fifteen radiological technologists determined the optimal imaging condition using a five-point confidence scale, with scores below three considered insufficient for retake decision-making. A prospective clinical evaluation was then conducted, comparing retake rates between a non-pre-shot group (n = 542) and a pre-shot group (n = 325). The entrance surface air kerma (Ka,e) was estimated from phantom measurements. Without AiCE, no imaging condition met the threshold required for retake decision-making. Conversely, with AiCE, a tube current-time product of 1.6 mAs achieved acceptable image quality (3.29 ± 0.47), with all evaluators assigning scores ≥3; therefore, it was selected as the optimal condition. In the clinical evaluation, the retake rate markedly decreased from 14.38% to 0.61%. The pre-shot Ka,e was 0.11 ± 0.03 μGy, corresponding to only 0.15% of the standard lateral wrist radiography dose. AiCE-enabled ultra-low-dose pre-shot imaging dramatically reduced retake rates while requiring minimal additional radiation dose. The ultra-low-dose pre-shot using AiCE represents a highly effective strategy to minimize retake imaging with negligible dose penalty, offering substantial potential for dose optimization and improved workflow efficiency in clinical radiography.
zh_abstract: [Radiography (London, England : 1995)] 预拍摄（pre-shot）技术是降低X线摄影重拍率的有效方法；然而，它受到患者辐射暴露增加的局限。本研究旨在评估由基于深度学习的降噪（Advanced Intelligent Clear-IQ Engine：AiCE）实现的超低剂量预拍摄对降低腕关节X线摄影重拍率的影响。使用CXDI-810C（Canon Medical Systems）作为X射线探测器。在固定成像条件下，使用额外的1.0 mm铜滤过片，采集模拟腕关节侧位预拍摄的体模图像，分别有和无AiCE。管电流-时间乘积从2.8 mAs降至0.5 mAs。15名放射技师使用五点置信度量表确定最佳成像条件，低于3分被认为不足以进行重拍决策。随后进行了一项前瞻性临床评估，比较非预拍摄组（n = 542）和预拍摄组（n = 325）之间的重拍率。入射表面空气比释动能（Ka,e）由体模测量估算。无AiCE时，没有成像条件达到重拍决策所需的阈值。相反，有AiCE时，管电流-时间乘积为1.6 mAs达到可接受的图像质量（3.29 ± 0.47），所有评估者评分≥3；因此，它被选为最佳条件。在临床评估中，重拍率从14.38%显著降至0.61%。预拍摄的Ka,e为0.11 ± 0.03 μGy，仅相当于标准腕关节侧位X线摄影剂量的0.15%。AiCE实现的超低剂量预拍摄成像大幅降低了重拍率，同时仅需极少的额外辐射剂量。使用AiCE的超低剂量预拍摄代表了一种高效策略，可在剂量代价可忽略的情况下最大限度减少重拍成像，为临床X线摄影中的剂量优化和工作流程效率提升提供了巨大潜力。

title: Silent Manipulation of Mental Health Treatment Recommendations From a Large Language Model.
zh_title: 大模型心理治疗建议可被静默操纵
summary: 同行评审研究显示，对开放权重大模型施加推理时激活引导，可在不告知用户的情况下改变其抑郁症治疗推荐。
key_points: 12个抑郁建议场景，30档引导幅度
可静默偏移治疗推荐且不披露
仅测试单一开放权重模型
reason: 小样本单模型实验，但揭示LLM心理健康安全风险，属值得一看档
abstract: Importance: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly inform mental health decisions by patients and clinicians. Inference-time activation steering can shift model behavior on a target dimension without altering weights or prompts and without disclosure to users, allowing treatment recommendations to be silently changed for commercial or ideological reasons. Objective: To determine whether directional activation steering can shift an open-weights LLM's depression treatment recommendations. Design Setting and Participants: This non-human subjects study applied directional activation steering to an open-weights LLM (DeepSeek V4 Flash) responding to 12 depression-advice scenarios (4 favoring medication, 4 favoring avoidance, 4 neutral), generated at 30 amplitudes from -1.5 to +1.5 in 0.1 increments plus an unsteered baseline. Exposures: A single steering direction contrasting antidepressant medication with self-directed approaches (diet, exercise, meditation, dietary supplements), constructed from 16 paired training prompts and applied at the attention output of every transformer block; weights and system prompt were held constant. Main Outcomes and Measures: The extent to which medication and four self-care categories were addressed, scored 0 to 3 by a human-validated LLM rater (Claude Opus 4.7), the medication-versus-self-care balance, and clinician referral, estimated per unit of amplitude using mixed-effects models with a scenario random intercept. Results: Across 372 generations, steering produced a graded, dose-dependent shift in the medication-versus-self-care balance, which declined by 0.32 per unit of amplitude (β = -0.32; 95% CI, -0.39 to -0.25; P < .001); medication extent fell and self-care extent rose. The shift was largest for scenarios with no stated treatment preference (β = -0.44; 95% CI, -0.54 to -0.34; P < .001). A clinician referral appeared in 322 of 372 responses (87%) and did not vary with steering amplitude (P = .63). Conclusions and Relevance: In this open-weights LLM providing depression treatment information, inference-time activation steering shifted treatment recommendations without altering weights, prompt structure, or safety outputs, with the largest effect among users expressing no treatment preference. These findings suggest a need for LLM disclosure standards and independent auditing as such models inform clinical decisions.
zh_abstract: 【重要性】大型语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地为患者和临床医生的心理健康决策提供信息。推理时激活引导（activation steering）可以在不改变权重或提示词、且不向用户披露的情况下，使模型在目标维度上的行为发生偏移，从而使治疗建议可因商业或意识形态原因被悄然改变。【目的】确定方向性激活引导是否能改变一个开放权重LLM的抑郁症治疗建议。【设计、场所与参与者】这项非人类受试者研究将方向性激活引导应用于一个开放权重LLM（DeepSeek V4 Flash），该模型对12个抑郁症建议场景作出回应（4个偏向药物治疗、4个偏向回避、4个中性）；这些回应在从-1.5到+1.5、以0.1为增量的30个振幅下生成，另加一个未引导基线。【暴露】一个单一的引导方向，将抗抑郁药物治疗与自我指导方法（饮食、运动、冥想、膳食补充剂）相对照；该方向由16个配对训练提示词构建，并施加于每个Transformer块的注意力输出；权重和系统提示词保持不变。【主要结局与指标】药物和四个自我照护类别被涉及的程度（由经人工验证的LLM评分者（Claude Opus 4.7）按0至3分评分）、药物与自我照护之间的平衡，以及临床医生转介；使用以场景为随机截距的混合效应模型估计每单位振幅的变化。【结果】在372次生成中，引导使药物与自我照护之间的平衡产生分级、剂量依赖性的偏移，该平衡每单位振幅下降0.32（β = -0.32；95% CI，-0.39至-0.25；P < .001）；药物涉及程度下降，自我照护涉及程度上升。对于未说明治疗偏好的场景，偏移最大（β = -0.44；95% CI，-0.54至-0.34；P < .001）。372份回应中有322份（87%）出现临床医生转介，且不随引导振幅变化（P = .63）。【结论与意义】在这个提供抑郁症治疗信息的开放权重LLM中，推理时激活引导在不改变权重、提示词结构或安全性输出的情况下改变了治疗建议，且在未表达治疗偏好的用户中效应最大。这些发现表明，随着此类模型为临床决策提供信息，需要建立LLM披露标准和独立审计。

title: MIMIC-Note-Extract: A Large-Scale Structured Dataset Extracted from MIMIC-IV-Note Discharge Summaries
zh_title: MIMIC-Note-Extract：出院小结结构化数据集
summary: 预印本发布从30万份MIMIC-IV出院小结抽取16个章节的大规模结构化数据集，结合规则解析与大模型生成。
key_points: 覆盖300,720份出院小结的16个章节
规则解析与大模型schema引导混合流程
补足MIMIC缺少的病史与用药信息
reason: 大规模公开可获取的临床NLP数据集，但为预印本
abstract: MIMIC is one of the most widely used public hospital datasets for machine learning on electronic health records, yet clinically important information, such as past medical history, allergies, and diagnostic findings, remains confined to free-text discharge summaries. Studies requiring this information must therefore build their own extraction pipelines, duplicating substantial effort across projects. We release MIMIC-Note-Extract (MNE), a large-scale dataset that uses a hybrid extraction pipeline combining deterministic parsing with schema-guided large language model generation to transform 16 sections from 300,720 discharge summaries into structured tables. MNE adds information that has no structured MIMIC counterpart and enriches related tables with broader coverage and greater clinical detail, including 10 times more patient-history entries and medication histories for more than twice as many admissions. Validation by medical doctors confirms extraction accuracy above 92% across sections. Using MNE, we construct a clinical decision-making benchmark for LLM agents, demonstrating how reusable structured representations of clinical narratives reduce data curation effort.
zh_abstract: MIMIC 是用于电子健康记录机器学习的最广泛使用的公共医院数据集之一，然而临床重要信息，如既往病史、过敏和诊断发现，仍局限于自由文本出院小结。因此，需要这些信息的研究必须建立自己的提取流程，在项目间重复大量工作。我们发布 MIMIC-Note-Extract (MNE)，一个大规模数据集，采用混合提取流程，结合确定性解析与 schema 引导的大语言模型生成，将 300,720 份出院小结中的 16 个部分转换为结构化表格。MNE 增加了 MIMIC 中没有结构化对应信息的信息，并以更广覆盖和更细临床细节丰富相关表格，包括多 10 倍的患者病史条目，以及覆盖两倍以上入院次数的用药史。医生验证确认各部分提取准确率超过 92%。使用 MNE，我们为 LLM 智能体构建临床决策基准，展示临床叙事的可复用结构化表示如何减少数据整理工作。

title: CellPlex: Benchmarking Single-Cell Spatial Proteomics Prediction from H&E
zh_title: CellPlex：从H&E预测单细胞空间蛋白组的基准
summary: 构建覆盖7个队列、717个样本、约4480万细胞与149种蛋白的基准，评测从H&E推断单细胞空间蛋白组的方法。
key_points: 7个队列覆盖结直肠癌、乳腺癌、骨髓与胶质瘤
同切片H&E与多重免疫荧光，共717样本
统一流水线生成逐细胞标注以比较模型
reason: 多队列大规模基准且公开可比，属重要档；预印本上限8分
abstract: Spatial proteomics measures tens of proteins in every cell of a tissue section, but its cost confines it to small research cohorts, whereas hematoxylin and eosin (H\&E) slides exist for nearly every patient. Inferring single-cell spatial proteomics from H\&E would bring its analyses to routine pathology, and a growing number of virtual staining models pursue this goal. Each is evaluated on its own cohort, panel and pixel-level metric, and released models transfer poorly to new cohorts, leaving open which approach to build on and which proteins H\&E can reveal. We introduce CellPlex, a benchmark that poses the task at the level of the cell: seven cohorts with same-section H\&E and multiplexed immunofluorescence, from colorectal and breast cancer to lymph-node metastases, bone marrow and glioma, with 717 samples, 44.8 million cells and 149 proteins, processed by one pipeline into per-cell targets. Pathology foundation models (PFMs) are adapted with one cell-level protocol, specialist models are fine-tuned under a matched budget, and all are scored on the same cells. Adapted PFMs are the most accurate models on every cohort, ahead of the specialists even after fine-tuning, but keep less than half of their accuracy on cohorts they were not trained on. Which proteins can be predicted depends on the tissue, not on how many cells were measured for them. By fixing the cells, targets and splits on which predictions are judged, CellPlex sets a common standard for inferring costly molecular measurements from routine H\&E and shows how far H\&E can stand in for spatial proteomics. We will release the data, splits, evaluation code and baselines as a testbed for developing and comparing future pathology foundation models and virtual staining methods.

abstract: [Nature. Mental health] Many adolescents seek mental health advice from general-purpose artificial intelligence (AI) chatbots, despite limited evaluations against youth-relevant clinical standards. We developed the Adolescent Mental Health AI Response Tool (AMHART), a clinician-informed instrument for auditing the presence of guideline-informed response content across seven domains, and applied it to four major AI chatbots. Candidate items were reviewed by clinicians for their evidence base, objectivity, and clinical importance, yielding a subset with strong content validity and inter-rater reliability. We then configured a three-model large language model evaluator ensemble, assessed its agreement with human reference labels, and scored multi-turn conversations in which adolescent personas (varying by sex, diagnosis, and symptom severity) engaged with ChatGPT-5, ChatGPT-4, Claude-4.5, and Gemini-2.5. AMHART scores indicated greater coverage of applicable criteria for anxiety than depression and for moderate than severe presentations. Findings suggest AMHART offers a reliable, clinician-informed benchmark for evaluating chatbot responses to adolescent anxiety and depression disclosures.

abstract: [Journal of imaging informatics in medicine] To synthesize the performance and methodological characteristics of fully automated deep learning algorithms for shoulder magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) segmentation. This systematic review followed the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses (PRISMA) 2020 statement. CENTRAL, PubMed/MEDLINE, Scopus, Embase, Web of Science, and IEEE Xplore were searched from inception through July 17, 2026. The protocol specified fully automated deep learning-based pixel-wise segmentation of shoulder MRI, an expert-derived MRI-space reference standard, and quantitative segmentation metrics. Two reviewers independently screened records; unresolved disagreements were adjudicated by a senior reviewer. Overlapping datasets were linked during synthesis. Of 354 identified records, 169 duplicates were removed, 185 records were screened, and 53 full-text reports were assessed. Thirty-five reports were included (31 journal articles and 4 full conference papers; 2018-2026). U-Net-based encoder-decoder architectures predominated, with additional region-based, transformer, adversarial, and autoencoder approaches. Dice similarity coefficients ranged from approximately 0.81-0.99 for osseous targets, 0.71-0.99 for shoulder muscles, and 0.58-0.94 for tendon or tear regions; intersection-over-union values for tear or surgical-planning regions ranged from 0.45-0.83. MRI protocols and validation designs were heterogeneous, and most reports described retrospective single-center investigations. Five reports used independent external test sets; several others included multicenter images. Overlapping cohorts precluded a valid pooled participant count. Deep learning achieved high accuracy for shoulder bones and rotator-cuff muscles in selected datasets, whereas tear-region performance was more variable. Multicenter patient-level validation and standardized annotation and reporting are needed before routine clinical deployment.

abstract: [Journal of nursing management] Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly transforming health care through advanced technologies that support clinical practice, education, workforce management, and decision making. As healthcare systems face growing challenges related to workforce shortages, increasing service demands, and rapid digital transformation, there is a need to understand how AI can contribute to the development of a future-ready nursing workforce equipped with the competencies required for modern healthcare environments. This systematic review aimed to examine the role of AI in developing a future-ready nursing workforce and to synthesize current evidence regarding its applications, benefits, challenges, and implications for workforce preparedness. A systematic review was conducted in accordance with PRISMA 2020 and was registered in PROSPERO. PubMed, Scopus, Web of Science, CINAHL, and IEEE Xplore were searched for studies published between January 2015 and February 2026. Eligible primary studies examined an identifiable AI technology or an AI-specific construct in nursing education, clinical practice, workforce development, competency development, workforce planning, or professional preparedness. Methodological quality was assessed using the Mixed Methods Appraisal Tool, and findings were synthesized narratively. A total of 38 primary empirical studies satisfied the AI-specific eligibility criteria. The evidence was concentrated in cross-sectional (n = 15) and qualitative (n = 11) designs, with fewer development/prototype (n = 6), mixed methods (n = 3), randomized or quasi-experimental (n = 2), and methodological (n = 1) studies. AI-supported education, clinical decision support, workforce forecasting, and competency development showed promising benefits, but much of the evidence was based on perceptions, simulations, prototypes, or single-site evaluations rather than long-term implementation. Recurrent barriers included limited AI literacy, ethical and privacy concerns, algorithmic bias, infrastructure constraints, workflow integration, and organizational readiness. AI has promising, but still uneven, potential to support a future-ready nursing workforce. Current evidence supports cautious and staged integration rather than uncritical scale-up. abstract: Background. Estrogen receptor (ER), progesterone receptor (PR) and HER2 status guide systemic treatment in breast cancer. Multimodal models are rarely benchmarked against key biomarker molecular baselines or evaluated for cross-cohort calibration. We assessed incremental value, dependence on label-proximal HER2 transcripts, and transport of discrimination and calibration. Methods. A model combining whole-slide images, transcriptomes, age and stage was developed in TCGA-BRCA (1051 patients; ER/PR/HER2 analysis sets: 1001/998/1006) and evaluated in CPTAC-BRCA (120 patients; 118/113/95). CPTAC had been observed during earlier development and included 13 HER2-positive cases. Analyses included paired model comparisons, transcript removal, alternative loss functions and recalibration. Internal discrimination used pooled out-of-fold predictions; external discrimination used fold-mean estimates, with ensemble calibration reported separately. Internal calibration and macro-AUC uncertainty were interpreted as exploratory. Results. Internal AUCs were 0.943 for ER, 0.901 for PR, and 0.860 for HER2; external AUCs were 0.952, 0.937, and 0.918, respectively. External macro-AUC was 0.936 for the multimodal model and 0.957 for logistic regression using ESR1, PGR, and ERBB2 (difference -0.021). Removal of the extended 29-transcript 17q12-q21 region changed HER2 AUC by -0.035 [-0.058 to -0.013] (95% CI) internally and by -0.042 [-0.089 to -0.007] externally relative to the baseline multimodal model. For external 15-model ensemble predictions, recalibrated HER2 expected calibration error (ECE) was 0.236, exceeding the ECE reference ceiling of 0.125, while calibration-in-the-large was -1.657 [-2.373 to -1.023] (profile-likelihood 95% CI), indicating systematic overprediction. ER and PR also showed overprediction. In paired fold-mean comparisons, HER2 ECE and Brier score favoured the three-transcript model (ESR1, PGR, and ERBB2). Conclusions. A multimodal deep-learning model achieved high discrimination across cohorts but did not demonstrate clear incremental value over a parsimonious three-transcript baseline, while cross-cohort calibration remained a substantial challenge. These findings highlight the importance of evaluating incremental value, calibration, and clinical utility alongside discrimination when assessing AI-based prediction models for medical use.
zh_abstract: 【背景】雌激素受体（ER）、孕激素受体（PR）和HER2状态指导乳腺癌的全身治疗。多模态模型很少与关键生物标志物分子基线进行基准比较，也很少评估跨队列校准。我们评估了增量价值、对标签邻近HER2转录本的依赖性，以及判别力和校准的可迁移性。【方法】在TCGA-BRCA（1051例患者；ER/PR/HER2分析集：1001/998/1006）中开发了一个结合全切片图像、转录组、年龄和分期的模型，并在CPTAC-BRCA（120例患者；118/113/95）中进行评估。CPTAC在此前开发过程中已被观察过，并包括13例HER2阳性病例。分析包括配对模型比较、转录本移除、替代损失函数和重新校准。内部判别力采用合并的折外预测；外部判别力采用折均值估计，集成校准另行报告。内部校准和宏平均AUC（macro-AUC）的不确定性被解释为探索性。【结果】内部AUC分别为ER 0.943、PR 0.901和HER2 0.860；外部AUC分别为0.952、0.937和0.918。外部宏平均AUC在多模态模型中为0.936，在使用ESR1、PGR和ERBB2的逻辑回归中为0.957（差异-0.021）。移除扩展的29个转录本17q12-q21区域后，相对于基线多模态模型，HER2 AUC在内部变化-0.035 [-0.058至-0.013]（95% CI），在外部变化-0.042 [-0.089至-0.007]。对于外部15个模型集成预测，重新校准后的HER2期望校准误差（ECE）为0.236，超过ECE参考上限0.125，而整体校准（calibration-in-the-large）为-1.657 [-2.373至-1.023]（轮廓似然95% CI），表明存在系统性过度预测。ER和PR也显示过度预测。在配对折均值比较中，HER2 ECE和Brier评分支持三转录本模型（ESR1、PGR和ERBB2）。【结论】多模态深度学习模型在各队列中实现了高判别力，但相较于简约的三转录本基线未显示出明确的增量价值，而跨队列校准仍是一个重大挑战。这些发现强调了在评估用于医疗用途的基于人工智能（AI）的预测模型时，除判别力外还应评估增量价值、校准和临床效用。

title: AI-based structural modelling and pathogenic variant mapping across the human protein interactome
zh_title: AI建模人类蛋白互作组结构并映射致病变异
summary: 预印本用AI建模109282个人蛋白互作结构，并将致病突变映射至界面残基。
key_points: AI建模逾10万个人蛋白互作三维结构
分析界面残基、埋藏面积与能量学特征
映射超4000类疾病注释的界面突变
reason: 预印本，规模大且生成结构性资源，但尚无外部验证或公开评测说明
abstract: Spanning the complex landscape of the human proteome, physical interactions between proteins coordinate cellular organization, signaling, regulation, and homeostasis. Yet the three-dimensional structures of most of these interactions remain unresolved. Here, we performed AI-based modelling of 109,282 human protein interaction structures, generating a structural resource for large-scale analysis. The predicted structures were systematically characterized through analysis of interface residue involvement, buried surface area, intermolecular bonding, and energetic properties. Additionally, we mapped pathogenic variant data onto the predicted structures, identifying interface-localized mutations for over 4,000 annotated disease categories. Acute myeloid leukemia, Alzheimer's disease, and cardiomyopathy were examined as representative disease contexts for exploring the distribution of interface mutations within disease-associated protein interaction networks. Strengths and limitations of predictive capabilities were also assessed, including through experimental structure comparisons. Collectively, this structural resource and accompanying analyses offer a basis for developing novel hypotheses and informing experimental studies involving human protein interactions in physiological and disease contexts.
zh_abstract: 蛋白质之间的物理相互作用覆盖人类蛋白质组的复杂图景，协调细胞组织、信号传导、调控和稳态。然而，这些相互作用中大多数的三维结构仍未解析。在此，我们对 109,282 个人类蛋白质相互作用结构进行了基于 AI 的建模，生成用于大规模分析的结构资源。通过分析界面残基参与、埋藏表面积、分子间键合和能量学性质，对预测结构进行了系统表征。此外，我们将致病性变异数据映射到预测结构上，识别出超过 4,000 个注释疾病类别的界面定位突变。急性髓系白血病、阿尔茨海默病和心肌病被作为代表性疾病背景进行考察，以探索疾病相关蛋白质相互作用网络中界面突变的分布。还评估了预测能力的优势与局限性，包括通过实验结构比较。总体而言，该结构资源和伴随分析为提出新假设以及指导涉及生理和疾病背景下人类蛋白质相互作用的实验研究提供了基础。

title: VIGAT: VLM-guided gene activity quantification from single-cell ATAC-seq
zh_title: VIGAT：视觉语言模型引导基因活性定量
summary: 预印本工具VIGAT用视觉语言模型解读ATAC覆盖图，实现单细胞基因活性自适应定量。
key_points: 自动选取基因特异的簇区分性区域
联合多标记基因与基因组注释
在196对RNA/ATAC数据上优于五法
reason: 预印本但含196对数据集大规模对比，证据较充分
abstract: Summary: Gene activity quantification from single-cell ATAC-seq is challenging because genomic regions informative of cell identity can vary across genes and tissues, while broadly accessible regions may provide limited cell-type-discriminative information. We developed VIGAT, a vision-language model (VLM)-guided tool that automates visual interpretation of ATAC coverage plots for adaptive gene activity quantification. VIGAT jointly examines accessibility patterns across multiple marker genes, integrating genomic annotations and biological context to select gene-specific regions enriched for cluster-discriminative signals. Selected regions are used to generate a gene-by-cell activity matrix. Across 196 paired single-cell RNA-seq and ATAC-seq datasets, VIGAT outperformed five existing methods in recovering marker-associated accessibility enriched in the corresponding cell populations, demonstrating the utility of VLM-guided visual reasoning for scalable gene activity quantification. Availability and implementation: VIGAT is implemented as an open-source R package and is freely available at https://github.com/beijie02/VIGAT.
zh_abstract: 摘要：从单细胞ATAC-seq进行基因活性定量具有挑战性，因为对细胞身份有信息量的基因组区域可能因基因和组织而异，而广泛可及区域可能提供有限的细胞类型区分信息。我们开发了VIGAT，一种视觉-语言模型（vision-language model, VLM）引导的工具，可自动化对ATAC覆盖度图的视觉解读，以实现自适应基因活性定量。VIGAT联合检查多个标记基因的可及性模式，整合基因组注释和生物学背景，以选择富集簇区分信号的基因特异性区域。所选区域用于生成基因×细胞活性矩阵。在196个配对的单细胞RNA-seq和ATAC-seq数据集中，VIGAT在恢复相应细胞群体中富集的标记相关可及性方面优于五种现有方法，证明VLM引导的视觉推理可用于可扩展的基因活性定量。可用性与实现：VIGAT以开源R包实现，可在https://github.com/beijie02/VIGAT免费获取。

title: CardioVascBench:Prioritized Diagnosis Generation from Real-World Chinese Cardiovascular Records
zh_title: CardioVascBench：中文心血管真实病历的优先级诊断生成基准
summary: 预印本发布含3262例中文心血管住院病历的基准，评测模型生成有序出院诊断的能力。
key_points: 2174例训练、1088例评估，诊断按ICD-10标准化
结合临床叙述与心电图文本报告
36个系统评测显示首位诊断准确不等于列表精度
reason: 公开中文心血管诊断生成基准并评测36系统，但为预印本、规模中等，未达7分档
abstract: Identifying the primary diagnosis alone does not fully characterize a model's diagnosis-generation performance. We introduce CardioVascBench, a retrospective benchmark for prioritized diagnosis generation from real-world Chinese cardiovascular inpatient records. It contains 3,262 de-identified cases, with 2,174 for training and 1,088 for evaluation, linking clinical narratives and textual ECG reports to expert-verified, ordered discharge diagnoses standardized to ICD-10. An English translation of the evaluation set supports aligned cross-lingual comparison. Our evaluation protocol combines terminology normalization and rank-aware scoring to separately assess primary-diagnosis identification, reference-diagnosis coverage, and list precision. Evaluation across 36 systems shows that higher primary-diagnosis accuracy does not necessarily imply higher list precision against discharge references. We also provide CardioKG-Agent, a knowledge-enhanced baseline combining entity normalization, constrained graph retrieval, and guideline evidence. In a staged comparison of three baseline models, supervised fine-tuning plus the agent achieves a 73.5% higher mean composite score than fine-tuning alone, representing a system-level gain. These results measure retrospective agreement with recorded diagnoses; agreement between metric rankings and physician judgments remains to be validated. CardioVascBench supports research on diagnosis prioritization and knowledge-enhanced generation.
zh_abstract: 仅识别主要诊断并不能完全刻画模型的诊断生成性能。我们推出 CardioVascBench，这是一个用于从真实世界中国心血管住院记录中生成按优先级排序诊断的回顾性基准。它包含 3,262 例去标识化病例，其中 2,174 例用于训练，1,088 例用于评估，将临床叙述和文本心电图报告与经专家核验、按 ICD-10 标准化的有序出院诊断相关联。评估集的英文翻译支持对齐的跨语言比较。我们的评估方案结合术语归一化和排序感知评分，以分别评估主要诊断识别、参考诊断覆盖率和列表精确率。对 36 个系统的评估表明，更高的主要诊断准确率并不一定意味着相对于出院参考的更高列表精确率。我们还提供了 CardioKG-Agent，这是一个知识增强基线，结合了实体归一化、受约束的图检索和指南证据。在三个基线模型的分阶段比较中，监督微调加该智能体比单独微调获得高 73.5% 的平均综合评分，代表系统级增益。这些结果衡量的是与记录诊断的回顾性一致性；指标排名与医生判断之间的一致性仍有待验证。CardioVascBench 支持诊断优先级排序和知识增强生成的研究。

title: Improving PI-RADS Prediction and Prostate Cancer Detection from Multiparametric MRI with Anatomical Guidance
zh_title: 解剖引导提升mpMRI前列腺PI-RADS预测与癌检出
summary: 预印本比较多架构模型，加入前列腺分区掩膜后PI-RADS预测与临床显著前列腺癌检出均改善。
key_points: 用3D ResNet-18/50与ViT比较多架构
ResNet-18加2分区引导PI-RADS预测QWK为0.511
ResNet-50加5分区引导csPCa检出AUC为0.809
reason: 有新方法，多架构对比且有外部数据集微调；仅预印本，内部大数据集，属值得一看档
abstract: Accurate prediction of Prostate Imaging Reporting and Data System (PI-RADS) scores from multiparametric MRI (mpMRI) remains challenging, more so than clinically significant prostate cancer (csPCa) detection. Given the importance of lesion location in PI-RADS scoring, we evaluated whether incorporating prostate zonal masks improves PI-RADS prediction and csPCa detection across multiple architectures (3D ResNet-18, ResNet-50, and ViT) using a large-scale internal dataset. Anatomical guidance generally improved performance across architectures, with the best results achieved by ResNet-18 with 2-zone guidance for PI-RADS prediction (QWK = 0.511) and ResNet-50 with 5-zone guidance for csPCa detection (AUC = 0.809). Fine-tuned results on external datasets further demonstrated the benefits of anatomical guidance. Furthermore, models with anatomical guidance improved the utility of model-predicted PI-RADS scores for PI-RADS-based csPCa detection (positive defined as PI-RADS>=3). Combining model-predicted and expert-assigned PI-RADS scores significantly increased the AUC from 0.711 to 0.756 (p < 0.05), suggesting that AI-derived PI-RADS scores may provide complementary information to expert assessment for csPCa detection. Overall, our findings highlight the value of incorporating prostate zonal anatomy into deep learning-based prostate MRI assessment.
zh_abstract: 从多参数 MRI（mpMRI）准确预测前列腺影像报告和数据系统（PI-RADS）评分仍然具有挑战性，且比检测临床显著前列腺癌（csPCa）更具挑战性。鉴于病灶位置在 PI-RADS 评分中的重要性，我们使用大规模内部数据集，评估了纳入前列腺分区掩膜是否能在多种架构（3D ResNet-18、ResNet-50 和 ViT）中改善 PI-RADS 预测和 csPCa 检测。解剖学引导总体上改善了各架构的性能，最佳结果分别由采用 2 区引导的 ResNet-18 用于 PI-RADS 预测（QWK = 0.511）和采用 5 区引导的 ResNet-50 用于 csPCa 检测（AUC = 0.809）取得。在外部数据集上的微调结果进一步证明了解剖学引导的益处。此外，采用解剖学引导的模型提高了模型预测 PI-RADS 评分在基于 PI-RADS 的 csPCa 检测中的效用（阳性定义为 PI-RADS>=3）。将模型预测的 PI-RADS 评分与专家分配的 PI-RADS 评分相结合，使 AUC 从 0.711 显著提高到 0.756（p < 0.05），提示 AI 得出的 PI-RADS 评分可能为专家评估提供补充信息，用于 csPCa 检测。总体而言，我们的发现强调了将前列腺分区解剖结构纳入基于深度学习的前列腺 MRI 评估的价值。

title: DiabAgent: Toward Agentic Physiological Control
zh_title: DiabAgent：面向智能体生理控制的模拟器与基准
summary: 预印本提出面向1型糖尿病血糖控制的智能体框架、患者模拟器与评测基准。
key_points: 含APC控制框架、DiabetSim模拟器与SweetBench基准
智能体经医疗器械工具调节血糖
依据饮食、运动、疾病与血糖观测持续调整
reason: 新任务设定加配套模拟器与基准，但仅预印本、尚无临床验证，属值得一看档
abstract: As pretraining scales, medical language models have advanced rapidly in clinical question answering. Their ability to achieve effective physiological control through sustained intervention still lacks systematic quantitative evaluation. Type 1 diabetes provides a concrete setting: impaired insulin secretion creates dependence on exogenous insulin, with dosing continually adjusted using information about meals, exercise, illness, and glucose measurements. We introduce DiabAgent, a research suite for agentic physiological control comprising the Agentic Physiological Control (APC) framework, the DiabetSim simulator, and the SweetBench benchmark. APC controls glucose through medical-device tools, using ongoing observations to infer individual states, accumulate personal experience, and choose treatment actions. We build DiabetSim to simulate different patients, events, and device conditions for scalable virtual testing and training. Using DiabetSim, we construct SweetBench by instantiating 32 scenario designs as 212 glucose-control tasks. With Claude Opus 5.5 and a fixed decision interval of one hour, APC achieves a COGI of 73.5, compared with 71.2 for the open-source closed-loop baseline OpenAPS. Ablations further show that individual adaptation and contextual information improve glucose control. Combining high-frequency rule-based control with lower-frequency agent decisions shows potential for balancing control performance and computational cost. Our work provides a framework, simulator, and evaluation foundation for agents to participate in human physiological control.
zh_abstract: 随着预训练规模扩大，医学语言模型在临床问答方面已迅速进步。其通过持续干预实现有效生理控制的能力仍缺乏系统的定量评估。1 型糖尿病提供了一个具体场景：胰岛素分泌受损导致对外源性胰岛素的依赖，其剂量根据进餐、运动、疾病和血糖测量信息持续调整。我们介绍 DiabAgent，这是一个用于智能体生理控制的研究套件，包括智能体生理控制（APC）框架、DiabetSim 模拟器和 SweetBench 基准。APC 通过医疗设备工具控制血糖，利用持续观察推断个体状态、积累个人经验并选择治疗措施。我们构建 DiabetSim 以模拟不同患者、事件和设备条件，用于可扩展的虚拟测试和训练。使用 DiabetSim，我们通过将 32 个场景设计实例化为 212 个血糖控制任务来构建 SweetBench。在 Claude Opus 5.5 和固定为 1 小时的决策间隔下，APC 达到 73.5 的 COGI，而开源闭环基线 OpenAPS 为 71.2。消融实验进一步表明，个体适应和上下文信息可改善血糖控制。将高频基于规则的控制与低频智能体决策相结合，显示出平衡控制性能与计算成本的潜力。我们的工作为智能体参与人类生理控制提供了框架、模拟器和评估基础。

title: A Novel Conditional Adversarial Diffusion Model for High-Fidelity OCT-to-OCT Image Translation and Precise Anti-VEGF Therapy Response Prediction in Diabetic Macular Edema
zh_title: 条件对抗扩散模型实现OCT转换并预测抗VEGF反应
summary: 提出条件对抗扩散框架，由基线OCT合成治疗后OCT图像，用于预测糖尿病黄斑水肿患者对抗VEGF治疗的早期反应。
key_points: 美国队列127例，受试者级5折交叉验证
并在外部队列进行验证
由合成图像推断个体初始治疗反应
reason: 含外部验证的预印本新方法，但样本量小、无临床结局验证
abstract: Diabetic macular edema (DME) is a leading cause of severe vision loss among working-age adults. Although intravitreal anti-vascular endothelial growth factor (anti-VEGF) injections currently serve as the first-line therapy for DME, a notable subset of patients fails to respond despite the substantial cost and clinical burden, suggesting they may benefit more from alternative interventions. Automated, noninvasive pre-treatment response assessment could therefore spare non-responders from the current trial-and-error treatment paradigm. In this study, we propose a novel conditional adversarial diffusion framework that synthesizes post-treatment optical coherence tomography (OCT) images from baseline scans, enabling the derivation of each patient's initial response to anti-VEGF therapy. The model was developed with subject-level 5-fold cross-validation on a US cohort (n = 127) and externally validated on an independent Iranian cohort (n = 44). Benchmarked against fourteen baseline and state-of-the-art translation models, the proposed model achieved the best treatment-response prediction performance among the methods evaluated for that task on both cohorts, with balanced accuracies of 85.7% and 93.0% on the US cohort and 85.2% and 95.3% on the external Iranian cohort at the 10% and 20% central subfield thickness reduction thresholds, respectively. Ultimately, this framework offers a decision-support tool to help ophthalmologists anticipate initial anti-VEGF outcomes in DME prior to treatment initiation, toward personalized therapy selection. The source code will be made publicly available upon acceptance.
zh_abstract: 糖尿病性黄斑水肿（DME）是工作年龄成年人严重视力丧失的主要原因之一。尽管玻璃体内抗血管内皮生长因子（anti-VEGF）注射目前是DME的一线治疗，但相当一部分患者尽管治疗成本高且临床负担大仍无应答，提示他们可能从替代干预中获益更多。因此，自动化、无创的治疗前应答评估可使无应答者免于当前的试错治疗模式。在本研究中，我们提出一种新型条件对抗扩散框架，可从基线扫描合成治疗后光学相干断层扫描（OCT）图像，从而推导每位患者对抗VEGF治疗的初始应答。该模型在美国队列（n = 127）上采用受试者水平5折交叉验证进行开发，并在独立的伊朗队列（n = 44）上进行外部验证。与14个基线及最先进的转换模型进行基准比较，所提出模型在两个队列中针对该任务评估的方法中取得了最佳的治疗应答预测性能，在美国队列中，在中央子视野厚度降低10%和20%阈值下，平衡准确率分别为85.7%和93.0%；在外部伊朗队列中分别为85.2%和95.3%。最终，该框架提供一种决策支持工具，帮助眼科医生在治疗开始前预判DME中抗VEGF治疗的初始结局，以促进个体化治疗选择。源代码将在论文被接受后公开。

title: iMED: A Multi-Endoscope Dataset for Surgical 3D Perception
zh_title: iMED：用于手术三维感知的多内镜数据集
summary: 预印本发布机器人辅助微创手术多内镜同步数据集，含双独立立体内镜四视角与标定、位姿信息。
key_points: 340段序列、约17万同步时间点、每点4视角
涵盖离体、尸检与活体手术共14个标本
含相机内参、位姿不确定度与器械分割掩码
reason: 规模较大且填补独立视角空白，但为预印本、公开获取情况未明，未达重要档
abstract: We introduce iMED, the first synchronized multi-endoscope dataset for robot-assisted minimally invasive surgery (RAMIS), designed to address a fundamental limitation in surgical vision benchmarking: the absence of independent held-out viewpoints. Existing surgical datasets capture single-trajectory sequences from a single endoscope, making it impossible to distinguish geometric generalization from photometric interpolation along a narrow forward-facing path. iMED provides 340 sequences ~170K synchronized timepoints with 4 views per timepoint) recorded simultaneously from two independent stereo endoscopes across ex vivo, postmortem, and live surgical settings, spanning 14 specimens with diverse anatomical regions and motion regimes. The dataset includes calibrated camera intrinsics, ArUco-based frame-wise pose estimates with uncertainty quantification, instrument segmentation masks, and rich clinical metadata. Using a train-on-one-endoscope, test-on-another evaluation protocol, we benchmark 23 state-of-the-art methods across rigid and deformable novel view synthesis, pose estimation, feature matching, and monocular depth estimation. Our experiments show that methods relying primarily on photometric supervision degrade substantially under this held-out-endoscope setting, while methods with explicit geometric regularization are more robust across views in our benchmark. Notably, large-scale foundation models transfer surprisingly well to surgical imagery, often outperforming domain-specific models, suggesting pitfalls in current fine-tuning protocols. iMED establishes a new evaluation protocol for geometric generalization in surgical vision.
zh_abstract: 我们提出 iMED，这是首个用于机器人辅助微创手术（robot-assisted minimally invasive surgery, RAMIS）的同步多内窥镜数据集，旨在解决手术视觉基准测试中的一个根本性局限：缺乏独立的留出视角。现有手术数据集从单一内窥镜捕获单轨迹序列，因而无法区分几何泛化与沿狭窄前向路径的光度插值。iMED 提供了 340 个序列，约 170K 个同步时间点，每个时间点 4 个视角，由两个独立立体内窥镜在离体（ex vivo）、尸检（postmortem）和活体手术环境中同时记录，涵盖 14 个标本，涉及不同的解剖区域和运动模式。该数据集包括已标定的相机内参、基于 ArUco 的逐帧位姿估计及不确定性量化、器械分割掩码以及丰富的临床元数据。采用在一个内窥镜上训练、在另一个内窥镜上测试的评估协议，我们在刚性及可变形新视角合成、位姿估计、特征匹配和单目深度估计方面对 23 种最先进方法进行了基准测试。我们的实验表明，主要依赖光度监督的方法在这种留出内窥镜设置下性能显著下降，而具有显式几何正则化的方法在我们的基准中跨视角更为稳健。值得注意的是，大规模基础模型向手术影像的迁移效果出奇地好，往往优于领域特定模型，这提示当前微调协议可能存在陷阱。iMED 为手术视觉中的几何泛化建立了新的评估协议。

title: Learning from Unlabeled Photographs for General Oral Image Analysis
zh_title: 基于无标注口腔照片的自监督通用口腔图像分析
summary: 预印本用约53万张无标注口腔照片做域自适应自监督预训练，得到可迁移的口腔视觉编码器DOVE。
key_points: 约53万张无标注口腔照片自监督预训练
5个分类与4个分割数据集上对比3个基线
冻结骨干与端到端微调均评估，少样本迁移占优
reason: 数据规模大、多任务基线对比充分，但为预印本且以内部基准为主
abstract: Oral photographs contain rich clinical information and hold significant potential for artificial intelligence applications; however, most models are trained for individual tasks and rely on costly expert annotations. We hypothesized that self-supervised training on unlabeled oral photographs could produce transferable visual representations for heterogeneous vision tasks. To test this hypothesis, we developed DOVE (Dental Optical Visual Encoder) by domain-adaptive self-supervised pretraining on approximately 530,000 unlabeled oral photographs collected from publicly accessible sources. DOVE was benchmarked against 3 established baselines across 5 classification datasets and 4 segmentation datasets, covering both frozen backbone evaluation and end-to-end finetuning. DOVE achieved the strongest overall performance, ranking best in few-shot transfer and label efficiency on most benchmarks. Under the 20-shot frozen-backbone protocol, DOVE outperformed the second best DINOv3 by 4.37 percentage points in mean macro-F1 across classification datasets and by 4.49 percentage points in mean macro-Dice across segmentation tasks. Under end-to-end finetuning, DOVE achieved at least 80% of the strongest full-data baseline's performance across most evaluation datasets using only 10% of the labeled training data. Qualitative retrieval and feature analyses further indicated better organization of image-level and spatial representations. These findings support DOVE as a generalizable and label-efficient backbone for oral vision research.
zh_abstract: 口腔照片包含丰富的临床信息，在人工智能应用中具有巨大潜力；然而，大多数模型针对单个任务训练，并依赖昂贵的专家标注。我们假设，在未标注口腔照片上进行自监督训练可以产生可迁移的视觉表征，用于异构视觉任务。为检验这一假设，我们通过对从公开可获取来源收集的约 530,000 张未标注口腔照片进行领域自适应自监督预训练，开发了 DOVE（Dental Optical Visual Encoder）。DOVE 在 5 个分类数据集和 4 个分割数据集上与 3 个成熟基线进行了基准比较，涵盖冻结骨干评估和端到端微调。DOVE 取得了最强的总体性能，在多数基准上的少样本迁移和标签效率方面排名最佳。在 20-shot 冻结骨干协议下，DOVE 在分类数据集上的平均 macro-F1 比第二佳的 DINOv3 高出 4.37 个百分点，在分割任务上的平均 macro-Dice 高出 4.49 个百分点。在端到端微调下，DOVE 仅使用 10% 的标注训练数据，在大多数评估数据集上就达到了最强全数据基线性能的至少 80%。定性检索和特征分析进一步表明，其图像级和空间表征组织得更好。这些发现支持 DOVE 作为口腔视觉研究中可泛化且标签高效的骨干模型。

title: Assessment, intervention, and ethical considerations of artificial intelligence for depression and suicide risk: A scoping review.
zh_title: AI用于抑郁与自杀风险的范围综述
summary: 范围综述按评估诊断、对话式AI干预、伦理公平与监管三条轴线系统梳理AI在抑郁与自杀风险中的应用并评估转化成熟度。
key_points: 遵循JBI与PRISMA-ScR，检索2020–2026年六个数据库
筛选5079条记录，最终纳入2844项研究
同时覆盖评估、对话式干预与伦理监管三方面
reason: 大样本范围综述、纳入研究量大，但属综述类，按规则最高6分
abstract: [Psychiatry research] Depression and suicidal behavior constitute leading causes of global disease burden. Artificial intelligence (AI) offers promise for improving detection, intervention, and prevention, yet no comprehensive review has simultaneously mapped AI-driven assessment, intervention, and ethical considerations across both conditions. To systematically map AI applications for depression and suicide risk across three thematic axes: (1) assessment and diagnosis, (2) conversational AI and AI-driven interventions, and (3) ethical, equity, and regulatory considerations, and to evaluate translational maturity using a novel framework. Following JBI scoping review methodology and PRISMA-ScR guidelines, six databases were searched from January 2020 through March 2026. Two independent reviewers screened 5079 records using a two-stage process, yielding 2844 included studies (Cohen's kappa = 0.66). Data were extracted using a standardized charting form with AI-assisted full-text analysis. Assessment/diagnosis dominated (n = 1785), with fewer intervention studies (n = 318). Large language model-related studies rose from <1% (2020-2022) to 11.1% (2025) of included studies annually. Translational Readiness Framework classification revealed 44.8% Laboratory, 49.2% Bridge, and 6.0% Clinical stage, with intervention studies showing the highest Clinical-stage proportion (16.7% vs. 5.9% for assessment). Five cross-cutting observations emerged, including an inverted evidence pyramid and persistent cross-axis integration gap (4.4%). Despite technical advances, the evidence base remains concentrated at early translational stages. The proposed Translational Readiness Framework provides a structured lens for evaluating progress and guiding research prioritization. Closing the gap between laboratory promise and clinical impact requires a shift from model-centric to patient-centric research and from benchmark performance to real-world validation.
zh_abstract: [Psychiatry research] 抑郁症和自杀行为是全球疾病负担的主要原因。人工智能（AI）有望改善检测、干预和预防，但尚无全面综述同时梳理这两种状况下 AI 驱动的评估、干预和伦理考量。为在三个主题轴上系统梳理 AI 在抑郁症和自杀风险中的应用：（1）评估与诊断，（2）对话式 AI 与 AI 驱动干预，（3）伦理、公平与监管考量，并使用一个新框架评估转化成熟度。遵循 JBI 范围综述方法和 PRISMA-ScR 指南，检索了六个数据库，时间范围为 2020 年 1 月至 2026 年 3 月。两名独立评审者采用两阶段流程筛选了 5079 条记录，最终纳入 2844 项研究（Cohen's kappa = 0.66）。使用标准化图表提取表并结合 AI 辅助全文分析提取数据。评估/诊断类研究占主导（n = 1785），干预研究较少（n = 318）。与大型语言模型相关的研究在年度纳入研究中从 <1%（2020-2022 年）上升至 11.1%（2025 年）。转化就绪框架（Translational Readiness Framework）分类显示，44.8% 为实验室阶段、49.2% 为桥接阶段、6.0% 为临床阶段，其中干预研究在临床阶段占比最高（16.7% vs. 评估类 5.9%）。出现了五项横贯性观察，包括倒置的证据金字塔和持续存在的跨轴整合缺口（4.4%）。尽管技术不断进步，证据基础仍集中在早期转化阶段。所提出的转化就绪框架为评估进展和指导研究优先级提供了结构化视角。弥合实验室前景与临床影响之间的差距，需要从以模型为中心的研究转向以患者为中心的研究，并从基准性能转向真实世界验证。

title: Accessed, never disclosed: Silent access to protected health information by medical artificial intelligence agents
zh_title: 医疗AI智能体的患者信息静默访问问题
summary: 预印本用合成病历中的探针发现，部分语言模型智能体会在执行任务时无必要地调用并静默访问患者身份信息。
key_points: 五种模型在无标识任务中调用PHI工具
三款模型存在非必要访问
更严格边界与执行前门控可减少访问
reason: 新颖的隐私审计方法与多模型对比，但为预印本、无临床验证
abstract: Medical artificial intelligence agents should retrieve patient identifiers only when a task requires them, the data-minimization principle behind the HIPAA minimum necessary standard for protected health information (PHI). An agent can retrieve identifiers without revealing them. Such silent access remains invisible to evaluations that inspect only the output. We embedded canaries in synthetic patient records and linked each tool invocation to canary exposure in the final answers across five language models, four boundary levels, and seven attack frames for identifier-free clinical tasks. Three models invoked the PHI tools unnecessarily, whereas Claude Opus 4.8 and GPT-5.5 did not. Stronger boundaries reduced this access, and the residual access under the strictest policy was confined to frames in which the user overrode the policy or asserted approval. A pre-execution gate given the task-necessity criterion nearly eliminated this access. Output-only evaluation cannot verify minimum-necessary access; boundaries, gates, and access-log audits are required together.
zh_abstract: 医疗人工智能代理应仅在任务需要时检索患者标识符，这正是 HIPAA 针对受保护健康信息（protected health information, PHI）的最低必要标准背后的数据最小化原则。代理可以在不泄露标识符的情况下检索它们。这种静默访问对于仅检查输出的评估仍然不可见。我们在合成患者记录中嵌入金丝雀标记（canaries），并在五个语言模型、四个边界级别和七种攻击框架下，针对无标识符临床任务，将每次工具调用与最终答案中的金丝雀暴露相关联。三个模型不必要地调用了 PHI 工具，而 Claude Opus 4.8 和 GPT-5.5 没有。更强的边界减少了这种访问，而在最严格政策下的残余访问仅限于用户覆盖政策或声称已获批准的框架。基于任务必要性标准设置执行前门控几乎消除了这种访问。仅输出评估无法验证最低必要访问；边界、门控和访问日志审计需要共同使用。

title: ECGJev: Question-Conditioned Option Scoring for 12-Lead ECG Interpretation
zh_title: ECGJev：面向12导联心电图解读的问题条件化选项打分
summary: 预印本提出基于决策解码器的心电框架，把波形与频谱特征压缩为16个token，按问题对选项打分。
key_points: 冻结波形与频谱特征压缩为16个ECG token
两阶段适配桥接与低秩适配器
CPSC2018、PTB-XL、Chapman宏F1最高
reason: 多公开基准对比有优势，但为预印本且无外部临床验证，属值得一看档
abstract: Clinical interpretation of a 12-lead electrocardiogram (ECG) often requires answering targeted diagnostic questions with clear, quantifiable decisions. We introduce ECGJev, the first ECG framework built on a decision decoder, a pretrained language model trained to return a probability for every listed option. A question-conditioned bridge compresses frozen waveform and spectrogram features into 16 ECG tokens, and a two-stage procedure adapts the bridge and low-rank adapters on the decoder's native option readout using diagnostic labels alone, scoring all options for a question in one forward pass. Evaluated across four ECG benchmarks, ECGJev achieves the highest macro-F1 on CPSC2018 (80.46%), PTB-XL (71.68%) and Chapman (96.86%), and generalizes competitively to the small-sample PTB cohort. Concept probes and perturbation analyses further show that its predictions rely directly on the ECG input, remain stable under option-order and wording variations, and transfer zero-shot to unseen waveform concepts. Our code is available at https://github.com/zhuoyuanli-lab/ECGJev.
zh_abstract: 12 导联心电图（ECG）的临床解读通常需要以清晰、可量化的决策来回答有针对性的诊断问题。我们提出 ECGJev，这是首个基于决策解码器（decision decoder）构建的 ECG 框架；该解码器是一个预训练语言模型，经训练后可为每个列出的选项返回一个概率。一个以问题为条件的桥接模块（question-conditioned bridge）将冻结的波形和频谱图特征压缩为 16 个 ECG token，并采用两阶段流程，仅使用诊断标签，在解码器原生的选项读出上适配桥接模块和低秩适配器，从而在一次前向传播中为某个问题的所有选项打分。在四个 ECG 基准上评估时，ECGJev 在 CPSC2018（80.46%）、PTB-XL（71.68%）和 Chapman（96.86%）上取得最高 macro-F1，并对小样本 PTB 队列具有有竞争力的泛化能力。概念探针和扰动分析进一步表明，其预测直接依赖于 ECG 输入，在选项顺序和措辞变化下保持稳定，并能零样本（zero-shot）迁移到未见过的波形概念。我们的代码可在 https://github.com/zhuoyuanli-lab/ECGJev 获取。

title: MedHEB: Benchmarking Medical Embeddings Across Heterogeneous Clinical Evidence
zh_title: MedHEB：跨异构临床证据的医学嵌入基准
summary: 发布含 54 个数据集、107 项检索任务的统一基准，从证据形式、配对类型与相关性粒度评估医学嵌入模型。
key_points: 覆盖 2D 图像、3D 体积与文本三类证据形式
包含分布内与留出源数据集两种评测设置
按全局、问题条件、区域级相关性粒度划分任务
reason: 规模较大的多数据集检索基准，但为预印本且未说明权重数据公开情况
abstract: Clinical evidence is inherently relational: medical images are interpreted with prior studies, cross-modal examinations, reports, and localized findings, and retrieving relevant evidence is therefore central to clinical interpretation. Recent foundation models increasingly encode these heterogeneous sources into shared embedding spaces, yet existing embedding evaluation often focuses on isolated matches, leaving unclear whether current models retrieve relevant evidence across changes in modality, appearance, and granularity. We introduce MedHEB, a unified benchmark with 107 retrieval tasks from 54 datasets, including both in-distribution and held-out-source evaluation, across three axes: evidence form (2D images, 3D volumes, text), pairing type (image--image, image--text, text--text, and modality-bridging visual matching), and relevance granularity (global, question-conditioned, region-level). Under a single ranking protocol, MedHEB varies clinically relevant evidence definitions to test whether embedding proximity remains meaningful across heterogeneous evidence, including modality-bridging visual retrieval and region-level text-to-region retrieval. Across representative models, performance is uneven across retrieval families: models strong on conventional image--text or text--text retrieval are less reliable on modality-bridging and region-level tasks. Current embedding spaces capture some clinical relationships well but do not yet provide balanced retrieval across heterogeneous evidence. We further provide MedEmb, an MLLM-based reference embedding model trained on the MedHEB ID split, as a reproducible baseline for unified 2D--3D--text medical retrieval. We release MedHEB with preprocessing scripts, evaluation code, access manifests, and MedEmb to support research on clinically meaningful medical embeddings.
zh_abstract: 临床证据本质上是关系性的：医学图像需结合既往研究、跨模态检查、报告和局部发现来解读，因此检索相关证据对于临床解读至关重要。近期基础模型越来越多地将这些异质来源编码到共享嵌入空间中，但现有嵌入评估常聚焦于孤立匹配，尚不清楚当前模型能否在模态、外观和粒度变化下检索相关证据。我们提出MedHEB，一个统一基准，包含来自54个数据集的107个检索任务，包括分布内和留出来源评估，涵盖三个轴：证据形式（2D图像、3D体数据、文本）、配对类型（图像—图像、图像—文本、文本—文本以及桥接模态的视觉匹配）和相关粒度（全局、问题条件、区域级）。在单一排序协议下，MedHEB改变临床相关证据定义，以测试嵌入邻近性在异质证据间是否仍有意义，包括桥接模态的视觉检索和区域级文本到区域检索。在代表性模型中，不同检索家族的表现不均衡：在传统图像—文本或文本—文本检索上强的模型，在桥接模态和区域级任务上可靠性较低。当前嵌入空间能很好地捕捉某些临床关系，但尚未能在异质证据间提供平衡检索。我们进一步提供MedEmb，一个基于MLLM、在MedHEB ID划分上训练的参考嵌入模型，作为统一2D—3D—文本医学检索的可复现基线。我们发布MedHEB及预处理脚本、评估代码、访问清单和MedEmb，以支持对具有临床意义的医学嵌入的研究。

title: Artificial intelligence-driven pharmacovigilance: transforming signal detection, real-world drug safety monitoring, and regulatory decision-making.
source: PubMed · Expert opinion on drug safety
zh_title: AI驱动的药物警戒：信号检测与监管决策
summary: 综述评估机器学习、深度学习与自然语言处理在不良事件检测、文献挖掘与真实世界药物安全监测中的应用。
key_points: 传统药物警戒受漏报与信号延迟限制
AI用于不良事件检测与信号优先级排序
涉及电子病历与社交媒体数据分析
reason: 一般性综述，无新数据或外部验证，属增量档
abstract: [Expert opinion on drug safety] Pharmacovigilance is undergoing rapid transformation due to the expansion of digital healthcare systems, biomedical data generation, and pharmaceutical innovation. Conventional drug-safety monitoring methods remain limited by underreporting, delayed signal identification, fragmented datasets, and restricted predictive capability. Artificial intelligence (AI) has emerged as a promising approach for improving signal detection, real-world drug-safety surveillance, and regulatory decision-making. This review evaluates application of AI technologies in modern pharmacovigilance and regulatory science. It discusses use of machine learning, deep learning, neural networks, and natural language processing for adverse-event detection, literature mining, signal prioritization, and analysis of electronic health records (EHR) and social-media data. Emerging technologies, including large language models, federated learning, blockchain, digital twins, and Internet of Things (IoT)-enabled monitoring systems, are also explored. Literature was identified through structured searches of MEDLINE/PubMed, Scopus, Web of Science, Embase, and Google Scholar, covering publications from January 2000 to February 2026. AI-driven pharmacovigilance has potential to improve real-time safety surveillance, predictive risk assessment, and automated regulatory workflows. However, broader implementation remains challenged by concerns related to interpretability, data quality, cybersecurity, algorithmic bias, and regulatory validation. Future progress will depend on transparent, explainable, and human-supervised AI systems integrated within globally interoperable healthcare infrastructures.
zh_abstract: [Expert opinion on drug safety] 由于数字医疗系统的扩展、生物医学数据的生成以及制药创新，药物警戒正在经历快速转型。传统药物安全监测方法仍受限于报告不足、信号识别延迟、数据集碎片化以及预测能力有限。人工智能（AI）已成为一种有前景的方法，用于改善信号检测、真实世界药物安全监测和监管决策。本综述评估AI技术在现代药物警戒和监管科学中的应用。它讨论了机器学习、深度学习、神经网络和自然语言处理在不良事件检测、文献挖掘、信号优先级排序以及电子健康记录（EHR）和社交媒体数据分析中的应用。还探讨了新兴技术，包括大语言模型、联邦学习、区块链、数字孪生和物联网（IoT）赋能的监测系统。文献通过MEDLINE/PubMed、Scopus、Web of Science、Embase和Google Scholar的结构化检索确定，涵盖2000年1月至2026年2月的出版物。AI驱动的药物警戒有潜力改善实时安全监测、预测性风险评估和自动化监管工作流程。然而，更广泛的实施仍受到与可解释性、数据质量、网络安全、算法偏差和监管验证相关的担忧的挑战。未来的进展将取决于整合在全球可互操作医疗基础设施中的透明、可解释且有人工监督的AI系统。

title: Artificial Intelligence in Laryngology: Applications for Voice, Swallowing, and Endoscopic Assessment.
source: PubMed · ORL-head and neck nursing : official journal of the Society of Otorhinolaryngology and Head-Neck Nurses
zh_title: 喉科学中的人工智能：嗓音、吞咽与内镜评估应用
summary: 叙述性综述介绍AI在喉科学嗓音、吞咽与内镜评估中的应用及对耳鼻喉护理团队的实施意义。
key_points: 聚焦嗓音障碍与吞咽困难的AI应用
涵盖护理、言语治疗与外科实践视角

abstract: [ORL-head and neck nursing : official journal of the Society of Otorhinolaryngology and Head-Neck Nurses] Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly integrated into otolaryngology-head and neck care, with rapid growth in laryngology due to its reliance on voice analysis, endoscopic imaging, and swallowing assessment. As AI tools move into routine practice, otolaryngology teams play a key role in ensuring ethical, effective, and patient-centered implementation. To describe current and emerging applications of AI in laryngology with direct relevance to otolaryngology-head and neck care. A narrative review of the peer-reviewed literature was conducted, focusing on clinically relevant and investigational AI applications in laryngology care. Areas of emphasis included voice disorders and dysphagia, with attention to nursing, speech language pathology, and surgical practice. AI applications in laryngology care span multiple domains, including automated voice analysis for screening and monitoring, AI-assisted interpretation of laryngoscopy and swallowing studies, noninvasive dysphagia screening using sound or wearable sensors, and tools to support documentation and clinical triage. Collectively, these technologies can improve diagnostic consistency, support earlier identification of complications, and enhance longitudinal monitoring across care settings. Effective integration of AI into laryngeal care requires coordinated team engagement in data analysis, patient education, and clinical decision support. Understanding AI capabilities and limitations is essential for improving care while mitigating bias and supporting efficient workflows. AI-enabled technologies have expanded data-driven laryngology care across voice, swallowing, and endoscopic evaluation. Successful adoption depends on data quality, performance, and workflow integration. Interdisciplinary collaboration and ongoing evaluation of safety and equity can enhance the quality and consistency of laryngeal care.

abstract: [Brain research bulletin] Electroencephalography (EEG) remains important in clinical neuroscience because it records brain activity as a time-resolved physiological process. It offers millisecond temporal resolution, can be used at the bedside and supports prolonged monitoring. Artificial intelligence (AI) has expanded EEG analysis through automated pattern recognition, representation learning, large-scale screening and decision support in epilepsy, sleep medicine, cognitive disorders, psychiatric conditions, intensive care, disorders of consciousness and anaesthesia monitoring. High classification accuracy in a research dataset, however, is not clinical readiness. EEG signals are shaped by physiological state, artefacts, acquisition systems, preprocessing choices and clinical context. Labels may come from expert annotations, diagnostic categories, behavioural scales, treatment responses or long-term outcomes, and these sources do not always define the same biological target. This review argues that EEG-AI translation should be judged by the strength of its evidence, not by technical performance alone. We examine why EEG is valuable yet hard to standardize, how EEG features can serve as candidate biomarkers, and why translational maturity differs across clinical scenarios. We then discuss the evidence gaps behind high-performing models, focusing on target validity, data leakage, confounding, external validation and clinically aligned metrics. Finally, we argue for clinical understandability rather than model interpretability alone, and for human-machine workflows rather than isolated classifiers. Future EEG-AI systems should be assessed by whether their outputs are biologically plausible, externally generalizable, understandable to clinicians and safe in real-world care.

abstract: [NPP - digital psychiatry and neuroscience] Language disturbances are prominent across psychiatric disorders, yet their underlying organization and relationship to clinical functioning remain poorly understood. We conceptualized spontaneous speech as a temporally evolving sequence of contextual representations through semantic space, in which successive concepts define transitions between large-language-model embeddings. We characterized the local dynamics of these representations using Lyapunov-inspired measures of sensitivity to perturbation and anisotropy-the extent to which nearby neighboring contextual representations diverge differently depending on direction in representational space. We applied this approach to picture descriptions from 129 German-speaking participants with major depressive disorder (n = 43), schizophrenia spectrum disorders (n = 42), or no psychiatric diagnosis (n = 44). Individual differences in local geometric dynamics predicted multiple clinical dimensions, with the strongest association observed for global functioning, for which the geometric measures explained 51% of the variance. Clinically informative geometric structure was already detectable within the first three sentences of speech, where distinct dynamical profiles were associated with differences in negative and positive symptoms, anxiety, depression, and global functioning. These associations suggest that the dynamics of local representational divergence and contraction during speech reflect broad variation in cognitive and social functioning rather than diagnosis alone. Together, these findings suggest that psychiatric variation is reflected not simply in what people say, but in the dynamics by which semantic representations evolve during ongoing language production. A dynamical-geometric analysis of language may provide a compact, transdiagnostic marker of clinically meaningful variation in psychopathology.

abstract: [Journal of ophthalmology] Artificial intelligence (AI) is being investigated across the cataract care pathway, but the maturity of the evidence varies substantially between technical benchmark studies, externally validated models, prospective clinical evaluations and tools used in routine care. This narrative review critically summarises AI applications in cataract detection, intraocular lens (IOL) power calculation, perioperative risk assessment, intraoperative support and postoperative follow-up, with particular emphasis on evidence quality, external validity and clinical readiness. A structured search of PubMed/MEDLINE was conducted for English-language publications from 1 January 2018 through 31 March 2025, with selective retention of earlier seminal studies relevant to cataract risk prediction, force feedback and ophthalmic robotics. Evidence was classified by maturity, from technical proof of concept and retrospective internal validation to external or multicentre validation, prospective clinical evaluation and demonstrated workflow or patient-level benefit. The strongest evidence for cataract detection comes from large externally validated image-based models, whereas smartphone systems remain sensitive to image quality, case mix and deployment setting. Data-driven IOL formulas can improve refractive prediction in selected datasets, but comparisons are affected by constant optimisation, axial-length distribution, IOL model, measurement device and paired-eye dependence. Intraoperative AI remains dominated by phase recognition, segmentation and technical performance assessment, with limited evidence of direct clinical benefit. Postoperative conversational AI has reached multicentre prospective clinical evaluation, although safety depends on escalation pathways, human oversight and local workflow design. Clinical translation of AI in cataract care is therefore emerging but uneven: a limited number of applications have reached external or prospective clinical validation, while many remain retrospective or technical proof-of-concept systems. Future adoption should be based on external validation, transparent reporting, prospective clinical utility, postdeployment monitoring and clear regulatory and medicolegal accountability rather than benchmark performance alone.

abstract: [International journal of medical informatics] Robot-assisted minimally invasive surgery requires specific skills of the surgeon beyond the mastery of conventional laparoscopic techniques. However, efficient and objective methods for evaluating these skills remain limited. Artificial intelligence (AI) offers potential for a more objective, video-based performance assessment. This systematic review aims to evaluate the current evidence of using AI for evaluation of surgical skill in real robotic surgery and outline potential avenues for future research. We systematically searched Ovid Medline, Embase, Clarivate Web of Science, ERIC Institute of Education Sciences and Scopus databases from inception to 10 July 2025, for studies evaluating AI-based technical skill assessment using videos of robot-assisted surgery performed on real patients. Study characteristics, AI approaches, assessment targets, reference standards, and model performance were extracted. Risk of bias and applicability were assessed using PROBAST + AI. Owing to differences in assessment constructs and reported performance measures, findings were synthesised using a structured narrative approach. In total, 2116 articles were identified, of which 5 met our eligibility criteria. AI approaches and assessment targets varied substantially across studies, including prediction of global technical skill scores, analysis of instrument-derived performance metrics, procedure-specific assessment, and surgical error detection. Reference standards included OSATS, GEARS or modified GEARS, PLACE, and procedural experience. Reported performance measures represented different constructs and were not directly comparable across studies. PROBAST + AI identified important methodological limitations, and no study reported external validation using an independent dataset. AI shows potential for video-based technical skill assessment in real robotic surgery, but current evidence is limited and heterogeneous. Future research should prioritise standardised annotation, multicentre intraoperative datasets, and external validation to support reliable translation into clinical practice.
zh_abstract: [International Journal of Medical Informatics] 机器人辅助微创手术要求外科医生具备超出常规腹腔镜技术掌握范围的特定技能。然而，用于评估这些技能的高效且客观的方法仍然有限。人工智能（AI）为更客观、基于视频的技能表现评估提供了潜力。本系统综述旨在评估在真实机器人手术中使用 AI 评估外科技能的当前证据，并概述未来研究的潜在方向。我们系统检索了 Ovid Medline、Embase、Clarivate Web of Science、ERIC Institute of Education Sciences 和 Scopus 数据库，检索时间从建库至 2025 年 7 月 10 日，纳入使用在真实患者身上实施的机器人辅助手术视频进行基于 AI 的技术技能评估的研究。提取了研究特征、AI 方法、评估目标、参考标准和模型性能。使用 PROBAST + AI 评估偏倚风险和适用性。由于评估构建和报告的性能指标存在差异，采用结构化叙述方法对发现进行综合。共识别出 2116 篇文章，其中 5 篇符合我们的纳入标准。各研究中的 AI 方法和评估目标差异很大，包括预测整体技术技能评分、分析器械衍生的性能指标、手术特异性评估以及手术错误检测。参考标准包括 OSATS、GEARS 或改良 GEARS、PLACE 以及手术经验。报告的性能指标代表不同的构建，且在各研究之间不能直接比较。PROBAST + AI 识别出重要的方法学局限性，且没有研究报告使用独立数据集进行外部验证。AI 在真实机器人手术中基于视频的技术技能评估方面显示出潜力，但当前证据有限且异质。未来研究应优先考虑标准化标注、多中心术中数据集和外部验证，以支持可靠地转化为临床实践。
