abstract: Extracting meaningful biological patterns from microscopy image datasets requires tools that quantitatively connect visual similarities and experimental context. Deep learning models, and in particular novel foundation models, have the capacity to translate images into high-dimensional embeddings that can better represent complex visual patterns. Using these complex representations analytically and linking them to experimental information, it is possible to build advanced exploratory and phenotyping capabilities. Here, we present PhenoMe, an open-source, model-agnostic framework to handle pretrained foundation model-derived image representations alongside quantitative image properties and experimental metadata. PhenoMe integrates multiple scriptable and interactive workflows for embedding space visualisation, dimensionality reduction and clustering, similarity-based comparison and retrieval of representative images for each phenotype, among others. It also supports correlation analyses that link the embedding structure to interpretable image properties. We demonstrate PhenoMe's capabilities on seven public microscopy datasets, ranging from cell painting assays, nanoscale synaptic images, drug-response analyses and dynamic cell-phenotyping. These case studies show how readily available image representations can support data contextualisation, curation and analysis. Through guided notebooks, reproducible configurations, extensible model wrappers and a napari plugin, PhenoMe makes representation-based microscopy exploration accessible to researchers without dedicated technical expertise. PhenoMe lays the groundwork for applying foundation models and representation learning to microscopy data analysis.
zh_abstract: 从显微图像数据集中提取有意义的生物学模式，需要能够定量连接视觉相似性与实验背景的工具。深度学习模型，尤其是新型基础模型，有能力将图像转化为高维嵌入，从而更好地表示复杂视觉模式。以分析方式使用这些复杂表示并将其与实验信息关联，可以构建先进的探索性和表型分析能力。在此，我们提出 PhenoMe，一个开源、模型无关的框架，用于处理预训练基础模型衍生的图像表示以及定量图像属性和实验元数据。PhenoMe 集成了多个可脚本化和交互式工作流，用于嵌入空间可视化、降维和聚类、基于相似性的比较和检索各表型的代表性图像等。它还支持将嵌入结构与可解释图像属性关联的相关性分析。我们在七个公共显微数据集上展示 PhenoMe 的能力，范围从 Cell Painting 测定、纳米尺度突触图像、药物反应分析到动态细胞表型分析。这些案例研究显示现成可用的图像表示如何支持数据情境化、整理和分析。通过引导式 notebook、可复现配置、可扩展模型封装器和 napari 插件，PhenoMe 使没有专门技术专长的研究人员也能开展基于表示的显微探索。PhenoMe 为将基础模型和表示学习应用于显微数据分析奠定基础。

title: Rethinking Next-Visit Diagnosis Prediction Beyond Aggregate Metrics: Retrieval--Memory Multi-Agent Adjudication
zh_title: 下次就诊诊断预测的多维评估与多智能体裁决
summary: 预印本从分布、时间与病史深度多维度评估下次就诊诊断预测，并比较多智能体等方法。
key_points: 构建区分持续、新发、复发诊断的评估框架
重复上次就诊基线总体优于多数LLM方法
检索与记忆方法优势随病史深度变化
reason: 预印本有新评估视角与基线对比，未经同行评审且证据有限
abstract: Next-visit diagnosis prediction forecasts the diagnoses documented at a patient's next encounter, turning retrospective electronic health records into prospective clinical prediction. However, conventional aggregate evaluation obscures its multifaceted nature: distributionally, models must handle variable-size diagnosis sets and long-tailed labels; temporally, they must distinguish persistent, newly recorded, and recurrent diagnoses; and both vary with observed history depth. We introduce an evaluation framework along these dimensions and apply it to rule-based heuristics, LLM-based prompting, retrieval, memory, and multi-agent approaches. This reveals that repeating the last visit outperforms most LLM-based approaches overall despite predicting no new or recurrent diagnoses, and that retrieval and memory exhibit distinct profiles whose relative strengths vary across temporal transitions and backbones. Motivated by this, we propose LONGINUS, a retrieval-memory multi-agent adjudication framework combining evidence retrieved from patient records with structured memory of the patient trajectory. Using cross-view agreement as a reliability heuristic, it preserves shared predictions and adjudicates disagreements without revealing their source. Across MIMIC-III and MIMIC-IV with four LLM backbones, LONGINUS achieves the best transition-specific performance among LLM-based methods in nearly all settings while remaining competitive with them on aggregate metrics.
zh_abstract: 下次就诊诊断预测预测患者下一次就诊时记录的诊断，将回顾性电子健康记录转化为前瞻性临床预测。然而，传统聚合评估掩盖了其多面性：在分布层面，模型必须处理可变大小的诊断集合和长尾标签；在时间层面，模型必须区分持续性诊断、新记录诊断和复发性诊断；而这两者都会随观察到的病史深度而变化。我们引入一个沿这些维度的评估框架，并将其应用于基于规则的启发式方法、基于 LLM 的提示、检索、记忆和多智能体方法。这揭示出，尽管重复上次就诊不预测任何新发或复发性诊断，但它在总体上优于大多数基于 LLM 的方法；并且检索和记忆表现出不同的特征轮廓，其相对优势随不同时间转变和主干模型而变化。受此启发，我们提出 LONGINUS，一个检索-记忆多智能体裁决框架，将从患者记录中检索到的证据与患者轨迹的结构化记忆相结合。使用跨视图一致性作为可靠性启发式，它保留共享预测，并在不揭示分歧来源的情况下裁决分歧。在 MIMIC-III 和 MIMIC-IV 上，使用四个 LLM 主干模型，LONGINUS 在几乎所有设置中都在基于 LLM 的方法中取得最佳的转变特异性性能，同时在聚合指标上与其保持竞争力。

title: Temporal Island Sparse Autoencoders for Interpreting Clinical Time-Series Models
zh_title: 时序岛稀疏自编码器解释临床时序模型
summary: 预印本提出TI-SAE，从冻结的EHR预测模型中学习可复用临床概念字典以解释预测。
key_points: 用时间高斯岛与稀疏变量向量定义概念
解耦选择器分离表征学习与归因
在五个骨干模型上评估
reason: 预印本新方法且有基线对比，未提及外部验证或开源
abstract: Deep learning models for electronic health records achieve strong predictive performance but provide little insight into what clinical concepts they represent internally. Post-hoc attribution methods produce per-cell importance scores that lack temporal coherence, cross-variable structure, and reusability across patients. We introduce the Temporal Island Sparse Autoencoder (TI-SAE), which learns a backbone-specific, patient-shared clinical concept dictionary from a frozen predictive model's representations. Each dictionary entry (latent) is defined by learned temporal Gaussian islands (specifying when the concept is active) and a sparse variable-composition vector (specifying which variables are involved). A decoupled selector then identifies which dictionary entries drive each patient's prediction, separating representation learning from attribution. We evaluate TI-SAE across five backbone architectures spanning different representation strategies on MIMIC-III and MIMIC-IV (three prediction tasks each). TI-SAE produces structured clinical concepts that go beyond transient attribution heatmaps while achieving strong performance on standard faithfulness benchmarks.
zh_abstract: 用于电子健康记录的深度学习模型具有强大的预测性能，但对其内部代表哪些临床概念提供了很少的洞察。事后归因方法产生每个数据单元的重要性评分，这些评分缺乏时间连贯性、跨变量结构以及跨患者可重用性。我们引入时间岛稀疏自编码器（Temporal Island Sparse Autoencoder, TI-SAE），它从冻结预测模型的表示中学习骨干模型特异性、患者共享的临床概念字典。每个字典条目（潜在项）由学习到的时间高斯岛（指定概念何时活跃）和稀疏变量组成向量（指定涉及哪些变量）定义。随后，解耦选择器识别哪些字典条目驱动每位患者的预测，将表示学习与归因分离。我们在MIMIC-III和MIMIC-IV上（各三项预测任务）评估TI-SAE，涵盖五种不同表示策略的骨干架构。TI-SAE产生结构化临床概念，超越瞬态归因热图，同时在标准忠实性基准上取得强大性能。

title: BioResearchBench: 50 Long Horizon Biological Research Tasks
zh_title: BioResearchBench生物学研究基准
summary: 发布含50个长程生物学研究任务的基准，覆盖10个子领域并评测多款模型。
key_points: 由生物学博士设计并经过专家复核
涵盖测序、蛋白、显微图像与临床数据
在多个前沿模型上比较任务表现
reason: 专家设计的多任务基准，但为预印本且任务规模有限，属值得一看档。
abstract: AI models are used in biology research to study disease mechanisms, discover potential treatments, analyze experimental data, troubleshoot problems, and plan next steps. Useful assistance depends on working with data in various scientific formats, interpreting results, and deciding what to test next. We present BioResearchBench, a benchmark of 50 research questions developed by PhD biologists drawing on their deep research expertise to reflect realistic problems encountered in their fields. Questions were refined through expert review and iterative model testing. The collection spans 10 diverse biology subdomains and includes sequencing data, proteomic measurements, microscopy images, assay readouts, and clinical datasets. We compared recorded outcomes and examined model responses in depth across the 50 tasks on OpenAI GPT-6 Astra, Claude Opus 5.5, Gemini 4 Argon, Meta Muse Wonder, and SpaceXSI Grok 4.7. Success across our benchmark was 18% for Claude Opus 5.5, 13% for Gemini 4 Argon, 11% for Meta Muse Wonder, 4% for GPT-6 Astra, and 4% for Grok 4.7. These results describe a deliberately challenging collection selected through expert review and model testing. Despite low whole task success, the selected responses met most rubric requirements on average: the average fraction of criteria missed ranged from 18% to 32% across models. Across models, the proportion of eligible tasks with at least one category failure was highest in computation and data handling (66.9% failure), followed by uncertainty and identification (55.3% failure), reporting and completeness (54.7% failure), biological interpretation (39.0% failure), controls and causal claims (37.2% failure), and choosing the next experiment or decision (31.0% failure). Gemini 4 Argon had the highest proportion of reviewed tasks without a recorded category failure in computation and data handling (45% success) and biological interpretation (69% success). Claude Opus 5.5 led in controls and causal claims (72% success) and choosing the next experiment or decision (75% success). GPT-6 Astra led in uncertainty and identification (56% success) which included judging the precision of estimates and recognizing when measurements could not distinguish between biological explanations. GPT-6 Astra and Meta Muse Wonder tied for the highest proportion of answers with no recorded omissions or reporting failures (51% success). Five case studies presented here show how top AI models can perform many analytical steps corre
zh_abstract: AI 模型被用于生物学研究，以研究疾病机制、发现潜在治疗方法、分析实验数据、排查问题并规划下一步。有用的辅助取决于能否处理各种科学格式的数据、解释结果并决定下一步测试什么。我们提出 BioResearchBench，这是一个由生物学博士基于其深厚研究专长开发的包含 50 个研究问题的基准，旨在反映其领域内遇到的现实问题。问题经过专家评审和迭代模型测试得以完善。该集合涵盖 10 个多样化的生物学子领域，包括测序数据、蛋白质组测量、显微图像、检测读数以及临床数据集。我们在 OpenAI GPT-6 Astra、Claude Opus 5.5、Gemini 4 Argon、Meta Muse Wonder 和 SpaceXSI Grok 4.7 上比较了记录的结果，并深入检查了模型在 50 项任务中的回答。在我们的基准上，Claude Opus 5.5 的成功率为 18%，Gemini 4 Argon 为 13%，Meta Muse Wonder 为 11%，GPT-6 Astra 为 4%，Grok 4.7 为 4%。这些结果描述了一个通过专家评审和模型测试选出的、刻意具有挑战性的集合。尽管整体任务成功率较低，所选回答平均满足了大多数评分标准要求：各模型遗漏标准的平均比例范围为 18% 至 32%。在各模型中，符合条件任务中至少有一个类别失败的比例最高的是计算与数据处理（66.9% 失败），其次是不确定性与识别（55.3% 失败）、报告与完整性（54.7% 失败）、生物学解释（39.0% 失败）、对照与因果主张（37.2% 失败），以及选择下一个实验或决策（31.0% 失败）。Gemini 4 Argon 在计算与数据处理（45% 成功）和生物学解释（69% 成功）方面，经审查任务中无记录类别失败的比例最高。Claude Opus 5.5 在对照与因果主张（72% 成功）以及选择下一个实验或决策（75% 成功）方面领先。GPT-6 Astra 在不确定性与识别（56% 成功）方面领先，该类别包括判断估计的精确性以及识别测量何时无法区分不同生物学解释。GPT-6 Astra 和 Meta Muse Wonder 并列无记录遗漏或报告失败的答案比例最高（51% 成功）。本文呈现的五个案例研究展示了顶级 AI 模型如何能够执行许多分析步骤 corre

title: Unsupervised prioritization of gene-regulatory variants with isolation forests
zh_title: 隔离森林无监督优先排序基因调控变异
summary: 预印本提出基于隔离森林的无监督机器学习方法，对基因调控变异进行优先级排序。
key_points: 面向非编码区eQTL与GWAS位点
采用隔离森林的无监督方案
针对深度学习多评分问题
reason: 有新方法的预印本，证据与验证信息有限，属值得一看档
abstract: Most common variants occur in non-coding genomic regions. Numerous expression quantitative trait loci (eQTLs) can influence nearby gene expression. Across diverse traits and diseases, many genome-wide association study (GWAS) loci have been shown to colocalize with eQTLs, supporting gene-regulatory causal mechanisms. However, linkage disequilibrium (LD) obscures the identification of the causal variant(s), necessitating prioritization by functional annotations. Previously published variant prioritization tools relied on the machine-learning-based combination of diverse feature types like evolutionary conservation and chromatin information, whereas more recent deep learning tools learn and describe gene-regulatory DNA sequence grammar. However, the latter approaches often generate a large number of scores per variant. We designed a novel unsupervised machine-learning approach based on isolation forests to integrate the predictions from the broadly used Enformer deep learning model into a single gene-regulatory predictive score for each common variant. Our novel approach eQTL prediction with isolation forests (eQIF) demonstrates strong performance in predicting eQTLs and gene-regulatory GWAS variants. We show that top eQIF variants are located in evolutionarily conserved transcription factor binding site (TFBS) footprints, and that the frequency of top eQIF variants within overrepresented TFBS motifs recapitulates the motif information content. eQIF predictions are precomputed for 9,431,969 common variants and publicly available.
zh_abstract: 大多数变异出现在非编码基因组区域。众多表达数量性状基因座（expression quantitative trait loci，eQTL）可影响邻近基因的表达。在多种性状和疾病中，许多全基因组关联研究（genome-wide association study，GWAS）位点已被证明与 eQTL 共定位，支持基因调控性因果机制。然而，连锁不平衡（linkage disequilibrium，LD）掩盖了因果变异的识别，因而需要借助功能注释进行优先级排序。此前发表的变异优先级排序工具依赖于基于机器学习的多种特征类型（如进化保守性和染色质信息）的组合，而较新的深度学习工具则学习并描述基因调控性 DNA 序列语法。然而，后一类方法通常为每个变异生成大量评分。我们设计了一种基于孤立森林（isolation forests）的新型无监督机器学习方法，将广泛使用的 Enformer 深度学习模型的预测整合为每个常见变异的单一基因调控性预测评分。我们这种基于孤立森林的 eQTL 预测新方法（eQTL prediction with isolation forests，eQIF）在预测 eQTL 和基因调控性 GWAS 变异方面表现强劲。我们表明，eQIF 评分最高的变异位于进化上保守的转录因子结合位点（transcription factor binding site，TFBS）足迹中，且这些高评分 eQIF 变异在过代表 TFBS 基序中出现的频率可重现基序的信息含量。eQIF 预测已对 9,431,969 个常见变异预先计算并可公开获取。

title: DEEPNET-LLM: Highly accurate structure prediction of unknown metabolites from mass spectra via their molecular neighborhoods
zh_title: DEEPNET-LLM：基于分子邻域从质谱预测未知代谢物结构
summary: 预印本提出结合分子社区网络与LLM推理的方法，将谱图搜索限制在代谢组局部邻域，以提升未知代谢物从头结构预测。
key_points: 针对未注释的质谱“暗物质”，其占比超过90%
用分子社区网络把候选搜索限制在局部邻域
以AI推理从邻域结构传播信息，预测未知物结构
指出现有方法很少将正确结构列为第一预测
reason: 有新意的预印本方法，问题意义明确但仅见方法描述，缺乏独立评测细节，属值得一看档。
abstract: Most molecular features detected by untargeted mass spectrometry-based metabolomics remain unannotated. This so-called 'dark matter' currently comprises more than 90% and likely holds uncharacterized bioactive chemistry. Structure prediction from fragmentation spectra remains an outstanding challenge, because a spectrum does not uniquely determine a structure and the space of candidate structures is mostly unbounded; correspondingly, existing methods rarely return the correct de novo structure as their top prediction. Here we describe De novo Ego network-Enabled Propagation and Neighborhood Extrapolation of Topology using Large Language Models (DEEPNET-LLM) reasoning approach, which uses Molecular Community Networking (MCN) to restrict the search of a query spectrum to its local neighborhood within the global metabolome, and applies AI reasoning to propagate structural information from neighbors to the query. For a collection of 900 authentic standards (2,249 spectra) that have never been publicly released to exclude possibility of data leakage, DEEPNET-LLM returned the correct structure as its top prediction for 84.7% of spectra. Accuracy was independent of precursor mass across a range over which the number of candidate structures grows by 30 orders of magnitude, and was comparable across ion polarity, adducts and in-source fragmentation. On a random subset of the public MassSpecGym benchmark, DEEPNET-LLM reached 85.9% top-1 accuracy excluding stereochemistry. We showcase the use of DEEPNET-LLM with an example of a discovery of tryptamine amidate of a bile acid in mouse gut, confirmed against a synthetic standard. The DEEPNET-LLM approach is orthogonal to existing in silico methods and can be combined with them.
zh_abstract: 通过非靶向质谱代谢组学检测到的大多数分子特征仍未被注释。这种所谓的“暗物质”目前占 90% 以上，很可能包含尚未表征的生物活性化学物质。从碎片谱预测结构仍是一项突出挑战，因为一张谱图并不能唯一确定一个结构，且候选结构空间基本无界；相应地，现有方法很少能将正确的从头（de novo）结构作为其最高预测返回。在此，我们描述一种基于大语言模型（Large Language Models）的 De novo Ego 网络启用的拓扑传播与邻域外推推理方法（De novo Ego network-Enabled Propagation and Neighborhood Extrapolation of Topology using Large Language Models，DEEPNET-LLM），该方法利用分子社区网络（Molecular Community Networking，MCN）将查询谱的搜索限制在全球代谢组内其局部邻域中，并应用 AI 推理将结构信息从邻居传播至查询对象。对于一组从未公开发布、以排除数据泄漏可能性的 900 个真实标准品（2,249 张谱图），DEEPNET-LLM 对 84.7% 的谱图将正确结构作为其最高预测返回。在候选结构数量增长达 30 个数量级的范围内，准确率与前体质量无关，并且在离子极性、加合物和源内碎裂之间具有可比性。在公开 MassSpecGym 基准的随机子集上，排除立体化学后，DEEPNET-LLM 达到 85.9% 的 top-1 准确率。我们通过一个在小鼠肠道中发现胆汁酸的色胺酰胺（tryptamine amidate）并用合成标准品确认的示例，展示了 DEEPNET-LLM 的用途。DEEPNET-LLM 方法与现有的计算机模拟（in silico）方法正交，并可与它们结合使用。

title: ScienceVision: Can AI Observe and Reason Like a Scientist?
zh_title: ScienceVision：科学三维数据理解与推理基准
summary: 预印本提出跨学科三维科学数据VQA基准，共250题，覆盖生物、化学、医学影像、机械CAD与建筑，并经领域专家审核。
key_points: 每个学科50题，共250道专家级视觉问答
原生3D数据配对，考察结构与空间关系理解
合成生成加专家标注审核的构建流程
reason: 新公开跨域3D基准含医学影像，但题量仅250，属有一定关注度的基准档。
abstract: Scientific discovery builds on accurate observations interpreted through domain knowledge and reasoning. For scientific 3D data, this requires understanding structures and spatial relationships, from protein contacts to anatomical organization. Existing multimodal benchmarks largely evaluate text and 2D images, while scientific 3D evaluations vary in representations and protocols across disciplines, limiting cross-disciplinary comparison. To assess these foundational capabilities, we introduce ScienceVision, a cross-domain benchmark for scientific 3D understanding and reasoning through expert-level visual question answering (VQA). We construct 250 questions, with 50 each from Biology, Chemistry, Medical Imaging, Mechanical CAD, and Architecture, through a pipeline combining synthetic question generation with domain-expert review and annotation. Each task pairs a native 3D artifact with a scientific question, a specified response format, and a task-specific reference answer, requiring domain knowledge to be applied to geometric or topological evidence. We evaluate 12 models on the same questions in three settings: visual question answering with native 3D artifacts accessed through an agent harness's file and code-execution tools; the same workflow augmented with expert-inspired viewer inspection and measurement tools exposed through the Model Context Protocol (MCP); and visual question answering from prescribed rendered 2D images using an agent harness. All settings use the same task-specific deterministic final-answer scoring. The inspection environment supports view changes, target isolation, and slice inspection. In this main comparison, the best mean answer score is 0.53 out of 1. Mean scores in the native-artifact workflow without additional MCP tools exceed those in the rendered-image workflow for every model, by 17.2 percentage points on average.
zh_abstract: 科学发现建立在通过领域知识与推理加以解读的准确观察之上。对于科学 3D 数据，这需要理解结构与空间关系，从蛋白质接触到解剖学组织方式。现有多模态基准主要评估文本和 2D 图像，而科学 3D 评估在各学科间的表示方式和协议各不相同，限制了跨学科比较。为评估这些基础能力，我们引入 ScienceVision，这是一个通过专家级视觉问答（visual question answering，VQA）进行科学 3D 理解与推理的跨领域基准。我们通过将合成问题生成与领域专家审阅和标注相结合的流水线构建了 250 个问题，其中生物学、化学、医学影像、机械 CAD 和建筑学各 50 个。每项任务将一个原生 3D 制品与一个科学问题、指定的回答格式以及任务特定参考答案配对，要求将领域知识应用于几何或拓扑证据。我们在三种设置下用相同问题评估了 12 个模型：通过智能体框架（agent harness）的文件与代码执行工具访问原生 3D 制品的视觉问答；在相同工作流基础上，通过模型上下文协议（Model Context Protocol，MCP）暴露的、受专家启发的查看器检查与测量工具进行增强；以及使用智能体框架从规定的渲染 2D 图像进行视觉问答。所有设置均使用相同的任务特定确定性最终答案评分。该检查环境支持视角变更、目标隔离和切片检查。在这一主要比较中，最佳平均答案得分为 0.53（满分 1）。对于每个模型，无额外 MCP 工具的原生制品工作流的平均得分均超过渲染图像工作流，平均高出 17.2 个百分点。

title: DUNEDepth: Bronchoscopic Depth and Pose Estimation via Hybrid Adaptation of a 3D-Vision Foundation Model
zh_title: DUNEDepth：支气管镜深度与位姿估计
summary: 基于3D视觉基础模型的混合架构，从支气管镜视频估计深度与相机运动，以对齐术前胸部CT。
key_points: 融合DUNE ViT编码器与孪生MASt3R交叉注意力解码器
采用合成监督与自监督混合的微调策略
目标是把气道检查视频与术前CT建立对应
reason: 有新方法的预印本，摘要未给出外部验证或临床结局，属值得一看档
abstract: State-of-the-art bronchoscopy guidance systems and computer-aided diagnosis methods have emerged as important tools for early lung cancer detection. Effective use of these tools depends on being able to accurately link a patient's bronchoscopic airway exam video to their pre-operative 3D chest CT scan. Unfortunately, the derivation of such links, which include bronchoscope depth and camera motion, from the exam video remains an open problem. Building on recently proposed 3D-vision foundation models, we propose DUNEDepth, a hybrid architecture that combines a shared DUNE ViT encoder, a twin MASt3R cross-attention decoder structure, and a prediction head that includes elements of the MASt3R and Reloc3r models. To fine-tune the architecture to our application, we utilize an integrated hybrid synthetic-supervised/self-supervised training strategy that draws on both bronchoscopic video and CT-derived virtual bronchoscopic views. Experiments drawing on bronchoscopic video sequences demonstrate that DUNEDepth more accurately derives depth information and camera motion trajectories than previously proposed self-supervised methods.
zh_abstract: 最先进的支气管镜导航系统和计算机辅助诊断方法已成为早期肺癌检测的重要工具。这些工具的有效使用取决于能否将患者的支气管镜气道检查视频与其术前三维胸部 CT 扫描准确关联。遗憾的是，从检查视频中推导此类关联（包括支气管镜深度和相机运动）仍是一个未解决的问题。基于近期提出的三维视觉基础模型，我们提出 DUNEDepth，这是一种混合架构，结合了共享的 DUNE ViT 编码器、孪生 MASt3R 交叉注意力解码器结构，以及包含 MASt3R 和 Reloc3r 模型元素的预测头。为使该架构针对我们的应用进行微调，我们采用一种集成的混合合成监督/自监督训练策略，同时利用支气管镜视频和 CT 衍生的虚拟支气管镜视图。基于支气管镜视频序列的实验表明，DUNEDepth 比先前提出的自监督方法更准确地推导深度信息和相机运动轨迹。

title: LOTUS: lineage-aware optimal transport reconstructs continuous clonal fate dynamics
zh_title: LOTUS：谱系感知最优传输重建克隆命运
summary: LOTUS整合时间分辨转录组快照与克隆谱系信息，用神经不平衡最优传输建模连续细胞状态变化与克隆扩增。
key_points: 耦合克隆级最优传输与神经不平衡传输
分支模拟中谱系不一致转运由4.94–14.84%降至1.10%
在LARRY血细胞生成条形码数据中重建分支轨迹
reason: 计算生物学预印本，有基线对比但仅有模拟与公开数据集验证
abstract: Destructive sampling in single-cell sequencing obscures ancestor-descendant relationships, limiting the continuous reconstruction of cell-fate dynamics. Here we present Lineage-aware optimal transport for unbalanced single-cell dynamics (LOTUS), a framework that integrates time-resolved transcriptomic snapshots with clonal lineage information from engineered barcodes or endogenous T cell receptor clonotypes. LOTUS couples clone-level optimal transport with neural unbalanced transport to model continuous cellular state change, population growth and clonal propagation under lineage-consistent constraints. In branching simulations, LOTUS reduced lineage-inconsistent transport relative to benchmark methods, lowering off-target routing from 4.94-14.84% to 1.10%. On LARRY lineage-barcode scRNA-seq of hematopoiesis, LOTUS reconstructed branching trajectories, improved early neutrophil-monocyte fate-boundary prediction, and inferred multi-fate progenitors and fate-biased meta-clones, linking their distinct fate potentials to inferred epigenetic priming. On CellTagging scRNA-seq of fibroblast reprogramming, it distinguished reprogrammed from failed trajectories and prioritized fate-associated perturbation genes. In longitudinal scRNA-seq and TCR-seq of malaria-responsive memory (CD45RA-) CD4+ T cells, it preserved endogenous clonotype structure and reconstructed TR1 dynamics and regulatory networks. LOTUS thus converts lineage-resolved single-cell snapshots into interpretable, continuous models of fate dynamics and their regulatory programs.
zh_abstract: 单细胞测序中的破坏性采样掩盖了祖先-后代关系，限制了细胞命运动态的连续重建。在此，我们提出面向不平衡单细胞动态的谱系感知最优传输（Lineage-aware optimal transport for unbalanced single-cell dynamics，LOTUS），这是一个将时间分辨转录组快照与来自工程条形码或内源性 T 细胞受体克隆型的克隆谱系信息整合起来的框架。LOTUS 将克隆水平的最优传输与神经不平衡传输耦合，以在谱系一致的约束下建模连续的细胞状态变化、群体生长和克隆传播。在分支模拟中，LOTUS 相对于基准方法减少了谱系不一致的传输，将脱靶路由从 4.94-14.84% 降至 1.10%。在造血的 LARRY 谱系条形码 scRNA-seq 数据上，LOTUS 重建了分支轨迹，改善了早期中性粒细胞-单核细胞命运边界的预测，并推断了多命运祖细胞和命运偏倚的元克隆，将其不同的命运潜能与推断的表观遗传启动联系起来。在成纤维细胞重编程的 CellTagging scRNA-seq 数据上，它区分了重编程成功与失败的轨迹，并对命运相关扰动基因进行了优先级排序。在疟疾反应性记忆（CD45RA-）CD4+ T 细胞的纵向 scRNA-seq 和 TCR-seq 数据中，它保留了内源性克隆型结构，并重建了 TR1 动态和调控网络。因此，LOTUS 将谱系分辨的单细胞快照转化为可解释的、连续的命运动态及其调控程序模型。

title: Measure Before You Repair: An Explainable Agent for Blind Restoration of Multi-Artifact 3-D MRI
zh_title: Dx-Rx：先检测后修复的MRI盲复原智能体
summary: 多模态大模型智能体先诊断3D脑MRI的多种伪影再调用修复工具，并可回溯调整顺序并输出影像式报告。
key_points: 称为首个针对整卷3D MRI的复原智能体
调用五个诊断工具与四个修复工具，顺序自选并可回退
在148例全卷T1加权像上模拟至多五种伪影
reason: 智能体设计有新意、任务设定完整，但为预印本且以模拟伪影为主，证据有限
abstract: A brain MRI scan can carry an unknown mix of artifacts, so restoration has to be blind, yet most deep-learning methods are built to correct one known artifact. We present Dx-Rx, an agent in which a multimodal large language model (MLLM) measures suspected artifacts before it repairs them. To our knowledge, it is the first agent to restore whole 3-D MRI volumes, whereas earlier MRI agents restore 2-D slices. In a loop, it looks at slices of the 3-D volume, calls five diagnostic tools (noise, spike, ghosting, bias field, motion) and four restoration tools in any order it chooses, checks each repair, can return to any earlier version to change the order, and ends with a radiology-style report of its diagnostic reasons, the repairs it applied and their results. We simulated up to five artifacts on 148 whole 3-D T1-weighted volumes, at levels calibrated to radiologists' grades of real scans. An MLLM that only looked at the image, as earlier MRI agents do, removed at most 19.7 % of the artifact error. With the best of five MLLMs, Dx-Rx removed a mean 64.5 %, nearly matching the 64.6 % of the same tools given the ground-truth artifacts, which are never known for a clinical scan. With all five models, it made no volume worse and was on par with or better than an expert rule-based pipeline built from the same tools (62.3 %). Code and demo are public at https://itu-biai.github.io/measure-before-you-repair.
zh_abstract: 脑部 MRI 扫描可能带有未知的伪影组合，因此恢复必须是盲目的，然而大多数深度学习方法是为校正某一种已知伪影而构建的。我们提出 Dx-Rx，一种代理（agent），其中多模态大语言模型（MLLM）在修复疑似伪影之前先对其进行测量。据我们所知，它是首个恢复完整三维 MRI 体积的代理，而此前的 MRI 代理恢复的是二维切片。在一个循环中，它查看三维体积的切片，以任意顺序调用五种诊断工具（噪声、尖峰、重影、偏置场、运动）和四种恢复工具，检查每次修复，可以返回到任何较早版本以更改顺序，并以放射科风格报告结束，报告其诊断原因、所应用的修复及其结果。我们在 148 个完整三维 T1 加权体积上模拟了多达五种伪影，水平校准至放射科医生对真实扫描的分级。仅查看图像的 MLLM（如早期 MRI 代理所做）最多去除了 19.7% 的伪影误差。在五个 MLLM 中最佳者的情况下，Dx-Rx 平均去除了 64.5%，几乎匹配相同工具在给定真实伪影（ground-truth artifacts）时的 64.6%，而临床扫描中这些真实伪影从未已知。在所有五个模型中，它没有使任何体积变差，并与由相同工具构建的专家规则流水线（62.3%）相当或更好。代码和演示公开于 https://itu-biai.github.io/measure-before-you-repair。

title: A Guideline-Grounded Multi-Agent Framework for Personalized Exercise Prescription from Clinical and Wearable Data
zh_title: FITTER：指南约束的多智能体运动处方框架
summary: 多智能体框架整合临床与可穿戴数据生成个体化FITT-VP运动处方，并以确定性安全审计修正违规。
key_points: 纳入诊断、用药、功能限制与基线活动数据
400名All of Us参与者（300癌症、100卒中）评估
reason: 有对照与结构化临床医生评审，但为预印本且无前瞻性临床结局
abstract: Translating population-level exercise guidance into individualized prescriptions requires integrating clinical and wearable data, including diagnoses, medications, functional limitations, and baseline activity, with condition-specific recommendations, a process difficult to scale beyond specialist rehabilitation settings. We developed FITTER, a multi-agent framework that integrates these data with condition-specific guidance to generate personalized FITT-VP prescriptions and applies deterministic safety audit and repair to correct rule-checkable violations. We evaluated FITTER using data from 400 All of Us participants (300 cancer, 100 stroke) against five LLM comparators through computational evaluation, ablation, and structured clinician review. FITTER achieved 98.5% safety-constraint compliance versus 75.8-85.8% for comparators and showed greater quantitative dosing precision and guideline alignment. Cancer-cohort ablation identified safety audit and repair as the largest contributor to safety-constraint compliance. Clinicians reviewed 80 prescriptions across safety, personalization, instruction concreteness, anticipated effectiveness, and clinical acceptability. FITTER provides a clinician-facing approach integrating clinical and wearable data, guidance, and explicit safety constraints.
zh_abstract: 将人群层面的运动指南转化为个体化处方需要整合临床数据和可穿戴设备数据，包括诊断、药物、功能限制和基线活动，并与疾病特异性建议相结合，这一过程难以扩展到专科康复环境之外。我们开发了 FITTER，一个多代理框架，它将这些数据与疾病特异性指导整合，以生成个性化 FITT-VP 处方，并应用确定性安全审计和修复来纠正可规则检查的违规。我们使用 400 名 All of Us 参与者的数据（300 名癌症，100 名卒中）通过计算评估、消融和结构化临床医生评审，将 FITTER 与五个 LLM 比较器进行评价。FITTER 达到 98.5% 的安全约束依从性，而比较器为 75.8-85.8%，并显示出更高的定量剂量精确性和指南一致性。癌症队列消融确定安全审计和修复是安全约束依从性的最大贡献者。临床医生审查了 80 份处方，涵盖安全性、个性化、指令具体性、预期有效性和临床可接受性。FITTER 提供了一种面向临床医生的方法，整合临床和可穿戴数据、指导以及明确的安全约束。

title: Polyp Matching Using Deep Learning
zh_title: 深度学习用于结肠胶囊内镜息肉匹配
summary: 预印本用孪生网络与对比学习判断多张图像是否为同一息肉，以减少重复计数与不必要随访。
key_points: 数据来自丹麦CareForColon2015试验
同息肉与不同息肉图像对各5103对
ResNet、DenseNet、EfficientNet骨干加余弦距离
reason: 有明确新任务与临床标注数据集的方法预印本，但单一数据来源、未见外部验证，属值得一看档
abstract: A key challenge in colon capsule endoscopy (CCE) analysis is accurately identifying whether multiple images depict the same polyp, which is critical to avoid over-counting and unnecessary clinical interventions. Additionally, this prevents prolonged follow-up colonoscopies where endoscopists search for duplicate polyps without precise localization. This study presents a novel contrastive learning-based approach to polyp matching using a Siamese neural network architecture. The model was trained on a dataset from the Danish CareForColon2015 trial. The dataset comprises 5,103 image pairs of confirmed same polyp and 5,103 pairs of different polyps, annotated by experienced clinicians. The proposed model employs ResNet variants (ResNet18, ResNet34, ResNet50), DenseNet121 and EfficientNet B0/B3 as backbones and utilizes contrastive learning with cosine vector distance metric for classification. Experimental results demonstrate high classification accuracies of up to 92% and AUC values close to 0.98. These results suggest that automated polyp matching has the potential to reduce polyp over-counting, improve patient risk stratification, and reduce unnecessary follow-up colonoscopies.
zh_abstract: 结肠胶囊内镜（CCE）分析中的一项关键挑战是准确识别多幅图像是否描绘同一息肉，这对于避免过度计数和不必要的临床干预至关重要。此外，这可避免因内镜医师在没有精确定位的情况下寻找重复息肉而导致的随访结肠镜检查延长。本研究提出了一种基于对比学习的新型息肉匹配方法，采用孪生神经网络架构。该模型在来自丹麦 CareForColon2015 试验的数据集上训练。该数据集包含由经验丰富的临床医生标注的 5,103 对经确认的同一息肉图像对和 5,103 对不同息肉图像对。所提出的模型采用 ResNet 变体（ResNet18、ResNet34、ResNet50）、DenseNet121 和 EfficientNet B0/B3 作为骨干网络，并利用结合余弦向量距离度量的对比学习进行分类。实验结果表明，分类准确率高达 92%，AUC 值接近 0.98。这些结果表明，自动息肉匹配有潜力减少息肉过度计数、改善患者风险分层，并减少不必要的随访结肠镜检查。

title: Performance, Scalability and Maintenance: An Experimental Study of RPA vs. Autonomous Agents in the Healthcare Domain
zh_title: 医疗场景RPA与LLM自主智能体对比实验
summary: 在实验室门户检索乳腺影像报告的实验中，RPA在准确率、速度与成本上均优于LLM自主智能体。
key_points: RPA准确率98.90%，智能体为96.49%
RPA每例16.07秒，智能体207.21秒
RPA每份成本0.030美元，智能体0.187美元
reason: 预印本，单场景实测对比含成本与耗时，有新意但无外部验证
abstract: Healthcare information systems are fragmented, and retrieving data from legacy web portals is a recurrent need. Robotic Process Automation (RPA) is deterministic but sensitive to interface changes, whereas autonomous agents based on large language models (Agent Process Automation, APA) promise adaptability at a higher computational cost. Following Design Science Research, we developed and compared an RPA solution (Playwright) and an APA solution (browser-use, LangGraph and Gemini 2.5 Flash-lite) to retrieve mammography and breast ultrasound reports from a laboratory portal, treating reports solely as informational artifacts. Across two rounds (T and T+7), RPA reached 98.90% accuracy and 98.27% F1-score versus 96.49% and 94.48% for APA, was about 13 times faster (16.07 s vs. 207.21 s per patient) and cost about six times less per report (USD 0.030 vs. 0.187). Both reached 100% step success rates; APA varied more over time. For a stable interface, RPA was superior.
zh_abstract: 医疗信息系统呈碎片化，从遗留网络门户检索数据是一项反复出现的需求。机器人流程自动化（RPA）具有确定性，但对界面变化敏感；而基于大语言模型的自主智能体（智能体流程自动化，APA）承诺以更高的计算成本实现适应性。遵循设计科学研究，我们开发并比较了一种RPA解决方案（Playwright）和一种APA解决方案（browser-use、LangGraph和Gemini 2.5 Flash-lite），用于从实验室门户检索乳腺X线摄影和乳腺超声报告，并将报告仅视为信息性制品。在两轮（T和T+7）中，RPA达到98.90%的准确率和98.27%的F1分数，而APA为96.49%和94.48%；RPA约快13倍（每名患者16.07秒 vs. 207.21秒），每份报告成本约低至六分之一（0.030美元 vs. 0.187美元）。两者均达到100%的步骤成功率；APA随时间波动更大。对于稳定界面，RPA更优。

title: FedReady: Bounded Agents for Federation Formation
zh_title: FedReady：受限智能体完成联邦组建
summary: 用受限LLM智能体完成联邦站点筛选与本地数据准备，在39个模拟视网膜站点上验证。
key_points: 智能体提出共享契约、本地适配器与任务代码
站点发现优先召回，本地准入先验证任务支持
组建完成后由常规联邦训练接管
reason: 预印本，解决联邦组建工程问题，仅模拟环境测试未见真实部署
abstract: Federated learning (FL) runtimes standardize aggregation and deployment, but each new study still requires federation formation: selecting task-eligible sites and preparing their local data and task code for federated training or analysis. This preparation recurs when the target changes, while raw records and site-private mappings are excluded from cross-site FL messages. We present FedReady, a system that performs federation formation with bounded LLM agents. Agents propose shared contracts, local adapters, and task code; the runtime owns workflow state and accepts artifacts only after checks tied to their digests. Candidate site discovery prioritizes recall; local eligibility verification checks task support before site admission. Once participating sites and artifacts are fixed, conventional federated training or analysis proceeds without readiness agents. Across 39 simulated retinal sites and four tasks, discovery reaches recall 1.00 at precision 0.65; local eligibility verification removes all 17 false positives without losing an eligible site-task pair. The participating sites supply 45,575 task-record instances and complete four 100-round jobs, including one with a runtime-generated contract. Across ten patient cohorts, preparation supports seven patient populations and holds endpoints at three sources as unsupported. Comparison with manually prepared reference populations and analysis (the manual reference) gives a maximum survival-curve difference of 0.001133. We also analyze 19 development failures, targeted classification ablations, and standalone and heterogeneous agent configurations. These results establish the feasibility of task-specific data preparation before ordinary FL training or analysis.
zh_abstract: 联邦学习（FL）运行时使聚合和部署标准化，但每项新研究仍需要联邦组建：选择符合任务条件的站点，并为其本地数据和任务代码做好准备，以进行联邦训练或分析。当目标变化时，这种准备工作会重复出现，而原始记录和站点私有映射被排除在跨站点FL消息之外。我们提出FedReady，一个使用有界LLM智能体执行联邦组建的系统。智能体提出共享契约、本地适配器和任务代码；运行时拥有工作流状态，并且仅在与其摘要绑定的检查之后接受制品。候选站点发现优先考虑召回率；本地合格性验证在站点准入前检查任务支持。一旦参与站点和制品确定，传统联邦训练或分析便无需就绪智能体即可进行。在39个模拟视网膜站点和四项任务中，发现达到召回率1.00、精确率0.65；本地合格性验证移除了全部17个假阳性，且未丢失任何合格的站点-任务对。参与站点提供45,575个任务记录实例，并完成四项100轮作业，其中包括一项使用运行时生成契约的作业。在十个患者队列中，准备工作支持七个患者群体，并将三个来源的终点视为不受支持。与人工准备的参考人群和分析（人工参考）相比，最大生存曲线差异为0.001133。我们还分析了19次开发失败、针对性分类消融，以及独立和异构智能体配置。这些结果确立了在普通FL训练或分析之前进行任务特定数据准备的可行性。

title: NormMoX: A Normative Mixture of Experts for Explainable Autism Classification from Structural and Functional MRI
zh_title: NormMoX：自闭症可解释分类专家混合模型
summary: 将典型脑作为共同参照的规范化专家混合模型，基于结构/功能MRI做自闭症分类并给出解释。
key_points: 以健康大队列建立年龄性别规范化参照
基于个体偏离值做预测、融合与解释
旨在解决站点、头动等混杂因素
reason: 预印本新方法有解释性设计，未见外部验证，属值得一看档
abstract: While structural and functional magnetic resonance imaging (sMRI, fMRI) offer profound potential for researching autism spectrum disorder (ASD) and understanding individual neurodivergence, current classifiers lack the explanatory power needed for scientific study, clinical use and personal-level insights. Most models learn from imaging features that also vary with age, sex, scanner site and head motion. They fuse the two modalities without a common reference and explain decisions against arbitrary reference inputs rather than a typical brain. We present NormMoX, a normative mixture of experts that makes the typical brain the shared reference for prediction, fusion and explanation. Normative models trained on large healthy cohorts give the value each brain measure is expected to take for a person's age and sex. NormMoX learns from each person's deviations from these expected values. For each modality, a neural network expert turns the deviations into a score of evidence for ASD. A fusion head, MoX, compares each score with those of typical controls before combining them. It therefore needs no imputation when a modality is missing and shows in which modality each person is atypical. On 1,035 participants of ABIDE I, NormMoX reached an AUROC of $0.728 \pm 0.004$ in repeated cross-validation, above linear, single-modality and deep fusion baselines. NormMoX thus shows not only whether a person is likely to have ASD, but where, and in which modality, their brain departs from typical. The implementation is available at https://github.com/Novelex/NormMox.
zh_abstract: 虽然结构和功能磁共振成像（sMRI、fMRI）为研究自闭症谱系障碍（ASD）和理解个体神经多样性提供了巨大潜力，但当前的分类器缺乏科学研究、临床使用和个人层面洞察所需的解释力。大多数模型从影像特征中学习，而这些特征也会随年龄、性别、扫描站点和头动而变化。它们在没有共同参照的情况下融合两种模态，并针对任意参照输入而非典型大脑来解释决策。我们提出 NormMoX，一种常模混合专家（normative mixture of experts）模型，使典型大脑成为预测、融合和解释的共享参照。在大型健康队列上训练的常模模型给出每个人在其年龄和性别下每项大脑测量指标的期望值。NormMoX 从每个人与这些期望值的偏差中学习。对于每种模态，一个神经网络专家将偏差转化为 ASD 的证据分数。融合头 MoX 在结合这些分数之前，将每个分数与典型对照的分数进行比较。因此，当某一模态缺失时它无需插补，并能显示每个人在哪种模态上表现不典型。在 ABIDE I 的 1,035 名参与者上，NormMoX 在重复交叉验证中达到 $0.728 \pm 0.004$ 的 AUROC，高于线性、单模态和深度融合基线。因此，NormMoX 不仅显示一个人是否可能患有 ASD，还显示其大脑在何处、以何种模态偏离典型。实现代码可在 https://github.com/Novelex/NormMox 获取。

title: Therapy-FIS: A Dataset for Assessing Facilitative Interpersonal Skills in Psychotherapeutic Setting
zh_title: Therapy-FIS：心理治疗促进性人际技能评估数据集
summary: 预印本公开首个心理治疗情境下促进性人际技能自动评估数据集，含面部、声学与文本信号。
key_points: 首个公开的心理治疗FIS评估数据集
基于890段治疗师视频录像构建
融合面部、声学与文本多模态信号
reason: 填补数据空白但规模有限、尚无模型效果证据，属值得一看档
abstract: Facilitative Interpersonal Skills (FIS) is a performance-based assessment method that provides a structured framework for evaluating the interpersonal competencies of mental health professionals. However, existing FIS assessment relies heavily on human observer ratings, making the evaluation process labor-intensive, costly, and difficult to scale. Progress toward automated FIS assessment has also been constrained by the lack of publicly available professional data in psychotherapy settings. To address this limitation, we introduce Therapy-FIS, a dataset for automated FIS assessment in standardized psychotherapy tasks. To our knowledge, Therapy-FIS is the first publicly available dataset in this domain. It contains facial, acoustic, and textual signals derived from standardized therapist responses to standardized mock patient stimulus clips, based on 890 therapist video recordings and 8 patient videos, and is rated with eight FIS subscale ratings and an overall FIS score. Built on Therapy-FIS, we further establish a benchmark with two downstream tasks: Therapist Performance Rating and Joint Therapist--mock-Patient Performance Rating. We also introduce a competitive baseline, DyadicFIS, with gated fusion and routed readout under therapist-only and dyadic settings. DyadicFIS obtains the best macro CCC(Concordance Correlation Coefficient) scores on both tasks (0.2807 and 0.3299). Therapy-FIS offers a reproducible resource for data-driven automated assessment of therapeutic interpersonal skills in mental health.
zh_abstract: 促进性人际技能（Facilitative Interpersonal Skills, FIS）是一种基于表现的评估方法，为评估心理健康专业人员的 interpersonal competencies 提供了结构化框架。然而，现有 FIS 评估严重依赖人工观察者评分，使评估过程劳动密集、成本高昂且难以规模化。自动 FIS 评估的进展还因心理治疗环境中缺乏公开可用的专业数据而受到限制。为解决这一局限，我们引入 Therapy-FIS，这是一个用于标准化心理治疗任务中自动 FIS 评估的数据集。据我们所知，Therapy-FIS 是该领域首个公开可用的数据集。它包含源自治疗师对标准化模拟患者刺激片段的标准回应的面部、声学和文本信号，基于 890 段治疗师视频记录和 8 段患者视频，并以八个 FIS 子量表评分和一个总体 FIS 分数进行评分。基于 Therapy-FIS，我们进一步建立了一个包含两个下游任务的基准：治疗师表现评分（Therapist Performance Rating）和治疗师—模拟患者联合表现评分（Joint Therapist--mock-Patient Performance Rating）。我们还引入了一个有竞争力的基线 DyadicFIS，在仅治疗师和二元设置下采用门控融合和路由读出。DyadicFIS 在两个任务上均获得最佳 macro CCC（Concordance Correlation Coefficient，一致性相关系数）分数（0.2807 和 0.3299）。Therapy-FIS 为心理健康中治疗性人际技能的数据驱动自动评估提供了可复现的资源。

title: Sparse-View 3D Coronary Reconstruction from Vessel Segmentations Using a Diffusion Prior
zh_title: 基于血管分割与扩散先验的稀疏视角冠脉三维重建
summary: 预印本提出结合三维扩散先验、可视外壳初始化与投影一致性的冠脉血管三维重建框架。
key_points: 扩散模型仅用冠脉血管掩码训练，无需成对2D-3D数据
可视外壳初始化加投影一致性更新
在ImageCAS模拟血管造影上评估2/4/8视角
reason: 方法有新意但仅在模拟造影数据上验证，证据有限
abstract: Reconstructing three-dimensional (3D) coronary anatomy from sparse angiographic views could support percutaneous coronary intervention, but limited angular coverage and imperfect vessel segmentations introduce substantial geometric ambiguity. We propose a vessel-specific reconstruction framework combining a learned 3D diffusion prior, visual-hull initialization, and projection-based data consistency. The unconditional diffusion model is trained on coronary vessel masks without paired 2D--3D data and reused across different view counts without retraining. During inference, a scaled visual hull initializes reconstruction, while projection-based updates constrain diffusion refinement using patient-specific vessel observations. We evaluated the framework on simulated angiograms derived from ImageCAS computed tomography angiography volumes using two, four, and eight views at two contrast levels. Across 50 evaluation coronary-tree cases, the proposed method achieved higher mean Dice and clDice than visual hull, deep image prior (DIP), and hash-grid implicit neural representation (INR) at all view counts under reduced contrast. With eight views, improvements over DIP, the best-performing baseline at lower contrast, were approximately 0.13 in Dice and 0.22 in clDice. At higher contrast, performance remained competitive with hash-grid INR, the best-performing eight-view baseline. The preferred diffusion starting timestep depended on observation quality and view count, with excessive refinement reducing accuracy at higher contrast. Projection guidance improved both metrics across all conditions. Averaging stochastic reconstructions further improved accuracy, while sample disagreement localized errors with average-precision gains of 0.14--0.21 over error prevalence. These findings support diffusion-prior reconstruction from sparse vessel observations, although clinical validation remains necessary.
zh_abstract: 从稀疏血管造影视图重建三维（3D）冠状动脉解剖结构可支持经皮冠状动脉介入治疗，但有限的角度覆盖和不完美的血管分割会引入显著的几何歧义。我们提出一种血管特异性重建框架，结合学习到的3D扩散先验、视觉外壳初始化以及基于投影的数据一致性。该无条件扩散模型在冠状动脉血管掩膜上训练，无需配对的2D–3D数据，并可在不同视图数量间复用而无需重新训练。推理时，缩放视觉外壳初始化重建，而基于投影的更新利用患者特异性血管观测约束扩散细化。我们在由ImageCAS计算机断层扫描血管造影体积衍生的模拟血管造影上评估该框架，使用2、4和8个视图，在两个对比度水平下。在50例评估冠状动脉树病例中，在降低对比度下，所提方法在所有视图数量下均获得比视觉外壳、深度图像先验（DIP）和哈希网格隐式神经表示（INR）更高的平均Dice和clDice。在8个视图下，相对于较低对比度下表现最佳的基线DIP，Dice提升约0.13，clDice提升约0.22。在较高对比度下，性能与哈希网格INR（表现最佳的8视图基线）保持竞争力。首选的扩散起始时间步取决于观测质量和视图数量，过度细化会降低较高对比度下的准确性。投影引导在所有条件下均改善了两项指标。对随机重建取平均进一步提高了准确性，而样本间分歧可定位错误，相较于错误流行率，平均精度提升0.14–0.21。这些发现支持基于稀疏血管观测的扩散先验重建，但仍需临床验证。

title: Balancing Chain-of-Thought and Answer Supervision for Small Language Models on Medical Question Answering
zh_title: 小语言模型医学问答中思维链与答案监督的权衡
summary: 比较两种思维链监督微调损失加权方式，在六个通用与医学模型、多个医学问答基准上测试。
key_points: 对比整体等权与思维链/答案分段加权两种微调策略
选择题上分段加权更优，通用模型受益最大
医学领域模型在选择题上提升较小甚至为负
reason: 多模型多基准的对比实验但为预印本、缺乏外部临床验证，属值得一看档
abstract: Small language models (<=9B parameters) can support local medical question answering (QA) while reducing privacy and latency concerns, but effective fine-tuning remains challenging. This paper compares two chain-of-thought (CoT) supervised fine-tuning methods: Uniform-across-Sequence (UaS), which applies equal loss weighting to the full CoT-and-answer sequence, and Segment-weighted (SwS), which separately weights CoT and answer losses. We evaluate six general- and medical-domain models on multiple-choice QA (MedQA and EMS-MCQA) and free-text QA (Med-O1). Results show that neither method is universally best: on multiple-choice QA (MedQA and EMS-MCQA), SwS generally performs better, with general-purpose models benefiting most; notably, Qwen3.5-4B improves by up to 44.8% over its zero-shot baseline on MedQA. In contrast, medical-domain models show smaller or even negative gains on MCQs. On free-text QA (Med-O1), UaS performs best for nearly all models and provides consistent improvements across both model types, with the 3B Llama-3.2 model approaching the performance of much larger 7B medical-domain models. We also find that excessively long CoT generation is associated with lower performance in some models on either multiple-choice or free-text QA tasks, suggesting that limiting the CoT length during training may benefit selected models. Overall, the results show that CoT loss weighting should be matched to the task format and the knowledge already encoded in the base model, rather than using a single fine-tuning strategy for all clinical QA tasks.
zh_abstract: 小型语言模型（≤9B 参数）可支持本地医学问答（QA），同时减少隐私和延迟问题，但有效微调仍具挑战性。本文比较两种思维链（chain-of-thought, CoT）监督微调方法：全序列均匀（Uniform-across-Sequence, UaS），对完整 CoT 和答案序列施加相同损失权重；分段加权（Segment-weighted, SwS），分别对 CoT 和答案损失加权。我们在多项选择 QA（MedQA 和 EMS-MCQA）和自由文本 QA（Med-O1）上评估六个通用领域和医学领域模型。结果表明，没有一种方法普遍最优：在多项选择 QA（MedQA 和 EMS-MCQA）上，SwS 通常表现更好，通用模型受益最大；值得注意的是，Qwen3.5-4B 在 MedQA 上较其零样本基线提升最高达 44.8%。相反，医学领域模型在 MCQs 上增益较小甚至为负。在自由文本 QA（Med-O1）上，UaS 对几乎所有模型表现最佳，并在两类模型上提供一致改进，其中 3B Llama-3.2 模型接近大得多的 7B 医学领域模型的性能。我们还发现，过长的 CoT 生成与某些模型在多项选择或自由文本 QA 任务上的较低性能相关，提示在训练期间限制 CoT 长度可能使选定模型受益。总体而言，结果表明 CoT 损失加权应与任务格式以及基座模型中已编码的知识相匹配，而不是对所有临床 QA 任务使用单一微调策略。

title: Mitigating Spatial Blindness in Multiple Instance Learning for Whole-Slide Image Analysis
zh_title: 缓解全切片图像多实例学习中的空间盲区
summary: 提出ResTopoMIL，先冻结成分预测器再训练图残差并加坐标重分配分离损失，以缓解WSI多实例学习的空间盲区。
key_points: 将「空间盲区」界定为模型未真正利用组织邻域信息
冻结成分预测器后训练图残差，配合分离损失
受控空间任务AUC 0.987，联合训练同架构为0.684
reason: 预印本方法学改进，受控实验与多WSI任务有对比，但无外部验证，属值得一看档
abstract: Whole-slide multiple instance learning can predict diagnostic and prognostic labels from tissue composition while making limited use of spatial organization. Providing coordinates or a graph does not establish that a trained predictor uses tissue neighborhoods. We examine this gap as spatial blindness and hypothesize that early composition learning can weaken supervision of a spatial pathway. We introduce ResTopoMIL, which freezes a learned composition predictor before training a graph residual with a coordinate-reassignment separation loss. Permutation and information analyses distinguish architectural symmetry, available spatial information and the proposed optimization mechanism. On a controlled spatial task, staged training achieved an AUC of 0.987, compared with 0.684 for the same jointly trained architecture. Performance remained high on a composition-only task. Across four WSI classification and five survival benchmarks, ResTopoMIL improved mean primary performance on eight tasks; four improvements remained significant after Holm-adjusted patient-cluster tests. Coordinate-free residual controls recovered some of the gains, while neighborhood destruction reduced performance close to the composition anchor. Neighborhood-preserving transformations and anatomy-stratified perturbations further characterized this dependence. These results support fixing a composition reference as a practical intervention for learning spatial corrections, while retaining additional appearance capacity as a contributing explanation.
zh_abstract: 全切片多实例学习能够根据组织组成预测诊断和预后标签，但对空间组织的利用有限。提供坐标或图并不能证明训练后的预测器利用了组织邻域。我们将这一缺口视为空间盲区，并假设早期组成学习可能削弱对空间通路的监督。我们引入 ResTopoMIL，它冻结已学习的组成预测器，然后使用坐标重分配分离损失训练图残差。置换分析和信息分析区分了架构对称性、可用空间信息和所提出的优化机制。在一个受控空间任务上，分阶段训练达到 AUC 0.987，而同一联合训练架构为 0.684。在仅组成任务上，性能仍保持较高。在四个 WSI 分类和五个生存分析基准上，ResTopoMIL 提高了八个任务的平均主要性能；在 Holm 校正的患者簇检验后，四项改善仍保持显著。无坐标残差对照恢复了一部分增益，而邻域破坏使性能降低至接近组成锚点。邻域保持变换和解剖分层扰动进一步刻画了这种依赖性。这些结果支持将固定组成参考作为学习空间校正的一种实用干预，同时保留额外外观容量作为一种促成解释。

title: Benchmark of THReD: Evaluating an LLM Agent and Its Preprocessing Tools for Turning Electronic Health Records into AI-Ready Datasets
zh_title: THReD基准：评估LLM智能体将电子病历转为AI可用数据集
summary: arXiv预印本发布THReD基准：141项任务、7类场景，用合成EHR表格检验LLM智能体预处理临床数据的可靠性、可复现性与抗提示注入能力。
key_points: 141项任务/100模板，含提示注入与故障恢复
约2550次运行，首答任务完成率92.7%
成功与否由产出数据检查判定；预印本未经同行评审
reason: 新基准含提示注入等场景，但为预印本、仅自建合成数据，属值得一看档
abstract: LLM agents are increasingly built into data-analysis software, yet little evidence shows how reliably they preprocess clinical data or whether the tools they invoke give correct, reproducible output. We report a benchmark of THReD, a web-based system that turns electronic health record (EHR) extracts into AI-ready datasets through a chat agent whose proposed steps run only after user confirmation. The agent benchmark has 141 tasks (100 templates) in seven categories, including goal-level requests, failure recovery, requests calling for no action, schema variation and prompt injection through the data, on synthetic tables calibrated to a regional health information exchange; success is judged by checks on the produced data. Over 2,550 episodes with Claude Haiku 5.5 in four context configurations, the deployed agent completed 92.7% (95% CI 88.1-96.4) of tasks on its first answer, abstained on every advice request, recovered from every injected fault, and never proposed an action requested by planted text. Without the data profile, completion fell to 58.0%; goal-level requests were hardest (80.6%). Six experiments on real records of two chronic-disease cohorts and on synthetic data at scale validate the tools: 91-92% of inferred patient classes and 99.7-99.8% of inferred vital-sign labels were correct in masked reconstruction; a dictionary builder combining curated dictionaries with LLM suggestions mapped 99.0% of 2,208 raw variants correctly; all 2,176 replays of 128 saved pipelines gave byte-identical files under pinned dependencies; subgroup differences in inference accuracy vanished within facility and lookup key; and the same-day consolidation rule changed 90-day emergency revisit rates by up to 3.2 points without shifting cohort composition by more than one point. Processing time grew roughly linearly to 5.5 million records while the prompt stayed at about 13 thousand tokens.
zh_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体正越来越多地被内置于数据分析软件中，但很少有证据表明它们预处理临床数据的可靠性如何，或它们调用的工具是否能给出正确、可复现的输出。我们报告了对THReD的基准测试；THReD是一个基于网络的系统，通过聊天智能体将电子健康记录（EHR）提取数据转化为可供AI使用的数据集，该智能体所提出的步骤仅在用户确认后运行。该智能体基准包含七类141项任务（100个模板），包括目标级请求、故障恢复、无需采取行动的请求、模式变异以及通过数据进行的提示注入；这些任务在按区域健康信息交换校准的合成表上进行，成功与否由对所生成数据的检查判定。在四种上下文配置下，使用Claude Haiku 5.5进行的超过2,550个回合中，部署的智能体在首次回答时完成了92.7%（95% CI 88.1-96.4）的任务，对每一个建议请求均弃权，从每一次注入故障中恢复，并且从未提出植入文本所要求的行动。在没有数据概况的情况下，完成率降至58.0%；目标级请求最难（80.6%）。在来自两个慢性病队列的真实记录以及大规模合成数据上开展的六项实验验证了这些工具：在掩蔽重建中，91-92%的推断患者类别和99.7-99.8%的推断生命体征标签是正确的；一个将精选词典与LLM建议相结合的词典构建器正确映射了2,208个原始变异中的99.0%；在固定依赖项下，对128个已保存流程的所有2,176次重放均产生字节完全一致的文件；推断准确性的亚组差异在机构（facility）和查找键（lookup key）内部消失；同日合并规则使90天急诊复诊率变化最多达3.2个百分点，同时未使队列构成偏移超过1个百分点。处理时间随记录数增至550万条而大致线性增长，同时提示保持在约1.3万个token。

title: Findings-aware Language-Image Pretraining for CT Volume Interpretation
zh_title: 面向CT的发现感知视觉语言预训练
summary: 提出面向CT的发现感知视觉-语言预训练框架，利用临床知识改进表征学习。
key_points: 针对CLIP将不同病例视为负样本的局限
引入语言基础模型的临床知识进行监督式表征学习
面向CT体积的影像-报告联合预训练
reason: 预印本新方法，针对CT多模态表征，证据有限，属值得一看档。
abstract: Computed tomography (CT) provides diverse patient information and various clinical tasks, for which numerous deep learning models have been investigated. Recent years have seen the development of vision-language foundation models that can comprehensively extract clinical features, driven by representation learning that combines CT volumes with radiology reports. Existing approaches typically adopt Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training (CLIP)-based representation learning, where pairs from different cases are, in principle, treated as negative pairs such that the volume and report embeddings are pushed apart. In the biomedical imaging, however, treating different cases as negative pairs is not always appropriate, particularly when clinical similarity exists. In this study, we propose a supervised representation learning framework grounded in clinical knowledge from language foundation models, rather than the weak supervision used in CLIP. Specifically, we utilized a large language model to extract abnormal finding phrases from reports. We then explicitly constructed the target features that the image encoder should output, as the semantic representation of the extracted findings using a biomedical text embedding model. Our Findings-aware Language-Image Pre-training (FiLIP) outperformed weakly supervised approaches in multi-label zero-shot finding classification in both in-domain and external-domain evaluations, and also proved effective when fine-tuned for the downstream task of radiology report generation.
zh_abstract: 计算机断层扫描（Computed tomography, CT）提供多样化的患者信息并支持多种临床任务，针对这些任务已研究了大量深度学习模型。近年来，结合 CT 体积与放射学报告的表征学习推动了视觉-语言基础模型的发展，这些模型能够全面提取临床特征。现有方法通常采用基于对比语言-图像预训练（Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training, CLIP）的表征学习，其中不同病例组成的配对原则上被视为负对，从而使体积嵌入与报告嵌入彼此远离。然而在生物医学影像中，将不同病例视为负对并不总是恰当，尤其是当存在临床相似性时。本研究提出一个基于语言基础模型所提供临床知识的监督式表征学习框架，而非 CLIP 中使用的弱监督。具体而言，我们利用一个大型语言模型从报告中提取异常发现短语。随后，我们利用一个生物医学文本嵌入模型，将提取发现的语义表示显式构建为图像编码器应输出的目标特征。我们的发现感知语言-图像预训练（Findings-aware Language-Image Pre-training, FiLIP）在域内和外部域评估的多标签零样本发现分类中均优于弱监督方法，并且在针对放射学报告生成这一下游任务进行微调时也证明有效。

title: Multimodal Prompt Learning with Dual-Granularity Contrastive Alignment for Preoperative Prediction of Lung Adenocarcinoma Invasiveness Using 3D CT
zh_title: 双粒度对比对齐的多模态提示学习预测肺腺癌浸润
summary: 预印本提出多模态提示学习框架，用3D CT与报告文本双粒度对齐，区分浸润性与前浸润性肺腺癌。
key_points: 3D ResNet-CBAM提取全局与空间视觉特征
冻结RadBERT加可学习提示编码报告与关键词
全局对比对齐与多示例学习实现局部对齐
reason: 有新意的多模态提示学习预印本，但未见外部验证与样本量信息，属值得一看档
abstract: Accurate preoperative prediction of lung adenocarcinoma invasiveness is important for surgical planning and individualized treatment. However, overlapping CT appearances make it challenging to distinguish invasive adenocarcinoma (IAD) from Pre-IAD lesions. We propose a multimodal prompt-learning framework with dual-granularity image-text alignment for 3D CT-based IAD classification. A 3D ResNet-CBAM encoder extracts global and spatial visual features. A frozen RadBERT backbone is adapted with separate learnable prompts for report-level and keyword-level text encoding. These prompts are initialized using semantic representations derived from real-world clinical reports. Global contrastive alignment connects whole-volume CT representations with reports generated from clinician-annotated radiological attributes to provide overall semantic supervision. A multiple instance learning-based local alignment module associates spatial CT features with vascular-focused radiological keywords, to capture local imaging characteristics potentially associated with tumor invasion. The framework jointly optimizes classification and alignment objectives, while inference requires only CT images. Experiments included 1,593 pathologically confirmed nodules. On the test set, the proposed method achieved an accuracy of 87.92%, F1-score of 87.78%, and AUC of 0.9499. Its AUC significantly exceeded that of the image-only Res-CBAM baseline with the same visual backbone (0.9297; DeLong test, p = 0.0078). Ablation analyses supported the complementary contributions of global and local alignment and the benefit of report-based prompt initialization. Qualitative visualizations showed activation within nodules and adjacent vascular structures. These findings suggest that dual-granularity radiological supervision can enhance CT-based invasiveness prediction while preserving a CT-only inference workflow.
zh_abstract: 准确的肺腺癌侵袭性术前预测对于手术规划和个体化治疗很重要。然而，重叠的 CT 表现使得区分侵袭性腺癌（IAD）与 Pre-IAD 病变具有挑战性。我们提出了一种多模态提示学习框架，具有双粒度图像-文本对齐，用于基于 3D CT 的 IAD 分类。3D ResNet-CBAM 编码器提取全局和空间视觉特征。冻结的 RadBERT 主干通过分别用于报告级和关键词级文本编码的独立可学习提示进行适配。这些提示使用源自真实世界临床报告的语义表示进行初始化。全局对比对齐将全体积 CT 表示与根据临床医生标注的放射学属性生成的报告连接起来，以提供整体语义监督。基于多示例学习的局部对齐模块将空间 CT 特征与以血管为重点的放射学关键词相关联，以捕获可能与肿瘤侵袭相关的局部影像特征。该框架联合优化分类和对齐目标，而推理仅需要 CT 图像。实验包括 1,593 个经病理确诊的结节。在测试集上，所提方法达到 87.92% 的准确率、87.78% 的 F1 分数和 0.9499 的 AUC。其 AUC 显著超过具有相同视觉主干的仅图像 Res-CBAM 基线（0.9297；DeLong 检验，p = 0.0078）。消融分析支持全局和局部对齐的互补贡献以及基于报告的提示初始化的益处。定性可视化显示结节内和邻近血管结构中的激活。这些发现表明，双粒度放射学监督可以增强基于 CT 的侵袭性预测，同时保留仅 CT 的推理工作流。

title: State-Aware Virtual Patient Simulation for Training Psychiatrists in Challenging Clinical Scenarios
zh_title: 面向精神科医师训练的状态感知虚拟患者模拟
summary: 预印本提出状态感知虚拟患者流水线，维持患者心理状态演变，用于训练精神科医师应对高危场景。
key_points: 针对自杀意念、幻觉等高危临床场景训练
系统维护随交互演化的患者状态
由状态编排行为，而非完全交由大模型生成
reason: 方法有新意的医学教育智能体预印本，但缺乏量化评估与外部验证，属值得一看档
abstract: Psychiatrists must be prepared to manage patients exhibiting challenging psychological states, including suicidal ideation, hallucinations, and other high-risk behaviors. However, opportunities to safely practice such interactions are limited. While recent conversational agents can simulate patients, existing approaches largely rely on large language models (LLMs) to determine patient responses, making it difficult to consistently maintain psychological state, adapt to the clinician's responses, and generate clinically plausible challenges that meaningfully test the clinician. We present a state-aware virtual patient simulation pipeline for training psychiatrists in challenging clinical scenarios. The proposed system maintains an evolving patient state throughout the interaction and orchestrates patient behavior rather than leaving response generation entirely to an LLM. At each interaction, a learning-based behavioral strategy selector determines the type and level of challenge appropriate to the current patient and clinician context. The selected strategy, patient state, clinician response, interaction history, and relevant clinical knowledge are then provided as grounded context to an LLM to generate a semantically relevant and psychologically consistent patient response. Following each session, the system analyzes the interaction and provides feedback to the clinician on their communication and management of the virtual patient.
zh_abstract: 精神科医生必须准备好管理表现出挑战性心理状态的患者，包括自杀意念、幻觉和其他高风险行为。然而，安全练习此类互动的机会有限。尽管近期的对话智能体可以模拟患者，但现有方法在很大程度上依赖大语言模型（LLMs）来确定患者反应，这使得难以一致地维持心理状态、适应临床医生的反应，并生成具有临床合理性且能有意义地考验临床医生的挑战。我们提出了一种状态感知的虚拟患者模拟流程，用于在挑战性临床场景中培训精神科医生。所提出的系统在整个交互过程中维持不断演变的患者状态，并编排患者行为，而不是将反应生成完全交给 LLM。在每次交互时，基于学习的行为策略选择器确定适合当前患者和临床医生情境的挑战类型和水平。随后，将所选策略、患者状态、临床医生反应、交互历史和相关临床知识作为有依据的上下文提供给 LLM，以生成语义相关且心理一致的患者反应。每次会话结束后，系统分析交互，并就临床医生与虚拟患者的沟通和管理提供反馈。

title: Attention Residual U-Net for Enhanced Cross-Dataset Polyp Localization in Endoscopy
zh_title: 注意力残差U-Net提升跨数据集内镜息肉定位
summary: 预印本提出基于注意力残差U-Net的息肉检测框架，学习病灶空间表征再转为检测框。
key_points: 针对设备差异、肠道内容与数据集偏倚
不直接回归边界框，而学习病灶聚焦表征
面向小病灶与低对比病灶的定位鲁棒性
reason: 有新意的检测框架但证据有限、仅预印本，属值得一看档
abstract: Precise localization of pathologies in endoscopy is a critical task in medical imaging, with deep learning (DL) frameworks now serving as the primary methodology for automated lesion detection. Today, generic object detection methods, such as YOLO, provide state-of-the-art performance in this context. However, their robustness often decreases under real-world clinical conditions due to variations across endoscopic devices, intestinal content, dataset bias, and the presence of small or low-contrast lesions. Motivated by these challenges, we propose a novel polyp detection framework based on a Attention Residual U-Net offering enhanced polyp localization. Instead of directly regressing bounding boxes from global feature representations, the proposed method learns lesion-focused spatial representations and converts them into bounding-box predictions during inference. Unlike conventional encoder-decoder localization frameworks that directly propagate all encoder activations into the decoding pathway, the proposed method selectively suppresses irrelevant background responses before feature reconstruction. This encourages the network to focus on lesion-relevant spatial evidence under heterogeneous imaging conditions. To achieve this, the framework integrates residual feature propagation, attention-guided encoder filtering, and multi-scale contextual learning. The proposed framework was evaluated on multiple public endoscopic datasets acquired using different devices. The comparative experimental results validate its effectiveness over the relevant state-of-the-art methods, with an improvement up to 22.0% in terms of the area under the receiving operating characteristic (AUC).
zh_abstract: 内镜中病变的精确局部定位是医学影像中的一项关键任务，深度学习（DL）框架现已成为自动病变检测的主要方法。如今，诸如YOLO等通用目标检测方法在该背景下提供了最先进的性能。然而，在真实临床条件下，由于内镜设备、肠道内容物、数据集偏倚以及存在小或低对比度病变等方面的差异，其稳健性往往下降。受这些挑战驱动，我们提出了一种基于注意力残差U-Net（Attention Residual U-Net）的新型息肉检测框架，可增强息肉定位。所提方法不是从全局特征表示直接回归边界框，而是学习以病变为中心的空间表示，并在推理期间将其转换为边界框预测。与直接将所有编码器激活传播到解码路径的传统编码器-解码器定位框架不同，所提方法在特征重建之前选择性抑制无关背景响应。这促使网络在异质成像条件下关注与病变相关的空间证据。为实现这一点，该框架整合了残差特征传播、注意力引导的编码器过滤和多尺度上下文学习。所提框架在多个使用不同设备采集的公开内镜数据集上进行了评估。对比实验结果验证了其相对于相关最先进方法的有效性，在受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUC）方面提升最高达22.0%。

title: SMILE: A Structured Multi-Agent Clinical Reasoning for Liver Ultrasound Understanding
zh_title: SMILE：面向肝脏超声理解的结构化多智能体临床推理
summary: 提出结构化多智能体框架，由多个专科智能体解读肝脏超声图像，并通过裁判引导的共识机制生成结构化报告。
key_points: 三类专科智能体分工解读超声图像
裁判引导的共识机制整合各智能体输出
针对视觉—语言模态鸿沟与配对监督不足
reason: 有新意的多智能体预印本方法，但摘要未见规模与外部验证
abstract: Automated liver ultrasound report generation improves the diagnosis of liver diseases by producing clinically structured descriptions of anatomical and disease-related findings. However, current generative vision-language models (VLMs) often rely on a single reasoning pathway that maps ultrasound appearance directly to textual descriptions. In addition to the inherent vision-language modality gap, this design is limited for liver ultrasound because disease interpretation is constrained by subtle visual evidence, heterogeneous disease patterns, and limited paired supervision. To address these limitations, we propose SMILE, a Structured Multi-agent clInicaL rEasoning framework that uses multiple complementary specialist agents to interpret ultrasound images and consolidates their outputs through a judge-guided consensus mechanism. Our approach employs three specialized agents: an image interpretation agent for morphological descriptions, a clinical-stage reasoning agent, and a visual question answering (VQA) agent for targeted queries. These agent responses are then aggregated and scrutinized by a judge VLM using a consensus filtering prompt to produce a unified, clinically coherent output. Across a public liver ultrasound dataset and an internal clinical dataset, SMILE consistently outperforms state-of-the-art VLMs, achieving up to 19.0\% improvement in ROUGE-1 and 18.8\% improvement in clinical F1-score, while reaching VQA F1-scores of 0.82 and 0.65 on public and internal datasets, respectively. These results demonstrate the potential of SMILE for data-scarce and limited-supervision clinical settings. Our models, datasets, and code are available \href{https://github.com/CMME-Lab/SMILE}{here}.
zh_abstract: 自动化肝脏超声报告生成通过生成解剖学和疾病相关发现的临床结构化描述，改善肝脏疾病的诊断。然而，当前的生成式视觉-语言模型（VLM）通常依赖单一推理路径，将超声外观直接映射为文本描述。除了固有的视觉-语言模态差距外，这种设计在肝脏超声中也有局限，因为疾病解释受到细微视觉证据、异质性疾病模式和有限配对监督的约束。为解决这些局限，我们提出SMILE，一种结构化多智能体临床推理（Structured Multi-agent clInicaL rEasoning）框架，使用多个互补的专家智能体解释超声图像，并通过评判器引导的共识机制整合其输出。我们的方法采用三个专门化智能体：用于形态学描述的图像解释智能体、临床阶段推理智能体，以及用于定向查询的视觉问答（VQA）智能体。然后，这些智能体响应由评判器VLM使用共识过滤提示进行汇总和审查，以产生统一、临床连贯的输出。在一个公开肝脏超声数据集和一个内部临床数据集上，SMILE始终优于最先进的VLM，在ROUGE-1上提升最高达19.0%，在临床F1-score上提升18.8%，同时在公开和内部数据集上分别达到VQA F1-score 0.82和0.65。这些结果证明了SMILE在数据稀缺和有限监督临床环境中的潜力。我们的模型、数据集和代码可在此处获取：https://github.com/CMME-Lab/SMILE。

title: Window-Aware Scheduling for Health Messaging under Platform Delivery Constraints: Evidence from an AI-Powered WhatsApp Maternal and Infant Health Chatbot in Nigeria
zh_title: WhatsApp孕婴健康聊天机器人的窗口感知调度
summary: 分析尼日利亚WhatsApp孕婴健康机器人98,607条消息，量化平台24小时会话窗口造成的投递失败并提出调度方案。
key_points: 窗口开放时3.55万条自由消息零失败
恰在24小时处失败率跳升93个百分点
两条流程贡献66.1%的失败消息
reason: 真实部署大数据量运营分析，但为预印本且限于投递工程层，值得一看档
abstract: WhatsApp lets a business send free-form messages only within 24 hours of a user's last message; outside this customer service window, only pre-approved templates are delivered. Health chatbots inherit this rule, but its cost is rarely measured. We analyse 98,607 messages sent to 3,696 mothers by a WhatsApp maternal health chatbot in Nigeria, with a largely separate export as replication. No free-form message failed with the window open (0 of 35,500), and failure jumped by 93.0 percentage points (95% CI 87.0 to 99.1) at exactly 24 hours. Two flows produced 66.1% of failures, including an offer to speak with a medical professional that, as built, reached 0.3 in 100 mothers whose window had closed. We formalise window-aware scheduling as a decision problem with an action of known zero value. Model-based offline evaluation, with bounds for unconfirmed delivery, estimates that sending the offer as an approved template would reach 81.5 to 86.8 in 100 such mothers, against 16.6 for waiting and 11.6 for a reply prompt. In a calibrated simulation, tabular Q-learning converges to the same template rule and does not beat it in any of 13 stress tests, and opting out does not rise with message volume. The main gain comes from respecting the platform rule, and it needs no learning. All outcomes are deliveries, not health outcomes.
zh_abstract: WhatsApp 仅允许企业在用户最后一条消息后的24小时内发送自由格式消息；在此客服窗口之外，只能发送预先批准的模板。健康聊天机器人继承了这一规则，但其代价很少被测量。我们分析了尼日利亚一个 WhatsApp 孕产妇健康聊天机器人发送给3,696名母亲的98,607条消息，并以一份基本独立的导出数据作为重复验证。在窗口开放时，没有一条自由格式消息失败（35,500条中0条），而在恰好24小时处，失败率跃升93.0个百分点（95% CI 87.0至99.1）。两个流程产生了66.1%的失败，其中包括一项与医疗专业人员交谈的邀请，按现有构建方式，该邀请在窗口已关闭的母亲中每100人仅触达0.3人。我们将窗口感知的调度形式化为一个决策问题，其中一个动作具有已知的零价值。基于模型的离线评估（对未确认送达设置了界限）估计，将该邀请作为已批准模板发送，可在每100名此类母亲中触达81.5至86.8人，而等待为16.6，回复提示为11.6。在校准模拟中，表格型 Q-learning 收敛到相同的模板规则，并且在13项压力测试中的任何一项都未能超越该规则，且消息量增加并未导致退出率上升。主要收益来自遵守平台规则，且无需学习。所有结局均为送达，而非健康结局。

title: A conditional generative model for T2-weighted prostate MRI with downstream evaluation in clinically significant cancer classificatio
zh_title: 前列腺T2加权MRI条件生成模型及下游评估
summary: 单中心回顾性研究开发带癌灶与分区条件的T2W前列腺MRI生成模型，并用分类器评估合成数据的下游价值。
key_points: 基于1,303例患者1,654个病灶微调
FID由13.28降至约2.04
五种模拟训练场景下评估合成数据效用
reason: 预印本、单中心回顾性，以图像保真度与模拟评估为主，值得一看档
abstract: Scarce and unrepresentative training data limit the performance of prostate MRI prediction models. Synthetic T2-weighted (T2W) MRI may augment training data containing clinically significant prostate cancer (csPCa) and transition zone (TZ) lesions. In this retrospective, single-center, ethics-committee-approved study, we developed a conditional generative model for T2W prostate MRI extending MAISI-v2 with csPCa class, zonal, and lesion-mask-guided conditioning, incorporating a relative advantage weighted loss fine-tuned on 1,303 patients (1,654 lesions). Fidelity was assessed by incremental ablation, and downstream utility was evaluated with T2W-based csPCa classifiers across five simulated training-data scenarios, each testing 18 synthetic-data configurations. The proposed model reduced Fréchet inception distance (FID) from 13.28 (pretrained MAISI-v2) to $2.04 \pm 0.06$ internally (PI-CAI: $3.83 \pm 0.51$). Synthetic augmentation significantly increased AUC in all five scenarios (+0.027 to +0.088; adjusted $p = 0.016$--$0.043$), though cross-institutional augmentation of PI-CAI yielded a non-significant gain (+0.013; $p = 0.397$). Overall, our model improved T2W MRI fidelity, and synthetic images improved csPCa classification under simulated data constraints, although benefit did not transfer significantly across institutions.
zh_abstract: 稀缺且不具代表性的训练数据限制了前列腺 MRI 预测模型的性能。合成 T2 加权（T2W）MRI 可扩充包含临床显著前列腺癌（csPCa）和移行区（TZ）病变的训练数据。在这项回顾性、单中心、经伦理委员会批准的研究中，我们开发了一种用于 T2W 前列腺 MRI 的条件生成模型，该模型在 MAISI-v2 基础上扩展，加入 csPCa 类别、分区和病变掩膜引导的条件化，并采用相对优势加权损失（relative advantage weighted loss），在1,303名患者（1,654个病变）上微调。通过增量消融评估保真度，并在五种模拟训练数据场景中，用基于 T2W 的 csPCa 分类器评估下游效用，每种场景测试18种合成数据配置。所提出的模型将 Fréchet inception distance（FID）从13.28（预训练 MAISI-v2）降至内部 $2.04 \pm 0.06$（PI-CAI：$3.83 \pm 0.51$）。合成数据增强在全部五种场景中均显著提高 AUC（+0.027至+0.088；校正 $p = 0.016$--$0.043$），不过对 PI-CAI 的跨机构增强带来的增益不显著（+0.013；$p = 0.397$）。总体而言，我们的模型提高了 T2W MRI 保真度，合成图像在模拟数据约束下改善了 csPCa 分类，但收益并未在机构间显著迁移。

title: Poisson Super Learning For Survival And Competing Risks On A Discretized Time Scale
zh_title: 离散时间尺度上生存与竞争风险的Poisson超级学习器
summary: 提出基于分段常数风险与Poisson似然对应的可扩展集成方法，用于右删失生存与竞争风险预测。
key_points: 利用分段常数风险似然与Poisson似然的对应关系
交叉验证的对数风险预测由Poisson元学习器组合
可整合参数、惩罚、加性及机器学习风险模型
reason: 方法学有新意且模块化，但为预印本且未见实证对比结果，属值得一看档
abstract: We introduce the Poisson Super Learner, a scalable ensemble method for survival and competing risks prediction with right-censored data. The approach exploits the correspondence between the likelihood of piecewise-constant hazard models and the Poisson likelihood. After expanding the data over a chosen time partition, candidate hazard learners are trained under a common Poisson loss, and cross-validated log-hazard predictions are combined by a Poisson meta learner. The resulting ensemble is a geometric combination of candidate hazards, and can be used to estimate survival probabilities and cause-specific absolute risks. The Poisson Super Learner framework is modular and can in principle incorporate any learner that can estimate interval-specific hazards, including parametric, penalised, additive, and other machine-learning hazard models. Training targets the cause-specific hazard directly and does not require explicit modelling of the censoring distribution. For competing risks, separate cause-specific ensembles are fitted and subsequently combined to obtain individualised cumulative incidence predictions. We illustrate the approach using data from the Steno Diabetes Center collected between 2005 and 2022 to predict cardiovascular disease risk in patients with type 1 diabetes from detailed covariate information. The applied analysis is complemented by simulation studies designed to reflect key features of the data and to examine the behaviour of the method under controlled settings. All analyses were implemented using the freely available R software package poissonsuperlearner.
zh_abstract: 我们引入 Poisson Super Learner，一种用于右删失数据的生存和竞争风险预测的可扩展集成方法。该方法利用分段常数风险模型的似然与泊松似然之间的对应关系。在选定时间划分上展开数据后，候选风险学习器在共同泊松损失下训练，交叉验证的对数风险预测由泊松元学习器组合。所得集成是候选风险的几何组合，可用于估计生存概率和病因特异性绝对风险。Poisson Super Learner 框架是模块化的，原则上可纳入任何能够估计区间特定风险的学习器，包括参数、惩罚、可加和其他机器学习风险模型。训练直接针对病因特异性风险，不需要显式建模删失分布。对于竞争风险，分别拟合病因特异性集成，随后组合以获得个体化累积发生率预测。我们使用 Steno Diabetes Center 于 2005 年至 2022 年间收集的数据说明该方法，利用详细协变量信息预测 1 型糖尿病患者的心血管疾病风险。应用分析辅以模拟研究，模拟研究旨在反映数据的关键特征并在受控环境中检查方法行为。所有分析均使用免费可用的 R 软件包 poissonsuperlearner 实现。

title: SurgPace: Complexity-Aware Progressive Distillation for Surgical Multimodal Large Language Models
zh_title: SurgPace：手术多模态大模型复杂度感知渐进蒸馏
summary: 针对手术视觉-语言模型提出复杂度感知的连续课程渐进蒸馏框架，以降低推理成本、便于临床部署。
key_points: 指出手术样本难度与视觉歧义差异大，直接蒸馏不稳定
按样本复杂度设计连续课程式蒸馏流程
兼顾早期多模态对齐与后期任务监督
reason: 问题设定清晰且有方法的预印本，但缺乏外部验证与量化结果，属值得一看档
abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have shown strong potential in robotic surgery for question answering, scene understanding, and grounded assistance, but their high computational cost limits real clinical deployment. Knowledge distillation provides a practical way to build compact surgical MLLMs, yet direct distillation is not well suited to surgical data because surgical samples vary greatly in difficulty, visual ambiguity, and required clinical context, making uniform teacher-student transfer unstable. In addition, the role of supervision changes during training: early stages require stronger teacher guidance for multimodal alignment, while later stages rely more on task supervision for effective optimization. To address these challenges, we propose SurgPace, a complexity-aware continuous curriculum framework for progressive distillation of surgical vision-language models. SurgPace estimates sample complexity using predictive confidence and Lorentz geometric consistency, and uses the fused score to guide a continuous easy-to-hard training process. We further introduce hierarchical representation alignment, which aligns the student with the teacher at the feature, logit, and probability levels, while gradually shifting the training focus from teacher imitation to task supervision. This design separates sample-level curriculum from objective-level scheduling, leading to more stable and effective distillation. We evaluate SurgPace on Surg-396K, a benchmark built from four public surgical datasets and covering five dialogue paradigms. SurgPace consistently outperforms strong MLLM distillation baselines, demonstrating its effectiveness for building compact, memory-efficient surgical MLLMs with faster decoding under controlled benchmarks. Code is available at https://github.com/hezhicheng2002/SurgPace.
zh_abstract: 多模态大语言模型（multimodal large language models, MLLMs）在机器人手术中的问答、场景理解和有依据的辅助方面显示出强大潜力，但其高计算成本限制了真实临床部署。知识蒸馏为构建紧凑的手术 MLLM 提供了实用途径，然而直接蒸馏并不很适合手术数据，因为手术样本在难度、视觉模糊性和所需临床背景方面差异很大，使得统一的教师-学生迁移不稳定。此外，监督的作用在训练过程中会发生变化：早期阶段需要更强的教师指导以进行多模态对齐，而后期阶段更依赖任务监督以实现有效优化。为应对这些挑战，我们提出 SurgPace，一个用于手术视觉-语言模型渐进蒸馏的复杂度感知连续课程框架。SurgPace 使用预测置信度和 Lorentz 几何一致性估计样本复杂度，并使用融合分数指导连续的由易到难训练过程。我们进一步引入分层表示对齐，在特征、logit 和概率层面将学生与教师对齐，同时逐渐将训练重点从教师模仿转向任务监督。这种设计将样本级课程与目标级调度分离，从而实现更稳定、更有效的蒸馏。我们在 Surg-396K 上评估 SurgPace，该基准由四个公共手术数据集构建，涵盖五种对话范式。SurgPace 始终优于强 MLLM 蒸馏基线，证明其在受控基准下构建紧凑、内存高效且解码更快的手术 MLLM 的有效性。代码见 https://github.com/hezhicheng2002/SurgPace。

title: Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks vs. Multi-Layer Perceptrons: A Rigorous Statistical Benchmark on Clinical Tabular Data
zh_title: KAN 与 MLP 在临床表格数据上的统计基准比较
summary: 在 7 个跨专科临床表格数据集上，用重复分层交叉验证与嵌套贝叶斯调参比较 9 种 KAN 变体、MLP 与随机森林。
key_points: 比较 11 种架构，含 9 种 KAN 变体与随机森林基线
7 个数据集覆盖肿瘤、心内、肾内、神经等专科
采用 3×5 重复分层交叉验证与嵌套贝叶斯调参
reason: 方法规范的回顾性基准比较，多数据集但无外部验证，属值得一看档
abstract: Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs) have recently been proposed as a promising alternative to Multi-Layer Perceptrons (MLPs). However, empirical evaluations on structured medical datasets remain scarce, and commonly reported metrics like AUROC can yield overly optimistic performance estimates on imbalanced clinical cohorts. In this study, we present a standardized benchmark comparing eleven architectures - nine KAN variants (FastKAN, WavKAN, ReLUKAN, ChebyKAN, TaylorKAN, GramKAN, JacobiKAN, LegendreKAN, and TabKAN), a tuned StandardMLP, and a Random Forest baseline - across seven heterogeneous medical tabular datasets spanning oncology, cardiology, nephrology, neurology, endocrinology, and obstetrics. Our experimental protocol employs a 3x5 Repeated Stratified K-Fold cross-validation scheme with nested Bayesian hyperparameter optimization and evaluates discrimination via Area Under the Precision-Recall Curve (AUPRC), calibration through the Brier Score, and computational efficiency. Formal equivalence testing is conducted using the Bayesian Correlated t-Test with a Region of Practical Equivalence (ROPE) at +/- 0.01. The results indicate that on datasets with severe class imbalance, dedicated KAN architectures (particularly TabKAN and ReLUKAN) can improve minority-class detection and achieve higher AUPRC than standard MLPs. Nevertheless, across pooled datasets, KAN variants demonstrate comparable overall predictive discrimination rather than a systematic advantage, while requiring 1.20x to 1.48x longer inference latency per sample and up to 12.5x more trainable parameters. Consequently, StandardMLP remains a strong baseline on the efficiency Pareto frontier, while KAN variants provide a viable alternative when precision on rare positive cases is the primary clinical objective. The code for reproducing the results is available at https://github.com/rafalwodzinski/kan_mlp_comparison.
zh_abstract: 科尔莫戈罗夫-阿诺德网络（Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks, KANs）最近被提出作为多层感知机（Multi-Layer Perceptrons, MLPs）的一种有前景的替代方案。然而，在结构化医学数据集上的实证评估仍然稀缺，且AUROC等常用报告的指标可能在类别不平衡的临床队列上产生过于乐观的性能估计。在本研究中，我们提出了一个标准化基准，在跨越肿瘤学、心脏病学、肾脏病学、神经病学、内分泌学和产科学的七个异质医学表格数据集上，比较十一种架构——九种KAN变体（FastKAN、WavKAN、ReLUKAN、ChebyKAN、TaylorKAN、GramKAN、JacobiKAN、LegendreKAN和TabKAN）、一个调优的StandardMLP以及一个随机森林（Random Forest）基线。我们的实验方案采用3x5重复分层K折交叉验证方案，并嵌套贝叶斯超参数优化，通过精确率-召回率曲线下面积（Area Under the Precision-Recall Curve, AUPRC）评估判别能力，通过Brier分数（Brier Score）评估校准，并评估计算效率。形式等价性检验使用贝叶斯相关t检验（Bayesian Correlated t-Test），并在+/- 0.01处设定实际等价区域（Region of Practical Equivalence, ROPE）。结果表明，在类别严重不平衡的数据集上，专用KAN架构（尤其是TabKAN和ReLUKAN）可以改善少数类检测，并实现比标准MLP更高的AUPRC。然而，在汇总数据集上，KAN变体表现出相当的总体预测判别能力，而非系统性优势，同时每个样本的推理延迟长1.20x至1.48x，可训练参数最多多12.5x。因此，StandardMLP在效率帕累托前沿上仍是强基线，而当罕见阳性病例的精确率是主要临床目标时，KAN变体提供了可行的替代方案。用于复现结果的代码可在 https://github.com/rafalwodzinski/kan_mlp_comparison 获取。

title: HistoTx: Early fusion of H&E images and spatial transcriptomics at varying spatial transcriptomics resolution with self-supervised learning
zh_title: HistoTx：H&E 图像与空间转录组早期融合模型
summary: 提出早期融合视觉 Transformer，将任意分辨率的转录组 token 与图像块 token 共同输入共享 Transformer，实现病理图像与空间转录组双向交互。
key_points: 转录组作为真实输入模态而非仅训练信号
转录 token 可构建于任意空间分辨率
基于纯视觉病理预训练路径初始化
reason: 有新方法构思的预印本，证据限于自建实验，未见外部验证
abstract: Spatial transcriptomics maps gene expression across tissue sections and, when integrated with whole slide images, jointly captures both morphological architecture and molecular activity to provide a rich, multimodal view of tissue biology. ML approaches combining spatial transcriptomics and WSIs typically learn a mapping from morphological features to molecular profiles via contrastive alignment or supervised fine-tuning of pathology foundation models. In both cases, transcriptomics serves as a training signal rather than a true input modality, leaving inference fundamentally image-driven. We propose an early-fusion vision transformer architecture in which transcript tokens are constructed at arbitrary spatial resolution, merged with image patch tokens, and jointly processed through a shared transformer stack for deep cross-modal interaction. Starting from a pretrained vision-only pathology foundation model, we train HistoTx by continuing self-supervised pretraining on paired image and spatial transcriptomics data and demonstrate that: 1) at inference with image only, performance remains on par with the baseline on most tasks while improving on tasks that inherently benefit from molecular knowledge, such as gene expression prediction; 2) when both modalities are available at inference, jointly providing image and transcript inputs outperforms either modality alone.
zh_abstract: 空间转录组学（spatial transcriptomics）映射组织切片上的基因表达，并与全切片图像（whole slide images, WSIs）整合时，共同捕获形态学结构和分子活动，从而提供组织生物学的丰富多模态视图。结合空间转录组学和WSI的机器学习方法通常通过对比对齐或病理基础模型的监督微调，学习从形态学特征到分子谱的映射。在两种情况下，转录组学都作为训练信号而非真正的输入模态，使推理从根本上由图像驱动。我们提出一种早期融合的视觉Transformer（vision transformer）架构，其中转录本标记（transcript tokens）在任意空间分辨率下构建，与图像块标记（image patch tokens）合并，并通过共享的Transformer堆栈联合处理，以实现深度跨模态交互。从预训练的仅视觉病理基础模型出发，我们通过在配对的图像和空间转录组学数据上继续进行自监督预训练来训练HistoTx，并证明：1）在仅使用图像进行推理时，性能在大多数任务上与基线持平，同时在本质上受益于分子知识的任务（如基因表达预测）上有所改善；2）当推理时两种模态均可用时，联合提供图像和转录本输入优于任一单一模态。

title: Peripheral prototypical contrastive loss for supervised medical image segmentation
zh_title: 面向监督式医学图像分割的边缘原型对比损失
summary: 提出边缘原型对比损失 PPC，利用边界附近局部区域原型特征改善边界识别，在多数据集含噪声标注下稳定训练。
key_points: 针对生物医学图像边界模糊、标注不稳问题设计新损失函数
用边界邻近局部区域的原型特征强化模糊区域监督
多数据集实验称分割性能提升，含噪声标签条件下亦稳定
reason: 预印本新损失方法，有多数据集对比但缺外部临床验证，属值得一看档
abstract: Robust segmentation of biomedical images remains challenging primarily due to ill-defined object boundaries. Although several loss functions have recently been proposed to enhance object boundary recognition, concerns remain about the susceptibility to unstable annotations resulting from boundary ambiguities. Here, we introduce the Peripheral Prototypical Contrastive (PPC) loss, which leverages prototypical contrastive learning to improve boundary recognition and enable stable training even under noisy annotation conditions. The PPC loss utilizes prototype features obtained from local regions near object boundaries, focusing specifically on ambiguous areas that have been challenging for existing approaches. Extensive experiments across multiple datasets demonstrated that the PPC loss consistently improve segmentation performance even under conditions with noisy labels. A newly proposed strategy, which adaptively determines the local region for prototype calculation, enhanced robustness and outperformed existing methods. Our findings indicate the potential of the PPC loss in facilitating scalable and reliable medical image segmentation, including the development of foundation models with imperfect annotations.
zh_abstract: 生物医学图像的稳健分割仍然具有挑战性，主要由于对象边界定义不清。尽管最近提出了若干损失函数来增强对象边界识别，但对其易受边界模糊导致的不稳定标注影响的担忧仍然存在。在此，我们引入外周原型对比（Peripheral Prototypical Contrastive, PPC）损失，它利用原型对比学习来改善边界识别，并即使在噪声标注条件下也能实现稳定训练。PPC损失利用从对象边界附近局部区域获得的原型特征，特别关注现有方法一直难以处理的不明确区域。跨多个数据集的大量实验表明，即使存在噪声标签，PPC损失也能持续改善分割性能。新提出的一种自适应确定用于原型计算的局部区域的策略增强了稳健性，并优于现有方法。我们的发现表明，PPC损失有潜力促进可扩展且可靠的医学图像分割，包括开发标注不完美的基础模型。

title: Artificial Intelligence-Enabled Nanomedicine in Precision Oncology: Diagnosis, Targeted Therapy, and Clinical Translation.
zh_title: AI赋能纳米医学的肿瘤精准诊疗综述
summary: 综述AI整合理化、影像、分子与临床数据，用于肿瘤纳米诊疗的设计、分层与转化。
key_points: AI整合多模态数据改进纳米材料设计
可用于早筛、分层及疗效与毒性预测
讨论纳米药物开发与临床转化的瓶颈
