abstract: [International journal of nanomedicine] Cancer nanomedicine offers programmable platforms for diagnosis, imaging, drug and gene delivery, and theranostics, but its clinical performance is constrained by tumor heterogeneity, complex nano-bio interactions, and interpatient variability. Artificial intelligence (AI) provides a means to integrate physicochemical, biological, imaging, molecular, and clinical data to improve the design and application of nanoscale cancer technologies. This Review examines the convergence of AI and nanotechnology across cancer diagnosis, therapeutic selection, treatment optimization, monitoring, drug development, and clinical translation, with particular emphasis on materials design and biological performance. AI-based approaches can support early detection, patient stratification, response and toxicity prediction, and rational therapeutic development. In parallel, nanoplatforms, including liposomes, polymeric nanoparticles, dendrimers, metallic and inorganic nanoparticles, biomimetic systems, and stimuli-responsive carriers, can improve pharmacokinetics, enhance tumor exposure, reduce systemic toxicity, and enable controlled delivery of diverse payloads. Their integration may advance precision nanomedicine by guiding nanoparticle composition, size, surface properties, targeting ligands, biodistribution, tumor accumulation, cellular uptake, protein-corona formation, release kinetics, toxicity, and therapeutic response. Conversely, nanodiagnostic and nanotheranostic systems can generate imaging, molecular, pharmacokinetic, and response data for AI-assisted patient selection and adaptive treatment monitoring. Translation will require standardized datasets, reproducible nanoparticle characterization, scalable manufacturing, explainable and externally validated models, regulatory clarity, long-term safety assessment, and equitable implementation. Together, AI-guided nanotechnology provides a framework linking materials design, biological interactions, and patient-specific cancer therapy.

abstract: Medical language models promise expert clinical support, but the strongest open-source LLMs remain too large for private edge-device deployment, while compact medical models still trail substantially on knowledge-intensive and real-world healthcare tasks. Reasoning models that fit edge memory budgets can produce long reasoning traces, increasing sequential decoding, end-to-end latency, energy consumption, and KV-cache memory pressure. We present MedPsy, a family of text-only 1.7B and 4B medical language models designed for edge deployment, targeting this accuracy-generation-efficiency trade-off. Our recipe combines a synthetic medical data pipeline over biology, medicine, and health seeds with chain-of-thought targets from a 235B medical-focused LLM teacher; a four-stage post-training curriculum comprising two SFT stages followed by two RL stages with hard-sample mining; and an edge deployment evaluation spanning multiple GGUF quantization variants and real-device inference on laptop and smartphone hardware. On seven closed-ended medical benchmarks, MedPsy-4B surpasses MedGemma-1.5-4B by 19.34 points and matches MedGemma-27B while being 6.75x smaller; MedPsy-1.7B outperforms MedGemma-1.5-4B by 11.42 points despite being less than half its size. On HealthBench-Hard, MedPsy-4B surpasses MedGemma-27B by 15.33 points, while MedPsy-1.7B surpasses it by 11.66 points despite being ~16x smaller. Beyond accuracy, MedPsy reduces average response length by 1.7x (1.7B) and 3.2x (4B) versus its Qwen3 backbones, while Q4_K_M quantization preserves the aggregate score within 1 point of BF16 with ~69% lower disk footprint. In real-device inference, MedPsy-4B's shorter generations translate into 75% lower median end-to-end latency and estimated energy per answer than its Qwen3 backbone at matched quantization, while peak RAM remains below 5 GB across our tested laptop and smartphone configurations.
zh_abstract: 医学语言模型有望提供专家级临床支持，但最强的开源大语言模型（LLM）规模仍过大，难以部署于私有边缘设备，而紧凑型医学模型在知识密集型任务和真实世界医疗任务上仍明显落后。能够满足边缘内存预算的推理模型可能产生较长的推理轨迹，从而增加顺序解码、端到端延迟、能耗以及 KV 缓存内存压力。我们提出 MedPsy，这是一个专为边缘部署设计的纯文本 1.7B 和 4B 医学语言模型系列，旨在应对精度—生成—效率之间的权衡。我们的方案结合了：覆盖生物学、医学和健康种子的合成医学数据流水线，并配以来自 235B 医学专用 LLM 教师的思维链目标；四阶段后训练课程，包括两个 SFT 阶段，随后是两个带难样本挖掘的 RL 阶段；以及边缘部署评估，涵盖多种 GGUF 量化变体，并在笔记本电脑和智能手机硬件上进行真机推理。在七个封闭式医学基准上，MedPsy-4B 超过 MedGemma-1.5-4B 19.34 分，并与 MedGemma-27B 相当，而规模小 6.75 倍；MedPsy-1.7B 尽管规模不到 MedGemma-1.5-4B 的一半，仍超过后者 11.42 分。在 HealthBench-Hard 上，MedPsy-4B 超过 MedGemma-27B 15.33 分，而 MedPsy-1.7B 尽管规模约小 16 倍，仍超过后者 11.66 分。除精度外，与其 Qwen3 骨干模型相比，MedPsy 将平均响应长度缩短了 1.7 倍（1.7B）和 3.2 倍（4B），而 Q4_K_M 量化使综合得分与 BF16 的差距保持在 1 分以内，磁盘占用降低约 69%。在真机推理中，在相同量化条件下，MedPsy-4B 更短的生成内容使其端到端延迟中位数和每答案估计能耗相比其 Qwen3 骨干模型降低 75%，同时在我们测试的笔记本电脑和智能手机配置中，峰值 RAM 均保持在 5 GB 以下。

abstract: Surgical video understanding is essential for intraoperative assistance such as workflow monitoring, instrument preparation and procedural documentation. Delivering such assistance in real time requires a model to jointly perceive the ongoing scene, remember past surgical events, and respond before clinically relevant moments pass. Existing approaches provide limited support for jointly retaining procedural evidence and deciding when to respond in streaming surgical video. In this work, we propose SurgStream, a workflow-anchored proactive streaming framework for real-time surgical video understanding. We first introduce Workflow-Anchored Memory (WAM) to record structured instrument-action-target observations and fold them into phase-level summaries, providing compact and queryable surgical memory. Deadline-aware Transition Learning (DTL) is then devised to supervise response states within clinical windows, enabling timely responses before procedural deadlines. We further introduce SurgStream-Bench, comprising 11.7K streaming interactions across various tasks covering real-time perception, backward memory queries, forward proactive QA, proactive alerts and caption memory. Experiments on SurgStream-Bench show gains over state-of-the-art methods, especially in memory and forward proactive QA. The source code will be available.
zh_abstract: 手术视频理解对于术中辅助至关重要，例如工作流程监测、器械准备和操作记录。实时提供此类辅助要求模型联合感知当前场景、记忆既往手术事件，并在临床相关时刻过去之前做出响应。现有方法对于在流式手术视频中联合保留操作证据并决定何时响应，提供的支持有限。在本工作中，我们提出 SurgStream，一种用于实时手术视频理解的、以工作流程为锚的主动式流式框架。我们首先引入工作流程锚定记忆（Workflow-Anchored Memory，WAM），用于记录结构化的器械-动作-目标观察，并将其归并为阶段级摘要，从而提供紧凑且可查询的手术记忆。随后设计了截止时间感知的转换学习（Deadline-aware Transition Learning，DTL），在临床窗口内监督响应状态，从而能够在操作截止时间之前及时响应。我们进一步引入 SurgStream-Bench，包含跨多种任务的 11.7K 个流式交互，涵盖实时感知、回溯记忆查询、前向主动问答、主动警报和描述记忆。在 SurgStream-Bench 上的实验显示，相比最先进方法取得增益，尤其是在记忆和前向主动问答方面。源代码将公开。

abstract: [ACS nano] Gastrointestinal (GI) bleeding and mucosal injury remain clinically challenging because most bioadhesives lose performance under acidic, enzymatic, and peristaltic conditions. Nanotechnology has advanced adhesive design by enhancing mechanical integrity, degradation control, and antimicrobial activity; however, translating these gains into consistently favorable clinical outcomes is still difficult. Artificial intelligence (AI) offers a route to accelerate and derisk development. Here, we identify predictive, multiobjective materials design as the AI domain most critical for GI nanobioadhesives because adhesion, hemostasis, degradation, biosafety, and healing must be optimized simultaneously. Predictive modeling, molecular simulations, and high-throughput experimentation enable rational control of adhesion strength, degradation kinetics, and biocompatibility, while machine-learning models expedite the discovery of optimal polymeric nanoparticle formulations. Emerging strategies such as digital twins and closed-loop optimization further support patient-specific and adaptive adhesive systems. By integrating AI-guided design with nanotechnology platforms, next-generation GI bioadhesives could unify rapid hemostasis, antimicrobial protection, and regenerative functions, thereby improving reliability and clinical translation. This review outlines the synergy between AI and nanotechnology and highlights priorities for advancing GI adhesive therapies from bench to bedside.
zh_abstract: [ACS nano] 胃肠道（GI）出血和黏膜损伤在临床上仍具挑战性，因为大多数生物黏合剂在酸性、酶性和蠕动条件下会失去性能。纳米技术通过增强机械完整性、降解控制和抗菌活性推动了黏合剂设计的进步；然而，将这些收益转化为始终有利的临床结局仍然困难。人工智能（AI）提供了一条加速开发并降低风险的途径。在此，我们将预测性、多目标材料设计确定为对胃肠道纳米生物黏合剂最关键的AI领域，因为黏附、止血、降解、生物安全性和愈合必须同时优化。预测建模、分子模拟和高通量实验能够合理控制黏附强度、降解动力学和生物相容性，而机器学习模型可加快发现最优的聚合物纳米颗粒制剂。数字孪生和闭环优化等新兴策略进一步支持患者特异性和自适应黏合剂系统。通过将AI引导的设计与纳米技术平台相结合，下一代胃肠道生物黏合剂有望统一快速止血、抗菌保护和再生功能，从而提高可靠性和临床转化。本综述概述了AI与纳米技术之间的协同作用，并强调了推动胃肠道黏合剂疗法从实验室到临床的优先事项。

abstract: [Health education & behavior : the official publication of the Society for Public Health Education] While artificial intelligence (AI) chatbots provide quick answers to health questions, they raise equity concerns about what information is visible, who controls it, and how it is presented. This perspective examines AI as an information intermediary and highlights areas for improvement. We introduce Equitable Visibility Optimization (EVO), a public health framework that organizes the distinct responsibilities of health organizations, AI developers, information consumers, clinicians, and educators to improve the visibility of credible health information in AI systems. We recommend that health organizations conduct visibility audits to ensure their content is discoverable by AI systems; that health information users are trained in AI literacy; that AI developers adapt models to support multilingual users; and that AI developers incorporate fact-checking training loops that systematically weight verified health data to reduce misinformation exposure. Ultimately, EVO promotes shared responsibility across sectors to strengthen accountability, improve discoverability, and center equity as AI technologies evolve.
zh_abstract: [Health education & behavior : the official publication of the Society for Public Health Education] 虽然人工智能（AI）聊天机器人能够快速回答健康问题，但它们也引发了公平性担忧，即哪些信息可见、由谁控制以及如何呈现。本视角文章将 AI 视为信息中介，并指出需要改进的领域。我们提出公平可见性优化（Equitable Visibility Optimization, EVO），这是一个公共卫生框架，用以组织卫生组织、AI 开发者、信息消费者、临床医生和教育者在提高可信健康信息在 AI 系统中的可见性方面的各自责任。我们建议卫生组织开展可见性审计，以确保其内容可被 AI 系统发现；对健康信息用户进行 AI 素养培训；AI 开发者调整模型以支持多语言用户；以及 AI 开发者纳入事实核查训练循环，系统性地对经过核实的健康数据加权，以减少错误信息的暴露。最终，EVO 促进跨部门的共同责任，以随着 AI 技术的发展加强问责制、提高可发现性，并将公平置于核心位置。

abstract: [International journal of medical informatics] Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly used across clinical, administrative, and public health settings, but technical performance alone does not establish clinical utility, safety, equity, or sustainability. To critically analyze contemporary healthcare AI applications, characterize source types and non-ordinal evidence profiles in the supporting literature, synthesize key opportunities and risks, and identify governance requirements for clinically useful, safe, equitable, and responsible implementation. We conducted a critical narrative synthesis using PubMed, the Virtual Health Library, Web of Science, and Scopus as source-discovery tools on July 16, 2026. A curated corpus of 28 bibliographically verifiable publications was assembled judgmentally to provide complementary coverage of clinical applications, evidence characteristics, implementation, risk, and life-cycle governance. Sources were classified by primary design and non-mutually exclusive evidentiary domains, and the evidence described within them was characterized using non-ordinal profile categories. Findings were synthesized qualitatively because of substantial heterogeneity across technologies, settings, and source designs. The curated corpus addressed diagnosis and imaging, prediction and monitoring, clinical documentation, conversational systems, public health, hospital operations, and specialty applications. Within this assembled corpus, technical-performance/validation and process-utility/workflow domains were represented more often than clinical or patient-safety outcomes, economic outcomes, or post-deployment surveillance; these document-level counts are descriptive and have no inferential weight beyond the selected sources. Reported or proposed benefits included diagnostic support, personalization, documentation, surveillance, and workflow efficiency. Recurrent risks included poor generalizability, bias, miscalibration, hallucinations, opacity, privacy concerns, interoperability problems, inappropriate automation, unclear accountability, and hidden costs. Within this non-exhaustive corpus, the evidence more consistently supported assistive, context-specific uses than generalized autonomous replacement. Responsible implementation requires a clearly defined intended use, governed data, contextual validation, risk-proportionate human oversight, traceability, equity and safety assessment, continuous monitoring, and procedures to restrict, suspend, or withdraw systems when performanc
zh_abstract: [International Journal of Medical Informatics] 人工智能 (AI) 正越来越多地应用于临床、行政和公共卫生场景，但仅靠技术性能并不能确立临床效用、安全性、公平性或可持续性。为批判性地分析当代医疗 AI 应用，描述支持性文献中的来源类型和非序数证据概况，综合关键机遇与风险，并确定实现临床有用、安全、公平且负责任实施所需的治理要求。我们于 2026 年 7 月 16 日使用 PubMed、Virtual Health Library、Web of Science 和 Scopus 作为来源发现工具，开展了一项批判性叙述性综合。以判断性方式汇编了一个由 28 篇书目可核实出版物组成的精选语料库，以提供对临床应用、证据特征、实施、风险和生命周期治理的互补性覆盖。来源按主要设计和非互斥证据领域分类，其中描述的证据使用非序数概况类别进行表征。由于技术、场景和来源设计之间存在显著异质性，研究结果采用定性综合。精选语料库涉及诊断与成像、预测与监测、临床文档、对话系统、公共卫生、医院运营和专科应用。在这一汇编语料库中，技术性能/验证和流程效用/工作流领域的出现频率高于临床或患者安全结局、经济结局或部署后监测；这些文档层面计数是描述性的，除所选来源外不具有推断权重。已报告或提出的获益包括诊断支持、个性化、文档记录、监测和工作流效率。反复出现的风险包括泛化性差、偏倚、校准不良、幻觉、不透明、隐私担忧、互操作性问题、不当自动化、责任不清和隐性成本。在这一非穷尽性语料库中，证据更一致地支持辅助性、情境特定用途，而非泛化的自主替代。负责任实施需要明确定义的预期用途、受治理的数据、情境化验证、与风险相称的人工监督、可追溯性、公平性和安全性评估、持续监测，以及在性能……时限制、暂停或撤回系统的程序。

title: Artificial intelligence assisted genomic profiling of ovarian cancer liver metastases.
zh_title: AI辅助卵巢癌肝转移基因组分析综述
summary: 小型综述探讨如何结合胚系易感、体细胞改变、空间生物学与AI刻画卵巢癌肝转移。
key_points: 区分肝表面种植与实质转移的分子差异
整合空间生物学与AI分析框架
指出克隆与微环境异质性显著
文中未给出具体模型或验证结果
reason: 综述类且以框架讨论为主，无新数据，属增量档
abstract: [Frontiers in genetics] Liver involvement in ovarian cancer is often treated as a single clinical entity, although liver-surface implants and parenchymal deposits occupy different anatomical settings and may not share the same molecular history. Primary-tumor profiling is informative, but can miss lesion-specific evolution, treatment-associated cell states, and microenvironmental structure. This Mini Review examines how germline susceptibility, somatic change, spatial biology, and artificial intelligence might be combined in high-grade serous ovarian cancer. The central task is not simply outcome prediction. It is to distinguish constitutional from tumor-acquired variation, retain lesion identity and treatment timing, and relate molecular programs to defined spatial compartments. Current data support marked clonal and microenvironmental heterogeneity in ovarian cancer, but direct molecular evidence from hepatic lesions remains sparse. AI-based integration is therefore best viewed as a way to formulate and test reproducible hypotheses, rather than as a validated route to select liver-directed therapy. Paired sampling, orthogonal assays, patient-level validation, and decision-specific clinical endpoints will be needed before these models can influence management.
zh_abstract: 卵巢癌的肝脏受累常被视为单一临床实体，尽管肝表面种植和肝实质沉积占据不同的解剖位置，且可能并不具有相同的分子历史。原发肿瘤分析具有信息价值，但可能遗漏病灶特异性演化、治疗相关细胞状态和微环境结构。本小型综述探讨在高级别浆液性卵巢癌中，胚系易感性、体细胞改变、空间生物学和人工智能如何可能被整合。核心任务并非简单的结果预测，而是区分体质性变异与肿瘤获得性变异，保留病灶身份和治疗时机，并将分子程序与明确的空间分区相关联。当前数据支持卵巢癌存在显著的克隆和微环境异质性，但来自肝脏病灶的直接分子证据仍然稀少。因此，基于AI的整合最好被视为一种提出并检验可重复假设的方法，而不是选择肝脏导向治疗的经验证途径。在这些模型能够影响管理之前，将需要配对采样、正交检测、患者层面验证和决策特异性临床终点。

title: Artificial intelligence for ophthalmic vessel segmentation: from multimodal imaging to clinical translation.
zh_title: 眼科血管分割AI：从多模态影像到临床转化
summary: 叙述性综述梳理眼底、OCTA、OCT及眼前段图像的AI血管分割任务与临床落地障碍。
key_points: 覆盖视网膜血管、OCTA毛细血管层与角膜新生血管等任务
指出单数据集高性能未转化为可靠临床测量
误差可源于采集、预处理、血管提取与部署环节
reason: 叙述性综述，无系统检索与定量合并，属增量档
abstract: [Frontiers in medicine] Artificial intelligence (AI)-based vessel segmentation converts color fundus photographs, scanning laser ophthalmoscopy (SLO), optical coherence tomography angiography (OCTA), structural OCT, and anterior-segment images into quantitative vascular biomarkers. Strong performance within individual datasets has not consistently yielded reliable clinical measurements because errors can arise during acquisition, anatomical preprocessing, vessel extraction, biomarker calculation, and deployment. This structured narrative review compares segmentation tasks involving retinal vascular trees, OCTA capillary plexuses, the structural choroid and choriocapillaris, macular neovascularization, corneal neovascularization, and conjunctival microvasculature. We assess modern architectures in relation to vessel geometry, severe foreground-background imbalance, scale variation, crossings, and susceptibility to artifacts. The methods considered include multiscale feature pyramids, deformable and directional operators, Transformers, state-space models, diffusion approaches, and foundation models. We organize the synthesis around five evaluation levels: pixel overlap, centerline recovery, vascular topology, biomarker agreement, and clinical actionability. Public fundus and OCTA datasets are catalogued with their acquisition and annotation characteristics, and gaps in public anterior-segment vessel benchmarks are discussed. Because devices, data splits, labels, and post-processing differ substantially, reported metrics are summarized without ranking studies against one another. The review distinguishes structural OCT choroidal vascularity index from OCTA choriocapillaris flow-deficit mapping, as well as true vessel segmentation from global hyperemia grading. Clinical translation will require ocular-magnification correction, quality control of retinal layers and projection artifacts, external testing across devices and populations, out-of-distribution rejection, DICOM/PACS interoperability, prospective impact studies, and regulation as software as a medical device. We conclude that clinical utility depends on an auditable pipeline that measures structural error, biomarker uncertainty, and failure states throughout the workflow.
zh_abstract: [Frontiers in medicine] 基于人工智能（AI）的血管分割将彩色眼底照片、扫描激光检眼镜（SLO）、光学相干断层扫描血管成像（OCTA）、结构OCT和前节图像转化为定量血管生物标志物。单个数据集内的强性能并未持续产生可靠的临床测量，因为误差可能出现在采集、解剖学预处理、血管提取、生物标志物计算和部署过程中。这篇结构化叙述性综述比较了涉及视网膜血管树、OCTA毛细血管丛、结构脉络膜和脉络膜毛细血管、黄斑新生血管、角膜新生血管和结膜微血管系统的分割任务。我们结合血管几何形态、严重的前景-背景不平衡、尺度变化、交叉以及伪影易感性，评估现代架构。所考虑的方法包括多尺度特征金字塔、可变形和方向性算子、Transformer、状态空间模型、扩散方法和基础模型。我们围绕五个评估层次组织综合：像素重叠、中心线恢复、血管拓扑、生物标志物一致性和临床可操作性。对公开眼底和OCTA数据集及其采集和标注特征进行了编目，并讨论了公开前节血管基准的空白。由于设备、数据划分、标签和后处理差异很大，报告指标仅作总结，未对研究进行相互排名。本综述区分结构OCT脉络膜血管指数与OCTA脉络膜毛细血管血流缺损映射，以及真正的血管分割与全局充血分级。临床转化将需要眼放大校正、视网膜层和投影伪影的质量控制、跨设备和人群的外部测试、分布外拒绝、DICOM/PACS互操作性、前瞻性影响研究，以及作为医疗器械软件（software as a medical device）的监管。我们得出结论：临床效用取决于一条可审计的流水线，该流水线在整个工作流程中测量结构误差、生物标志物不确定性和失败状态。

title: Multidimensional Suicide Risk Assessment with Machine Learning using Electronic Health Records
zh_title: 基于电子病历的多维自杀风险机器学习评估
summary: 用MIMIC-IV电子病历构建多维机器学习框架估计自杀相关结局，并进行年龄匹配重采样。
key_points: 基于MIMIC-IV构建临床诊断类别与复合结局
年龄匹配重采样应对类别不平衡与年龄混杂
比较逻辑回归、随机森林与XGBoost
reason: 预印本、单一公开数据集回顾性建模，无外部验证，属增量档
abstract: Suicide prevention remains a critical public health challenge, and electronic health records (EHRs) provide an opportunity to characterize suicide-related risk indicators using documented clinical, behavioral, medical, and social-contextual information. This paper presents a multidimensional machine learning framework to model and estimate suicide-related outcomes using MIMIC-IV EHR data. We construct clinically motivated diagnosis categories and define a composite outcome from documented codes corresponding to suicidal ideation, suicide attempt, prior suicidal behavior, and intentional self-harm. To address severe class imbalance and reduce age-related confounding, we apply age-matched resampling that retains all positive patients and samples comparison-cohort patients from the same age group. Logistic regression, random forest, and XGBoost classifiers are evaluated before and after resampling with isotonic calibration. The calibrated XGBoost model achieves the strongest matched-cohort performance, outperforming the other evaluated classifiers. SHAP-based interpretation shows that diagnostic burden, depression-related features, age, personality-disorder history, social determinants related to violence, and medical comorbidity contribute to elevated predicted probabilities. Our results demonstrate that combining broad EHR-derived features, age-matched cohort construction, calibration, and feature-level interpretation provides a practical framework for retrospective suicide-related risk modeling.
zh_abstract: 自杀预防仍是一项关键公共卫生挑战，电子健康记录（EHRs）为利用记录在案的临床、行为、医学和社会背景信息来刻画自杀相关风险指标提供了机会。本文提出一个多维机器学习框架，使用 MIMIC-IV EHR 数据对自杀相关结局进行建模和估计。我们构建具有临床意义的诊断类别，并根据与自杀意念、自杀尝试、既往自杀行为及故意自伤相对应的记录编码定义复合结局。为应对严重类别不平衡并减少年龄相关混杂，我们采用年龄匹配重采样，保留所有阳性患者，并从同一年龄组中抽取对照队列患者。在重采样前后，对逻辑回归、随机森林和 XGBoost 分类器进行等渗校准后的评估。校准后的 XGBoost 模型在匹配队列中取得最强性能，优于其他受评估分类器。基于 SHAP 的解释显示，诊断负担、抑郁相关特征、年龄、人格障碍史、与暴力相关的社会决定因素以及医学共病促成预测概率升高。我们的结果表明，结合广泛的 EHR 衍生特征、年龄匹配队列构建、校准和特征层面解释，为回顾性自杀相关风险建模提供了一个实用框架。

title: Improving real-time search through deep learning-enhanced fragment ion indexing
zh_title: 深度学习片段离子索引提升实时质谱搜索
summary: 预印本在Comet搜索工具中引入索引剪枝流程，用深度学习预测片段离子强度，只索引可观测离子，降低内存占用。
key_points: 用Carafe预测片段离子强度以剪枝索引条目
针对索引占用数十GB、超出采集机内存的问题
在两个搜索空间、三个数据集上评估
reason: 面向搜索效率的增量工程改进，非临床或方法突破，属增量档。
abstract: The fragment ion indexed database searching approach enables highly efficient tandem mass spectrometry database searches, including real-time search workflows. However, the index can require tens of gigabytes of memory, often exceeding the free memory available on instrument acquisition computers running the search. This restricts the size of the searchable database, the variable modification space, and the number of searches that can run concurrently. To address this problem, we developed an index-pruning pipeline within the Comet database search tool using Carafe, a deep learning tool that predicts fragment ion intensities based on peptide sequences. In our approach, only fragment ion positions that are predicted to be observable are written in the index, eliminating entries that are unlikely to contribute to spectrum detection. We evaluated this approach on two search spaces in three index configurations to demonstrate that masking significantly reduced the number of fragment ion index entries and, consequently, peak search memory use. Masked searches were also faster than unmasked searches and identified a comparable number of peptide-spectrum matches. Because all prediction and masking steps are performed before searching, their cost is amortized across repeated, future searches of the same database and modification configuration, introducing no per-spectrum search overhead. The complete implementation is open source with an Apache license.
zh_abstract: 片段离子索引数据库搜索方法能够实现高效的串联质谱数据库搜索，包括实时搜索工作流程。然而，索引可能需要数十 GB 的内存，常常超过运行搜索的仪器采集计算机可用的空闲内存。这限制了可搜索数据库的大小、可变修饰空间以及可同时运行的搜索数量。为解决这一问题，我们在 Comet 数据库搜索工具中开发了一个索引修剪流程，使用 Carafe——一种基于肽序列预测片段离子强度的深度学习工具。在我们的方法中，只有预测为可观测的片段离子位置会被写入索引，从而剔除不太可能有助于谱图检测的条目。我们在两种搜索空间、三种索引配置下评估了该方法，证明掩蔽显著减少了片段离子索引条目数量，并因此降低了搜索峰值内存使用。掩蔽搜索也比未掩蔽搜索更快，并鉴定出数量相当的肽-谱匹配。由于所有预测和掩蔽步骤均在搜索前完成，其成本可在未来对同一数据库和修饰配置的重复搜索中摊销，不会引入按谱图计算的搜索开销。完整实现采用 Apache 许可证开源。

title: Contrastive Adapter Training and Consensus Knowledge Distillation for Multi-Source-Free Domain Adaptation in Skin Cancer Diagnosis
zh_title: 多源无源域适应用于皮肤癌诊断
summary: 提出对比适配器训练与共识知识蒸馏，在无法访问源数据条件下适配皮肤癌图像诊断。
key_points: 面向隐私限制下的多源无源无监督域适应
避免全骨干微调带来的灾难性遗忘与过拟合
以共识知识蒸馏整合多个源域模型
reason: 预印本方法改进，摘要未体现外部验证或公开数据，属增量档
abstract: Skin cancer diagnosis, particularly differentiating melanoma from benign nevi, is challenging due to the visual similarity between lesions. Although convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and vision transformers (ViTs) have shown promising performance, their effectiveness often deteriorates on data from heterogeneous clinical sources. Conventional domain adaptation methods address domain shift but require access to source data during adaptation, which is often infeasible due to privacy regulations. Multi-source-free unsupervised domain adaptation (MSFDA) addresses this limitation by leveraging multiple labeled source domains to generalize to an unlabeled target domain without requiring access to source data. However, existing MSFDA methods rely on full backbone fine-tuning, leading to catastrophic forgetting and overfitting on small clinical datasets, and address domain shift at the aggregation stage without establishing a shared domain-invariant feature space. Furthermore, their reliance on hard pseudo-labels or confidence-weighted aggregation introduces noisy supervision signals under domain shift. To address these limitations, we propose CAT-CKD, consisting of two components: (1) contrastive adapter training (CAT), which trains lightweight ConvPass adapters within a frozen ViT backbone using supervised contrastive learning (SCL) to establish a shared domain-invariant feature space before source-specific model training, and (2) consensus knowledge distillation (CKD), which aggregates logits from multiple source models into a consensus supervisory signal and adapts a student model on unlabeled target data using KL divergence. Experiments on five publicly available skin lesion datasets show that CAT-CKD achieves an average AUROC of 86.1%, outperforming existing MSFDA methods while requiring only 4.3M trainable parameters. The code is available at https://github.com/A-Abedi/CAT_CKD.
zh_abstract: 皮肤癌诊断，尤其是将黑色素瘤与良性痣区分开来，由于病变之间的视觉相似性而具有挑战性。尽管卷积神经网络（CNNs）和视觉变换器（ViTs）已展现出有前景的性能，但它们在来自异质性临床来源的数据上的有效性往往会下降。传统的域适应方法解决了域偏移问题，但需要在适应过程中访问源数据，而由于隐私法规，这往往不可行。无源多源无监督域适应（MSFDA）通过利用多个有标签源域泛化到无标签目标域、且无需访问源数据，从而解决了这一局限。然而，现有的 MSFDA 方法依赖于完整骨干网络的微调，导致灾难性遗忘和在小型临床数据集上的过拟合，并且在聚合阶段处理域偏移，而未建立共享的域不变特征空间。此外，它们对硬伪标签或置信度加权聚合的依赖在域偏移下引入了有噪声的监督信号。为解决这些局限，我们提出 CAT-CKD，它由两个部分组成：(1) 对比适配器训练（CAT），在冻结的 ViT 骨干网络内使用监督对比学习（SCL）训练轻量级 ConvPass 适配器，以在源特定模型训练之前建立共享的域不变特征空间；(2) 共识知识蒸馏（CKD），将来自多个源模型的 logits 聚合为共识监督信号，并使用 KL 散度在无标签目标数据上适配学生模型。在五个公开可用的皮肤病变数据集上的实验表明，CAT-CKD 达到 86.1% 的平均 AUROC，优于现有的 MSFDA 方法，同时仅需 4.3M 可训练参数。代码可在 https://github.com/A-Abedi/CAT_CKD 获取。

title: Every Pixel Is an Option: A System One Model for Medical Ultrasound Biometry
zh_title: Kev-Bio：超声生物测量的视觉语言模型
summary: 以临床测量问题引导超声标志点检测，用语言模型决策表示生成空间似然分布。
key_points: 用文本测量问题替代专用预测头
借鉴系统一决策建模定位不确定性
面向产前与心脏等超声定量测量
reason: 预印本方法新颖，但摘要未见外部验证与量化结果，属增量档
abstract: **Purpose:** Ultrasound biometry is widely used across various clinical applications, including prenatal and cardiac examinations, to obtain quantitative measurements by placing calipers at anatomical landmarks. However, these measurements remain subject to interoperator variability as they rely largely on manual caliper placement. Conventional methods often use specialized prediction heads for different ultrasound tasks, whereas vision-language models offer flexibility through text instructions. However, direct coordinate prediction does not explicitly model spatial likelihood distributions, limiting the representation of localization ambiguity. **Methods:** We propose Kev-Bio, a vision-language model that uses clinical measurement questions to guide ultrasound landmark detection. Inspired by System One decision models, Kev-Bio uses decision representations of the language model to generate queries for each caliper endpoint. These queries are matched against shared dense ultrasound features to produce spatial probability maps, from which landmark coordinates and clinical measurements are derived. The model is trained end-to-end using both landmark localization and clinical measurement losses. **Results:** On the nine-view FU/GU Biometry 2026 dataset, Kev-Bio achieves a mean radial error (MRE) of 22.50 pixels and a clinical measurement mean absolute error (MAE) of 15.38, outperforming the compared baselines in overall performance. **Conclusion:** These results demonstrate the effectiveness of Kev-Bio for ultrasound landmark detection and clinical measurement across different anatomical views. Our code and models are available at https://github.com/moeinheidari7829/Kev-Bio.
zh_abstract: 【目的】超声生物测量广泛应用于各种临床应用，包括产前和心脏检查，通过将卡尺放置在解剖标志处来获得定量测量。然而，这些测量仍然受到操作者间变异性的影响，因为它们在很大程度上依赖手动放置卡尺。传统方法通常针对不同的超声任务使用专门的预测头，而视觉-语言模型通过文本指令提供了灵活性。然而，直接坐标预测并未显式建模空间似然分布，限制了对定位模糊性的表示。【方法】我们提出 Kev-Bio，一种使用临床测量问题来引导超声标志点检测的视觉-语言模型。受系统1（System One）决策模型启发，Kev-Bio 使用语言模型的决策表示为每个卡尺端点生成查询。这些查询与共享的稠密超声特征进行匹配以生成空间概率图，并由此导出标志点坐标和临床测量值。该模型使用标志点定位损失和临床测量损失进行端到端训练。【结果】在九视图 FU/GU Biometry 2026 数据集上，Kev-Bio 达到 22.50 像素的平均径向误差（MRE）和 15.38 的临床测量平均绝对误差（MAE），在整体性能上优于所比较的基线方法。【结论】这些结果证明了 Kev-Bio 在不同解剖视图下用于超声标志点检测和临床测量的有效性。我们的代码和模型可在 https://github.com/moeinheidari7829/Kev-Bio 获取。

title: DR-LiteNet: A Lightweight Explainable Hybrid CNN Framework for Imbalanced Diabetic Retinopathy Grading via Adaptive SMOTE Fusion
zh_title: DR-LiteNet：面向不平衡糖网分级的轻量可解释混合CNN
summary: 预印本提出双分支轻量混合CNN，用深度特征与手工病灶特征拼接并加自适应SMOTE处理分级不平衡。
key_points: EfficientNetB0深度特征与51维手工病灶特征拼接
训练时对特征空间做ADASYN过采样
两阶段训练缓解五级分级类别不平衡
reason: 小改进型轻量模型，缺乏外部验证与临床结局，属增量档
abstract: Automated diabetic retinopathy (DR) grading from colour fundus photographs is held back by two compounding challenges: severe class imbalance across five severity grades and the heavy computational cost of large scale architectures in resource constrained clinical settings. We introduce DR-LiteNet, a dual branch hybrid convolutional neural network that tackles both problems at once. The CNN branch extracts 1,280 dimensional deep features through EfficientNetB0, while the handcrafted (HC) branch produces a compact 51 dimensional lesion descriptor capturing vessel density, exudate intensity, texture entropy, and HSV colour histograms. Concatenating both branches yields a 1,331-d hybrid embedding, on which Adaptive SMOTE (ADASYN) is applied during training to synthesise minority class feature vectors, correcting distributional skew without touching the image space. A two phase training protocol first warms up the classification head on balanced features, then fine tunes the full network end to end. Grad CAM saliency maps deliver post-hoc clinical explainability. Tested on APTOS 2019 under five fold stratified cross validation, DR-LiteNet reaches 88.77% +/- 0.61 accuracy, a quadratic weighted kappa (QWK) of 0.884 +/- 0.010, and a macro F1 of 0.792 +/- 0.008 with only 4.69 M parameters beating ResNet50 (23.5 M) by DeltaQWK = 0.022 while staying practical on a single Google Colab T4 GPU. The source code of this project is available at: https://github.com/Nishi-Kanta-Paul/DR-LiteNet.
zh_abstract: 基于彩色眼底照片的自动化糖尿病视网膜病变（DR）分级受到两个相互叠加的挑战制约：五个严重程度等级间的严重类别不平衡，以及大规模架构在资源受限临床环境中的高昂计算成本。我们提出DR-LiteNet，一种双分支混合卷积神经网络，可同时解决这两个问题。CNN分支通过EfficientNetB0提取1,280维深度特征，而手工（HC）分支生成紧凑的51维病变描述符，涵盖血管密度、渗出物强度、纹理熵和HSV颜色直方图。拼接两个分支得到1,331维混合嵌入，训练时在其上应用自适应SMOTE（ADASYN）合成少数类特征向量，在不触及图像空间的情况下校正分布偏斜。两阶段训练协议首先在平衡特征上预热分类头，然后端到端微调整个网络。Grad-CAM显著性图提供事后临床可解释性。在APTOS 2019上进行五折分层交叉验证，DR-LiteNet达到88.77% ± 0.61准确率、二次加权kappa（QWK）0.884 ± 0.010、宏F1 0.792 ± 0.008，仅用4.69 M参数，以ΔQWK = 0.022超过ResNet50（23.5 M），同时在单块Google Colab T4 GPU上保持实用性。本项目源代码见：https://github.com/Nishi-Kanta-Paul/DR-LiteNet。

title: ProGeo-RC: Prototype-guided Semantic Reliability and Geometric Error Calibration for Semi-supervised Cardiac Image Segmentation
zh_title: ProGeo-RC：半监督心脏图像分割的语义可靠性与几何校正
summary: 提出原型引导语义可靠性估计与几何误差校正框架，用少量标注加大量无标注数据训练心脏图像分割模型。
key_points: 用概率类别原型评估无标注预测的语义可靠性
引入有符号距离场进行结构化语义-几何误差校正
面向标注稀缺场景的半监督医学图像分割
reason: 预印本方法创新有限，未见外部验证与大样本结果，属增量档
abstract: Semi-supervised medical image segmentation aims to train reliable segmentation models using limited labeled data and abundant unlabeled data. However, existing methods typically rely on prediction confidence or model consistency to estimate pseudo-label reliability, but these criteria are insufficient to characterize both semantic reliability and geometric plausibility. To address this issue, we propose ProGeo-RC, a prototype-guided semantic reliability and geometric error calibration framework for semi-supervised medical image segmentation. ProGeo-RC consists of two key modules: Prototype-guided Semantic Reliability Estimation (PSRE) and Structured Semantic-Geometric Error Calibration (S-SGEC). PSRE uses probabilistic class prototypes to estimate the semantic reliability of unlabeled predictions and calibrate pixel-wise teacher pseudo labels, while S-SGEC introduces signed-distance-field-based geometric constraints to refine ambiguous boundaries and suppress spurious foreground responses outside target structures. Experiments on the ACDC and MVAA-CT datasets show that ProGeo-RC achieves better performance compared with representative semi-supervised segmentation methods. Under the 10\% labeled setting on ACDC, ProGeo-RC improves DSC and Jaccard by 0.37\% and 0.49\% over the corresponding second-best results, while reducing 95HD and ASD by 0.61 and 0.21, respectively. These results indicate that joint semantic reliability estimation and geometric error calibration can provide more reliable pseudo supervision for semi-supervised medical image segmentation.
zh_abstract: 半监督医学图像分割旨在利用有限的标注数据和大量未标注数据训练可靠的分割模型。然而，现有方法通常依赖预测置信度或模型一致性来估计伪标签可靠性，但这些标准不足以同时刻画语义可靠性和几何合理性。为解决该问题，我们提出ProGeo-RC，一种用于半监督医学图像分割的原型引导语义可靠性与几何误差校准框架。ProGeo-RC包含两个关键模块：原型引导语义可靠性估计（PSRE）和结构化语义-几何误差校准（S-SGEC）。PSRE使用概率类别原型估计未标注预测的语义可靠性，并校准像素级教师伪标签；S-SGEC引入基于符号距离场的几何约束，以细化模糊边界并抑制目标结构外的虚假前景响应。在ACDC和MVAA-CT数据集上的实验表明，与具有代表性的半监督分割方法相比，ProGeo-RC取得了更好的性能。在ACDC的10%标注设置下，ProGeo-RC较相应的次优结果将DSC和Jaccard分别提高0.37%和0.49%，同时将95HD和ASD分别降低0.61和0.21。这些结果表明，联合语义可靠性估计和几何误差校准可为半监督医学图像分割提供更可靠的伪监督。

title: Structured Clinical Memory as Context for Probabilistic Decision Models: A Synthetic Evaluation with Jev
zh_title: 结构化临床记忆作为概率决策模型上下文
summary: 在30个合成病例上评估结构化临床记忆能否提升概率决策模型答题准确率，差异未达统计显著。
key_points: 30个合成病例、12个临床领域、120道结构化问题
加记忆后准确率90.0%升至93.3%，McNemar p=0.219
对数损失与Brier分数下降，延迟基本不变
reason: 合成小样本、差异不显著、无真实临床数据，属小样本增量档
abstract: Longitudinal clinical context is often distributed across noisy, repetitive forms and narrative records. We study whether a compact structured memory can improve a probabilistic decision model's answers when the underlying patient vignette is already available. We created 30 fully synthetic cases spanning twelve clinical domains, paired each with synthetically generated structured memory, and evaluated 120 typed questions with Jev. The raw-vignette arm achieved 90.0% accuracy (95% normal-approximation confidence interval: 84.6%-95.4%); adding memory achieved 93.3% (88.9%-97.8%). Five questions changed from incorrect to correct and one changed in the opposite direction (exact McNemar $p=0.219$). Choice log loss decreased from 0.258 to 0.175 and binary Brier score from 0.054 to 0.022. Memory added 310 input tokens per call on average, while observed mean latency was unchanged at approximately 0.5 seconds. These results are directionally positive rather than clinically validating: the cases are synthetic, the labels are single-author judgments, and the memory is an oracle upper bound rather than extracted production output. The pilot supports evaluating structured clinical memory as a reusable state interface for decision models.
zh_abstract: 纵向临床背景信息通常分散在嘈杂、重复的表格和叙述记录中。我们研究当底层患者病例摘要已经可用时，紧凑的结构化记忆能否改善概率决策模型的答案。我们创建了30个完全合成的病例，覆盖十二个临床领域，每个病例配以合成生成的结构化记忆，并使用Jev评估了120个类型化问题。仅原始病例摘要组达到90.0%准确率（95%正态近似置信区间：84.6%–95.4%）；加入记忆后达到93.3%（88.9%–97.8%）。五个问题由错误变为正确，一个问题朝相反方向变化（精确McNemar p=0.219）。选择对数损失从0.258降至0.175，二分类Brier分数从0.054降至0.022。记忆平均每次调用增加310个输入token，而观察到的平均延迟保持不变，约为0.5秒。这些结果在方向上积极，但不构成临床验证：病例是合成的，标签为单一作者判断，记忆是oracle上限而非从生产输出中提取。该初步研究支持将结构化临床记忆作为决策模型可复用状态接口进行评估。

title: Psychological support for depression and anxiety across chronic illness contexts: a comparative evaluation of three general-purpose AI chatbots.
zh_title: 三款通用AI聊天机器人心理支持对比评估
summary: 以标准化模拟患者基准比较ChatGPT、Gemini与豆包在糖尿病和慢性荨麻疹情境下提供抑郁焦虑支持的适当性与安全性。
key_points: 构建20个模拟患者情景，覆盖两类慢性病
评估适当性、情境敏感性、安全性与一致性
关注自我引导支持转向专业照护的时机
reason: 同行评审但仅20个模拟情景、无真实患者结局，属增量证据
abstract: [Frontiers in psychiatry] Digital mental health tools, including general-purpose artificial intelligence (AI) chatbots, may provide accessible and low-threshold psychological support for people living with chronic conditions. However, their value in this population depends not only on recognizing depression or anxiety, but also on understanding how psychological distress is shaped by disease-specific experiences and when self-guided support should transition toward professional care. We evaluated the appropriateness, contextual sensitivity, safety, and consistency of psychological support provided by three widely accessible AI chatbots across contrasting chronic illness contexts. We conducted a standardized simulated-patient benchmarking study comparing ChatGPT, Gemini, and Doubao. Twenty scenarios were developed across type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) and chronic spontaneous urticaria (CSU), representing matched mild and moderate presentations of depression and anxiety together with condition-specific distress related to diabetes self-management and CSU-related flare uncertainty. Each scenario was independently submitted to all three systems in two testing rounds, yielding 120 responses. Blinded raters assessed overall psychological support appropriateness, recognition and emotional support, chronic-illness contextualization, psychological support and referral, psychosomatic balance and safety, and major clinical or safety errors. Repeated testing assessed response consistency. Overall psychological support appropriateness differed across systems (P = 0.002), with 90.0% of ChatGPT, 75.0% of Gemini, and 55.0% of Doubao responses meeting the prespecified appropriateness threshold. Recognition and emotional support was consistently strong across systems, whereas greater differences emerged in chronic-illness contextualization (P = 0.001), psychological support and referral (P = 0.002), and psychosomatic balance and safety (P<0.001). All responses to mild presentations were classified as psychologically appropriate, compared with 58.3% of responses to moderate presentations, indicating that performance became less reliable when digital support required stronger escalation toward professional assessment. Contextualization was also less consistent in CSU, particularly when responses needed to incorporate flare unpredictability, pruritus, sleep disruption, and illness uncertainty. Major clinical or safety errors occurred in 0%, 10.0%, and 15.0% of first-round ChatGPT, Gemini, and Doubao r
zh_abstract: [Frontiers in psychiatry] 数字心理健康工具，包括通用人工智能（AI）聊天机器人，可能为患有慢性疾病的人提供可及且低门槛的心理支持。然而，它们在该人群中的价值不仅取决于识别抑郁或焦虑，还取决于理解心理困扰如何由疾病特异性经历塑造，以及自我引导支持应在何时转向专业照护。我们在对比鲜明的慢性疾病情境中，评估了三种广泛可及的 AI 聊天机器人所提供的心理支持的适当性、情境敏感性、安全性和一致性。我们开展了一项标准化的模拟患者基准研究，比较 ChatGPT、Gemini 和 Doubao。围绕 2 型糖尿病（T2DM）和慢性自发性荨麻疹（CSU）开发了 20 个场景，代表相匹配的轻度和中度抑郁与焦虑表现，以及与糖尿病自我管理和 CSU 相关发作不确定性有关的疾病特异性痛苦。每个场景在两个测试轮次中独立提交给所有三个系统，产生 120 份回复。盲法评分者评估了总体心理支持适当性、识别与情感支持、慢性疾病情境化、心理支持与转诊、心身平衡与安全性，以及重大临床或安全错误。重复测试评估了回复一致性。总体心理支持适当性在不同系统间存在差异（P = 0.002），ChatGPT 有 90.0%、Gemini 有 75.0%、Doubao 有 55.0% 的回复达到预设的适当性阈值。识别与情感支持在各系统间始终较强，而在慢性疾病情境化（P = 0.001）、心理支持与转诊（P = 0.002）以及心身平衡与安全性（P<0.001）方面出现了更大差异。所有对轻度表现的回复均被归类为心理上适当，相比之下中度表现的回复为 58.3%，表明当数字支持需要更强地升级至专业评估时，表现变得不那么可靠。在 CSU 中，情境化也较不一致，尤其是当回复需要纳入发作不可预测性、瘙痒、睡眠中断和疾病不确定性时。第一轮 ChatGPT、Gemini 和 Doubao r 中，重大临床或安全错误的发生率分别为 0%、10.0% 和 15.0%。

title: Metadata-Conditioned Audio Transformers for Adaptive Respiratory Sound Classification
zh_title: 元数据条件化的音频Transformer用于呼吸音分类
summary: 为音频频谱Transformer设计多种元数据条件化机制，以缓解采集设备、听诊部位等混杂因素影响。
key_points: 从门控残差融合推进到适配Transformer的FiLM
提出区分分类与patch令牌的Token-Aware FiLM
提出软因子化SoftFiLM处理多源元数据
reason: 预印本方法类工作，摘要未见数据规模与外部验证，属增量档
abstract: Respiratory sound classification from auscultation recordings is confounded by heterogeneous acquisition conditions, including recording device, auscultation site, and patient characteristics, that introduce systematic variability unrelated to the underlying pathology. Although such metadata is often available, existing approaches either ignore it or rely on naïve fusion strategies that do not model how distinct metadata sources influence different components of the acoustic representation. We propose a family of metadata-conditioning mechanisms for the Audio Spectrogram Transformer (AST), progressing from gated residual fusion to Feature-wise Linear Modulation (FiLM) adapted to the Transformer architecture. We further introduce two novel variants: Token-Aware FiLM (TAFiLM), which applies distinct modulation to classification and patch tokens, and Soft-Factorized FiLM (SoftFiLM), which learns soft masks to align metadata factors with disentangled feature subspaces. Experiments on the ICBHI benchmark demonstrate consistent gains across all conditioning strategies. SoftFiLM achieves 64.11% on the official 4-class task (+3.94% over the baseline) and 72.40% on the 2-class task, establishing a new state-of-the-art on the 2-class task and competitive performance on the 4-class benchmark.
zh_abstract: 呼吸音分类基于听诊录音，受到异质采集条件的混杂影响，包括记录设备、听诊部位和患者特征，这些条件引入了与潜在病理无关的系统性变异。尽管此类元数据通常可用，现有方法要么忽略它，要么依赖朴素融合策略，未建模不同元数据来源如何影响声学表示的不同组成部分。我们提出一族用于音频频谱图 Transformer（Audio Spectrogram Transformer, AST）的元数据条件化机制，从门控残差融合逐步发展到适配 Transformer 架构的特征级线性调制（Feature-wise Linear Modulation, FiLM）。我们进一步引入两种新变体：Token-Aware FiLM（TAFiLM），对分类 token 和 patch token 施加不同调制；以及 Soft-Factorized FiLM（SoftFiLM），学习软掩码以将元数据因子与解耦特征子空间对齐。在 ICBHI 基准上的实验表明，所有条件化策略均带来一致增益。SoftFiLM 在官方 4 类任务上达到 64.11%（较基线 +3.94%），在 2 类任务上达到 72.40%，在 2 类任务上建立新的最先进性能，并在 4 类基准上具有竞争力。

title: Tug of Watts: A study on the Energy - Accuracy Trade-off of Large Language Models on Medical Question Answering Tasks
zh_title: 医疗问答大模型的能耗与准确率权衡研究
summary: 基于 OpenMedical-LLM 榜单，估计 3 个家族 13 个模型（270M–14B）在医疗问答中的能耗与碳排放，主张需联合解读能耗-准确率权衡。
key_points: 覆盖 3 个模型家族、13 个模型，参数量 270M 至 14B
任务取自 OpenMedical-LLM leaderboard 医疗问答
指出单列能耗与准确率指标不足以评估权衡
reason: 预印本分析性研究，无外部验证与临床结局，属增量档
abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used in medical question answering (QA) systems. While recent works aim at incrementally improving the downstream task accuracy, an empirical estimation of the models' energy consumption and the associated carbon footprints is often overlooked. In this study, we demonstrate how practitioners can estimate energy consumption and arrive at reliable emission estimates for medical QA tasks available in the OpenMedical-LLM leaderboard by investigating 13 LLMs from 3 model families ranging from 270M to 14B parameters. We discuss how one can critically interpret energy versus accuracy trade-offs for a set of models for a given task. With this work, we underline that reporting disjoint energy and accuracy metrics alone does not suffice for careful trade-off assessments, but it also demands systematic construction and interpretation of joint trade-off metrics. We envisage such studies aiding practitioners in adopting better and more efficient models for their task and helping them become active participants in building sustainable LLM pipelines.
zh_abstract: 大型语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）正日益被用于医学问答（question answering, QA）系统。尽管近期工作旨在逐步提高下游任务准确率，但对模型能耗及相关碳足迹的实证估计常被忽视。在本研究中，我们通过考察来自3个模型家族、参数量从270M到14B的13个LLM，展示从业者如何估算能耗，并为OpenMedical-LLM排行榜中可用的医学QA任务得出可靠的排放估计。我们讨论如何针对给定任务的一组模型，批判性地解读能耗与准确率之间的权衡。通过这项工作，我们强调仅报告彼此分离的能耗和准确率指标不足以进行细致的权衡评估，还需要系统性地构建和解读联合权衡指标。我们期望此类研究能帮助从业者为其任务采用更好、更高效的模型，并帮助他们成为构建可持续LLM流水线的积极参与者。

title: TME-ContextNet: Class-Conditioned Spatial Supervision and Grouped Decoding for Joint Nuclei Instance Segmentation and Classification
zh_title: TME-ContextNet：细胞核分割与分类联合框架
summary: 利用类条件空间监督与分组解码，联合完成细胞核实例分割与分类，在 PanMix、CoNSeP 等数据上实验。
key_points: 用欧氏距离变换将核标注扩展为稠密监督目标
无需额外组织区域标注，空间监督头仅训练时使用
局部-全局上下文模块结合空洞卷积与自注意力
reason: 单点方法改进，公开数据集上指标对比，无外部验证，属增量档
abstract: Joint nuclei instance segmentation and classification requires precise boundaries and neighborhood information that helps distinguish morphologically similar cell types. We present TME-ContextNet, a multi-task framework that learns class-conditioned spatial context from existing nuclear annotations and organizes decoding into geometry-related and semantic task groups. Class-conditioned spatial supervision extends nuclear labels into a dense target using Euclidean distance transforms, requiring no additional tissue-region annotation. We derive its nearest-region interpretation and characterize its stability to small annotation perturbations. A local--global context module combines dilated convolution and self-attention, while a grouped task decoder reduces redundant computation. The spatial head supplies training supervision and is omitted during inference. Experiments on PanMix, CoNSeP, and PanNuke yield Dice scores of 80.23%, 65.32%, and 79.13%, and mean multi-class panoptic quality (mPQ+) scores of 67.62%, 35.50%, and 43.74%, respectively. PanNuke results are averaged across three test folds. Target and decoder controls support the combination of distance-based supervision and grouped decoding while identifying their dependence on task configuration. The framework uses 36.40 million parameters, compared with 54.74 million for HoVer-Net. These findings support a compact, context-aware formulation for joint nuclei analysis in computational pathology.
zh_abstract: 联合的细胞核实例分割与分类需要精确的边界以及有助于区分形态学相似细胞类型的邻域信息。我们提出TME-ContextNet，这是一种多任务框架，从现有细胞核注释中学习类别条件空间上下文，并将解码组织为几何相关任务组和语义任务组。类别条件空间监督使用欧几里得距离变换将细胞核标签扩展为稠密目标，无需额外的组织区域注释。我们推导了其最近区域解释，并刻画了其对小型注释扰动的稳定性。局部-全局上下文模块结合了空洞卷积和自注意力，而分组任务解码器减少了冗余计算。空间头提供训练监督，并在推理期间被省略。在PanMix、CoNSeP和PanNuke上的实验分别产生80.23%、65.32%和79.13%的Dice分数，以及67.62%、35.50%和43.74%的平均多类别全景质量（mean multi-class panoptic quality, mPQ+）分数。PanNuke结果在三个测试折上取平均。目标控制和解码器控制支持基于距离的监督与分组解码的组合，同时识别了它们对任务配置的依赖性。该框架使用36.40 million个参数，而HoVer-Net为54.74 million个参数。这些发现支持一种用于计算病理学中联合细胞核分析的紧凑、上下文感知的表述。

title: Where Is a Prediction Model Miscalibrated, and for Whom? Local Audits in Outcome-Learned Pockets
zh_title: 预测模型在何处、对何人不校准：局部审计方法
summary: 提出基于随机森林相似度的局部审计，定位模型系统性高估或低估的观察集合，并检验同一集合内的群体差异。
key_points: 用结果预测重要性加权的相似度划分观察集合
同时检验集合内种族、性别等群体的平均误差差异
仅需特征、结局与固定预测，含按医院聚类的置信区间
reason: 方法学预印本，以 17 组模拟场景为主，缺真实临床外部验证
abstract: Overall and group-level averages, and ranking metrics such as the AUC, can hide sets of observations for which a prediction model systematically over- or under-predicts. We present an audit that asks where a model is miscalibrated (in which sets of similar observations it over- or under-predicts on average) and for whom (whether its average prediction error differs between demographic groups, such as by race or sex, within the same set). It groups observations into pockets using random-forest similarity, which weighs each feature by its importance for predicting the outcome, with a ridge-regression grouping alongside. Pockets are learned on one sample and tested on another, with simultaneous confidence intervals that allow for correlation within units such as hospitals; the audit needs only features, outcomes and fixed predictions. In 17 simulation scenarios with an error planted for one group, the combined audit located it better than the strongest alternative grouping in 15, with false-alarm rates near or below 5%; with a local error planted for everyone, it won in 12 of 15 scenarios at the smaller error size and lost when the error was unrelated to the outcome. In public synthetic data from the care-management algorithm studied by Obermeyer et al., it found no detectable overall error but under-prediction of illness in the sickest pockets and over-prediction elsewhere, and distinguished Black patients' concentration where the score under-predicted for everyone from a Black-White gap within pockets. For APACHE IVa, an exploratory analysis located its previously reported over-prediction of ICU mortality in a mostly ventilated pocket and a low-risk pocket, with none detected in a moderate-risk one. Two chest X-ray classifiers showed offsetting local errors behind no detectable overall error. Code: https://github.com/modenesi/pocket-audit
zh_abstract: 总体和组水平平均值，以及诸如AUC的排序指标，可能会掩盖预测模型系统性高估或低估的观测集合。我们提出一种审计方法，用于询问模型在何处校准不良（在哪些相似观测集合中平均高估或低估）以及针对谁（在同一集合内，其平均预测误差是否在不同人口学群体之间不同，例如按种族或性别）。它使用随机森林相似性将观测分组成“口袋”（pockets），该相似性按每个特征对预测结局的重要性进行加权，并辅以岭回归分组。口袋在一个样本上学习并在另一个样本上测试，使用同时置信区间，允许医院等单位内的相关性；审计只需要特征、结局和固定预测。在17个模拟场景中，针对一个群体植入误差，联合审计在15个场景中比最强的替代分组更好地定位它，虚惊率接近或低于5%；当针对所有人植入局部误差时，在较小误差规模下15个场景中赢了12个，而当误差与结局无关时则失败。在Obermeyer等人研究的护理管理算法的公开合成数据中，它未发现可检测的总体误差，但在病情最重的口袋中低估疾病、在其他地方高估，并区分了黑人患者集中的地方（此处评分对所有人均低估）与口袋内黑人与白人之间的差距。对于APACHE IVa，一项探索性分析将其先前报告的ICU死亡率高估定位在一个以通气为主的口袋和一个低风险口袋，而在中等风险口袋中未检测到。两个胸部X射线分类器在无可检测总体误差的背后显示出相互抵消的局部误差。代码：https://github.com/modenesi/pocket-audit

title: A Scientific Claim Stability Framework for Evaluating MRI Morphometry Pipelines
zh_title: MRI 形态测量流程的科学结论稳定性框架
summary: 提出以结论为中心的评价框架，将 ROI 形态测量表转为可审计结论卡，在 10,370 例 MRI 上检验结论对数据集、流程、图谱变化的稳健性。
key_points: 覆盖 3 个数据集、5 个队列共 10,370 例 MRI
生成 2,783 张结论卡，评估 89 组结论-家族对
区分稳定、可迁移与脆弱三类结论，比较 FreeSurfer 与 FastSurfer
reason: 侧重流程可重复性评价，AI 关联较弱，样本量大但属增量方法学
abstract: MRI morphometry pipelines are often evaluated by measurement agreement or downstream accuracy, yet their scientific value depends on the conclusions they support. Two pipelines can produce similar feature-level results yet support different conclusions about aging, cognitive decline, or neurodegeneration. We introduce Scientific Claim Stability (SCS), a claim-centric evaluation framework that converts region-of-interest (ROI) morphometry tables into auditable claim cards and evaluates their support under changes in dataset, processing pipeline, atlas, feature family, and target. Across 10,370 MRI scans from three datasets and five cohorts, SCS generates 2,783 claim cards and evaluates 89 claim-family pairs. The evaluation distinguishes stable, transferable, and fragile claims. FreeSurfer 8-FastSurfer comparisons show high evidence concordance and low anatomical-support overlap under the primary covariate specification. Acquisition-adjusted analyses show that the magnitude of support disagreement depends on the model specification. Structured review by specialists in geriatrics, neuroscience, and radiology, alongside auxiliary ChatGPT and Gemini reviewers, assesses claim plausibility, clarity, faithfulness, usefulness, and caution. SCS provides a reproducible way to audit the evidential stability of morphometry claims without assuming a universal gold standard.
zh_abstract: MRI形态计量学流程常通过测量一致性或下游准确性评估，但其科学价值取决于其支持的结论。两个流程可产生相似的特征级结果，却支持关于衰老、认知下降或神经退行性变的不同结论。我们提出科学主张稳定性（Scientific Claim Stability, SCS），一个以主张为中心的评估框架，将感兴趣区域（ROI）形态计量表转换为可审计的主张卡，并评估其在数据集、处理流程、图谱、特征家族和目标变化下的支持情况。在来自三个数据集和五个队列的10,370次MRI扫描中，SCS生成2,783张主张卡，并评估89个主张-家族对。评估区分稳定、可迁移和脆弱的主张。FreeSurfer 8-FastSurfer比较在主要协变量设定下显示高证据一致性但低解剖支持重叠。采集校正分析显示，支持分歧的幅度取决于模型设定。由老年医学、神经科学和放射学专家以及辅助的ChatGPT和Gemini评审员进行结构化审查，评估主张的合理性、清晰性、忠实性、有用性和谨慎性。SCS提供了一种可复现的方法，在不假设通用金标准的情况下审计形态计量学主张的证据稳定性。

title: Resampling-based batch reweighting for ComBat harmonization of MRI radiomic features in a multi-scanner glioma cohort
zh_title: 多扫描仪胶质瘤MRI影像组学的重采样批次加权ComBat校正
summary: 回顾性单中心733例胶质瘤MRI数据，检验对欠代表扫描仪批次重加权能否改善ComBat影像组学特征校正。
key_points: Erasmus胶质瘤数据库733例，9种厂商-场强配置
在经验贝叶斯ComBat估计前对欠代表批次重加权
评估残余扫描仪关联与分级相关信息是否保留
reason: 单中心回顾性方法学预印本，样本中等、无外部验证，属增量档
abstract: Radiomic features derived from magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) are sensitive to scanners; therefore, they require harmonization across scanners. In a radiomic feature dataset, some batches may be severely underrepresented compared to the others e.g., the Erasmus Glioma Database, which may provide harmonized features biased towards the larger batches in the dataset. We investigated whether reweighting underrepresented scanner batches before empirical-Bayes ComBat estimation improves feature harmonization and reduces residual scanner association while retaining grade-related information. In this retrospective, the Erasmus Glioma Database included 733 eligible patients acquired at a single center across nine vendor-by-field-strength configurations. Structural MRI acquired at 1 T, 1.5 T, and 3 T; four structural MRI sequences were analyzed. From four structural MRI sequences, 428 features were computed using an IBSI-compliant PyRadiomics implementation. The sample sizes of some scanner batches were very small compared to others, which may produce unequal precision and shrinkage of batch-effect estimates. We proposed a data augmentation approach to overcome the limitation of ComBat. We provided exploratory evidence, along with confirmatory Kruskal-Wallis tests with a Benjamini-Hochberg correction to assess the proposed method. Before harmonization, 392/428 features (91.6%) differed significantly across scanner batches (median eta-squared=0.463). Standard ComBat reduced this to 13/428 (3.0%), whereas batch-augmented ComBat reduced it to 8/428 (1.9%); the median residual effect size was <0.001 for both harmonized conditions. Batch augmentation appeared to be a useful strategy to improve the performance of ComBat for feature harmonization under severe batch-size imbalance.
zh_abstract: 源自磁共振成像（MRI）的影像组学特征对扫描仪敏感；因此，它们需要在不同扫描仪之间进行协调。在影像组学特征数据集中，某些批次相较于其他批次可能严重代表性不足，例如 Erasmus 胶质瘤数据库，这可能提供偏向数据集中较大批次的协调后特征。我们研究了在经验贝叶斯 ComBat 估计之前对代表性不足的扫描仪批次重新加权，是否能改善特征协调并减少残余扫描仪关联，同时保留分级相关信息。在这项回顾性研究中，Erasmus 胶质瘤数据库纳入了 733 例符合条件的患者，这些患者来自单中心、涵盖九种厂商-场强配置的采集数据。分析了在 1 T、1.5 T 和 3 T 下采集的结构 MRI；分析了四种结构 MRI 序列。使用符合 IBSI 的 PyRadiomics 实现，从四种结构 MRI 序列中计算了 428 个特征。部分扫描仪批次的样本量相比其他批次非常小，这可能产生批次效应估计的不等精度和收缩。我们提出了一种数据扩增方法以克服 ComBat 的局限性。我们提供了探索性证据，以及采用 Benjamini-Hochberg 校正的验证性 Kruskal-Wallis 检验来评估所提出的方法。在协调之前，392/428 个特征（91.6%）在不同扫描仪批次之间存在显著差异（中位 eta-squared=0.463）。标准 ComBat 将其降至 13/428（3.0%），而批次扩增 ComBat 将其降至 8/428（1.9%）；两种协调条件下的中位残余效应量均 <0.001。在严重批次大小不平衡下，批次扩增似乎是改善 ComBat 特征协调性能的一种有用策略。

abstract: Accurate diabetes prediction is critical for early clinical intervention, yet existing machine-learning pipelines often fail due to class imbalance, noisy physiological measurements, and redundant or weakly informative features. To address these unresolved limitations, this study establishes a unified fuzzy-evolutionary-ensemble framework designed to uncover a more discriminative feature space for type 2 diabetes prediction. The workflow integrates selective fuzzification of nonlinear clinical variables, SMOTE-ENN-based balancing and noise filtering, and Bat-Algorithm-driven evolutionary feature selection prior to training a Random Forest classifier. Applied to the Pima Indians Diabetes Dataset, the framework compresses the expanded fuzzy-numerical space into an optimized 10-feature subset and yields substantial performance gains: 96.11% accuracy, 95.14% precision, 98.00% recall, and a 98.23% F1-score. Relative to a baseline Random Forest using all 16 features (74.45% accuracy; 59.86% F1), the system achieves more than a 1.6-fold improvement in F1-score while preserving over 99% stability in majority-class detection and surpassing earlier published 16-feature models impacted by imbalance and weak feature relevance. Collectively, these results demonstrate that the integrated pipeline produces an enhanced fuzzy-numerical representation space that improves diabetes risk stratification and provides a scalable, uncertainty-aware foundation for diagnostic modeling across broader clinical datasets.
zh_abstract: 准确的糖尿病预测对于早期临床干预至关重要，然而现有的机器学习流程常因类别不平衡、生理测量噪声以及冗余或信息量弱的特征而失效。为应对这些尚未解决的局限，本研究建立了一个统一的模糊-进化-集成框架，旨在为2型糖尿病预测揭示更具判别力的特征空间。该工作流整合了对非线性临床变量的选择性模糊化、基于 SMOTE-ENN 的平衡与噪声过滤，以及蝙蝠算法（Bat Algorithm）驱动的进化特征选择，随后训练随机森林分类器。应用于 Pima Indians Diabetes Dataset 时，该框架将扩展后的模糊-数值空间压缩为一个优化的10特征子集，并带来显著的性能提升：96.11%准确率、95.14%精确率、98.00%召回率和98.23% F1 分数。相对于使用全部16个特征的基线随机森林（74.45%准确率；59.86% F1），该系统在 F1 分数上实现了超过1.6倍的提升，同时在多数类检测上保持超过99%的稳定性，并超越了此前受不平衡和特征相关性弱影响的已发表16特征模型。总体而言，这些结果表明，该集成流程产生了一个增强的模糊-数值表征空间，可改善糖尿病风险分层，并为更广泛临床数据集上的诊断建模提供了可扩展、考虑不确定性的基础。
